papers.title: FUTURE PERSPECTIVES OF CARBON QUANTUM DOTS: SYNTHESIS, APPLICATIONS, AND ENVIRONMENTAL IMPLICATIONS IN AQUACULTURE
papers.authors: Marlinda, Shella; Octavera, Anna; Ariyatna, Harits Atika; Effendi, Irzal; Rohmy, Sulasy; Miranti, Shavika; Nuryati, Sri; Alimuddin
papers.abstract: ARTICLE HIGLIGHTS- Carbon quantum dots enable sustainable applications in modern aquaculture- Biomass-derived carbon dots support green synthesis and circular economy- Fluorescent carbon dots enable rapid sensing of pollutants in aquatic systems- Carbon dots support bioimaging, antimicrobial activity, and gene delivery- Toxicity risks highlight the need for safety standards and life cycle assessment ABSTRACTCarbon quantum dots (CQDs) have emerged as promising carbon-based nanomaterials owing to their excellent optical properties, high biocompatibility, and versatile synthesis routes. Recent research trends have shifted from fundamental synthesis and characterization to functional applications in bioimaging, biosensing, biomedical therapy, food safety, and aquaculture. Green synthesis using renewable biomass has become the dominant approach, supporting circular economy concepts while reducing hazardous waste. Numerous studies demonstrate that CQDs can act as sensitive sensors for heavy metals and pollutants, stable probes for cellular and in vivo imaging, antimicrobial agents, and efficient nanocarriers for drug and gene delivery. Despite these advances, toxicological findings reveal that CQDs may induce oxidative stress, developmental abnormalities, and ecological risks in aquatic organisms, particularly at high concentrations or when heteroatom-doped. Moreover, the absence of specific regulations highlights the urgent need for standardized safety protocols and life-cycle assessments. This review outlines the progress, applications, challenges, and regulatory considerations of CQDs, emphasizing their potential role in advancing sustainable biotechnology and modern aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 本文综述碳量子点（CQDs）的合成、应用及其在水产养殖中的环境风险。CQDs因优异光学性能和高生物相容性，已从基础合成表征转向生物成像、生物传感、抗菌及药物/基因递送等功能应用，基于生物质的绿色合成成为主流。研究表明CQDs可灵敏检测重金属与污染物，但毒理学发现其在高浓度或杂原子掺杂时可能引发氧化应激、发育异常及生态风险。目前缺乏专门法规，亟需建立标准化安全规范与生命周期评估。

papers.title: Aquaculture, global food security and the looming risks of climate change
papers.authors: Perry, William Bernard
papers.summary_cn: 该文探讨水产养殖在全球粮食安全中的作用及气候变化带来的潜在风险，属综述性讨论，无具体研究方法与数据。

papers.title: Fishery monitoring reveals a rare and seasonal occurrence of the threatened tope shark Galeorhinus galeus (Linnaeus, 1758) within a restricted bathymetric range in the state of Santa Catarina, southern Brazil
papers.authors: Santos, P. R. S.; Vasconcellos, J. C. S.; Maribelto, R.; Lebedeff, V.; Cenci, H.; Rodrigues‐Filho, J. L.
papers.abstract: Abstract This study aimed to report new records of the tope shark Galeorhinus galeus , a critically endangered species in Brazil, based on onboard monitoring of artisanal bottom gillnet fisheries in southern Brazil, emphasizing its seasonal occurrence and strong association with a narrow depth range. Data were collected between 2021 and 2025 across 168 monitored fishing operations. A total of 14 individuals were recorded in only eight operations, suggesting the contemporary occurrence of the species in the region, where it was consistently recorded at low frequency throughout the monitoring period. All captures were restricted to winter and early spring and occurred within a narrow bathymetric range (48–52 m). Only juveniles were recorded, with similar proportions of males and females. These findings indicate that, despite its rarity, the species continues to use the region in a highly specific and seasonal manner. Overall, the results highlight the importance of continuous fishery monitoring for detecting remnant populations and emphasize the relevance of specific coastal habitats for the conservation of this threatened species.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于2021—2025年对巴西南部圣卡塔琳娜州手工底刺网渔业的168次随船监测，报道了极危物种翅鲨（Galeorhinus galeus）的新记录。共在8次作业中记录到14尾个体，出现频率低，且全部集中于冬季至初春、水深48–52 m的狭窄范围，均为幼鱼，雌雄比例相近。结果表明该物种虽稀有，仍以高度特异的季节性和水深偏好利用该区域，凸显了持续渔业监测对发现残存种群及沿海特定生境保护的重要性。

papers.authors: Lu, Qifeng; Zhang, Huai; Liu, Junhui; Jiang, Liqi; Zhang, Han; Lin, Li; Li, Qingqing
papers.abstract: Abstract Food deprivation is a pre‐harvest management practice that can alter body composition and muscle quality in cultured fish. This study compared growth performance, physiological indices, histological characteristics, muscle texture, proximate, fatty acid and amino acid content between food‐deprived and normally fed Oreochromis niloticus over a 30‐day period. Food deprivation significantly reduced specific growth rate (SGR), and liver somatic index (LSI) after 15 days and body weight (BW), weight gain rate (WGR), SGR, viscerosomatic index (VSI) and LSI after 30 days ( p < 0.05), whereas condition factor (CF) and visceral fat index (VAI) did not differ significantly between treatments. There were no significant changes in activities of superoxide dismutase (SOD), glutathione peroxidase (GSH‐Px) and aspartate aminotransferase (AST) after food deprivation. Muscle hardness was significantly greater in food‐deprived O. niloticus than in normally fed O. niloticus after 15 days ( p < 0.05). Micrographs from food‐deprived O. niloticus showed liver cells to be slightly irregular in shape, with some showing signs of dispersion and vacuolization; in addition, the intestine showed substantially more pronounced vacuolation, enlarged intercellular spaces and shortened villi compared with normally fed fish. Muscle crude protein content was significantly higher in food‐deprived O. niloticus than in normally fed O. niloticus ( p < 0.05); however, this increase may partly reflect a relative concentration effect associated with lipid depletion rather than an increase in absolute protein deposition. Serine and tyrosine concentrations were significantly higher after 15 days of food deprivation than in normally fed fish; the reverse was seen for total lipid content ( p < 0.05). After 30 days of food deprivation, muscle n‐3 PUFA content was significantly lower, whereas the n‐6/n‐3 PUFA ratio was significantly higher, than in normally fed fish ( p < 0.05). These findings indicate that a 30‐day food deprivation period reduced growth performance and altered muscle composition and texture, while producing only limited changes in the physiological indicators examined.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以尼罗罗非鱼（Oreochromis niloticus）为对象，比较了30天禁食与正常投喂组在生长性能、生理指标、组织学特征及肌肉品质上的差异。禁食显著降低了15天后的SGR和LSI以及30天后的BW、WGR、SGR、VSI和LSI，而CF和VAI无显著变化；SOD、GSH-Px和AST活性亦无显著改变。禁食15天后肌肉硬度显著升高，肝细胞形态轻度不规则并出现空泡化，肠道绒毛缩短、细胞间隙增大；肌肉粗蛋白含量升高（部分为脂质消耗所致的相对浓缩效应），总脂含量下降，30天后n-3 PUFA降低、n-6/n-3比值升高。结果表明30天禁食抑制生长并改变肌肉组成与质地，但对所测生理指标影响有限。

papers.title: Microplastic-Induced Gut Microbiome–Immune Crosstalk in Nile Tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus): Molecular Mechanisms, Biomarkers, Multi-Omics Insights and Mitigation Strategies for Sustainable Aquaculture
papers.authors: Shah, Masood; Naveed, Usman; Sarwar, Tahreem; Tahir, Maryam; Bakhsh, Allah; Faseeha, Inshrah; Ashraf, Zahra; Kousar, Adeela
papers.journal: Haya: The Saudi Journal of Life Sciences
papers.abstract: Microplastics (MPs) are widespread pollutants in freshwater aquaculture systems, entering through the degradation of pond linings and nets, contaminated aquafeeds, agricultural runoff and atmospheric deposition. Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) an omnivorous and intensively farmed fish, is heavily exposed to MPs however, the interaction between MPs, gut microbiota and mucosal immunity in this species has not been comprehensively assessed. In this review, we summarize recent evidence on the sources, uptake and accumulation of MPs and on how MP exposure causes gut dysbiosis, characterized by decreased alpha diversity, increased abundance of Proteobacteria and reduced levels of beneficial Firmicutes and Fusobacteria, which may affect short chain fatty acid biosynthesis. We then examine how dysbiosis and barrier dysfunction are linked to activation of the TLR4/MyD88/NF-κB, MAPK, JAK/STAT, Nrf2/Keap1 and NLRP3 inflammasome pathways and to oxidative and histopathological damage in the intestine and liver. Special attention is given to age dependent susceptibility, as juvenile fish show dysregulated inflammatory genes under conditions in which no effects are observed in adults. Candidate molecular, biochemical, hematological and non-invasive mucus-based biomarkers are discussed alongside the feasibility of multi omics approaches (metagenomics, transcriptomics, proteomics and metabolomics) for resolving host microbiota environment interactions. Mitigation strategies, including multi species probiotics, algal supplements, engineered biochar, feed management and biodegradable materials, are also evaluated. Key knowledge gaps remain in chronic low dose exposure, mixture effects, nanoplastics, reversibility of dysbiosis and methodological standardization. Addressing these gaps will be essential for developing resilient and sustainable tilapia aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 微塑料（MPs）通过池塘衬膜和网具降解、受污染饲料、农业径流及大气沉降等途径进入淡水养殖系统，尼罗罗非鱼作为集约化养殖的杂食性鱼类暴露风险较高，但其MPs-肠道菌群-黏膜免疫互作尚未得到系统评估。本文综述了MPs的来源、摄取与蓄积及其引发的肠道菌群失调（α多样性下降、Proteobacteria增多、有益Firmicutes和Fusobacteria减少，可能影响短链脂肪酸合成），并探讨了菌群失调与屏障功能障碍同TLR4/MyD88/NF-κB、MAPK、JAK/STAT、Nrf2/Keap1及NLRP3炎症小体通路激活及肠肝氧化损伤和组织病理损伤的关联。幼鱼在成鱼无效应的暴露条件下即表现炎症基因失调，提示年龄依赖性易感性；文章还讨论了候选分子、生化、血液及无创黏液生物标志物和多组学方法的应用前景，并评估了多菌种益生菌、藻类补充剂、工程生物炭、饲料管理及可降解材料等缓解策略。

papers.title: Policy Support and Farmers’ Ecological Aquaculture Behavior: The Mediating Role of Ecological Awareness
papers.authors: Jiang, Shuyang; Hu, Yanfu
papers.abstract: Promoting farmers’ adoption of ecological aquaculture practices is important for the environmental sustainability and green transformation of aquaculture. Using survey data from 278 aquaculture farmers in Zhangzhou, Fujian Province, China, this study examines the relationship between policy support and farmers’ ecological aquaculture behavior. Policy support is measured across three dimensions—financial and credit support, agricultural insurance support, and technical and knowledge support—and the potential mediating role of ecological awareness is further examined. The results show that policy support is significantly and positively associated with farmers’ ecological aquaculture behavior, and each of the three dimensions also exhibits a significant positive association when examined separately. Further analysis indicates that policy support is significantly and positively associated with ecological awareness, which plays a significant partial mediating role in the relationship between policy support and farmers’ ecological aquaculture behavior. These findings suggest that promoting the environmental sustainability of aquaculture requires attention to farmers’ financial, risk-related, and technical constraints, as well as to the role of ecological awareness in linking policy support to actual production behavior.
papers.summary_cn: 基于福建漳州278户养殖渔民的调查数据，研究考察了政策支持（金融信贷支持、农业保险支持、技术与知识支持三个维度）与渔民生态养殖行为的关系，并检验生态意识的中介作用。结果表明，政策支持及其各维度均与生态养殖行为显著正相关，生态意识在其中发挥显著的部分中介作用。研究提示，推动水产养殖绿色转型需同时关注渔民在资金、风险和技术方面的约束以及生态意识的培育。

papers.title: A legal strategy for state fish and wildlife agencies: A comprehensive review
papers.authors: Kisonak, Lane; Batcheller, Gordon R.
papers.summary_cn: 该文围绕州级鱼类与野生动物管理机构的法律策略展开综合评述，属渔业管理政策范畴，但因缺乏摘要无法提炼具体研究方法与发现。

papers.title: A Fish-Oriented Heavy Metal Pollution Index for the Danube River
papers.authors: Bezdan, Atila; Bezdan, Jovana
papers.abstract: The Heavy Metal Pollution Index (HPI) usually includes the metals that have a regulatory standard rather than those most relevant to fish. Its usual weights also give most influence to the metals with the strictest standards. This study developed a fish-oriented HPI for the Danube River. A data-coverage screen and an expert evaluation with the PAPRIKA method selected eight metals: Cd, Pb, Hg, Cu, Ni, Zn, As and Cr. They were combined with equal weights so that each selected metal contributes to the index. The index was calculated for 6467 sampling events at 43 stations in eight countries (1998–2022), and values below detection limits were estimated by multiple imputation. A generalised additive mixed model showed that the index increased about fourfold from the upper to the lower Danube and tended to decline over time. The downstream increase persisted under most alternative methods. In a Serbian reach surveyed for fish in 2022, the index in 2020–2022 was in the upper third of the basin, mainly because of Ni and Cu, and the fish community was dominated by eurytopic and non-native species. Selecting metals by their relevance to fish, and weighting them so that this selection matters, offers a transferable approach for fish-relevant contamination indices in large rivers.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对传统重金属污染指数（HPI）侧重监管标准而非鱼类相关性的问题，构建了面向鱼类的多瑙河HPI。通过数据覆盖筛选与PAPRIKA专家评估法选定Cd、Pb、Hg、Cu、Ni、Zn、As、Cr八种金属并等权合成，基于1998–2022年8国43个站点6467次采样数据计算指数，检出限以下数据采用多重插补处理。广义加性混合模型显示指数从多瑙河上游至下游约增长四倍，且随时间呈下降趋势；塞尔维亚河段2020–2022年指数居全流域前三分之一，主要受Ni和Cu驱动，鱼类群落以广适性和非本地种为主。该基于鱼类相关性选金属并等权赋值的思路可为大河鱼类相关污染指数提供可移植方法。

papers.title: Carbon footprint and energy-related performance indicators of Mediterranean and Black Sea trawl fisheries
papers.authors: Russo, Tommaso; Labriola, Maria Silvia; Ferrà, Carmen; Tassetti, Anna Nora; Marsaglia, Luca; Rinalduzzi, Sofia; Sala, Antonello
papers.abstract: Abstract Spatially explicit information on fuel consumption and energy efficiency is essential for evaluating the climate-related and economic performance of trawl fisheries, yet such data are rarely available at regional scales. This Data Descriptor presents four harmonised spatial datasets describing fuel consumption, fuel costs, and energy-related performance indicators for Mediterranean and Black Sea trawl fisheries during 2013 to 2022. The datasets integrate fleet-segment economic data from the EU Annual Economic Report with spatially resolved fishing effort and landings from the Fisheries Dependent Information database, using a reproducible framework that allocates fleet-segment fuel consumption and costs to spatial fishing grounds according to the distribution of fishing effort and landings. Indicators include Energy Consumption, Energy Costs, Fuel Use Intensity, Energy Use Intensity, and Fuel Efficiency, reported on a 0.5° c-square grid. The four products provide energy indicators at increasing levels of aggregation, ranging from datasets disaggregated by fishing technique, gear type, and vessel length to datasets summarised across all trawl fleet segments within each c-square grid. Spatial patterns of energy consumption were independently validated using Automatic Identification System data combined with empirically derived fuel-consumption relationships to reconstruct fuel use. These datasets provide a consistent spatial representation of energy use to support spatial analyses, modelling applications, and assessments of energy efficiency and decarbonisation strategies.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究构建了2013–2022年地中海与黑海拖网渔业四个协调的空间数据集，整合欧盟年度经济报告的船队经济数据与渔业依赖信息数据库的空间捕捞努力量和上岸量，将船队燃油消耗与成本按捕捞努力量分布分配至0.5°网格。指标涵盖能耗、能源成本、燃油使用强度、能源使用强度及燃油效率，并按捕捞技术、渔具类型和船长分级汇总。能耗空间格局经AIS数据结合经验燃油消耗关系独立验证，可为能效评估与脱碳策略的空间分析提供一致的数据支撑。

papers.title: A shared vision: regional data harmonization for resilient small-scale fisheries in the Western Indian Ocean
papers.authors: Mbaru, Emmanuel; Tilley, Alexander; Longobardi, Lorenzo; Gardella, Giacomo; Tembo, Japhet; Thoya, Pascal; Khalfan, Zahor; Tuda, Arthur; Hamza, Altarturi; Leopold, Marc
papers.abstract: Effective fisheries management in the Western Indian Ocean (WIO) is currently hindered by a lack of timely, harmonized data, which undermines the formulation of evidence-based policies. To address this gap, this study utilizes the Integrated Data Harmonization Framework (IDHF) to: (1) examine gaps and limitations in existing digital data collection systems in the region; (2) identify challenges and solutions for harmonizing small-scale fisheries (SSF) data; and (3) develop a strategic roadmap for national and regional data integration. While high-quality data is essential for sustainable governance, stakeholders perceived existing fisheries data systems in the region as performing inadequately, with a predominant focus on conventional catch metrics and insufficient attention to socio-economic indicators such as market value chains, prices, and costs. Consequently, these systems fail to provide the real-time insights necessary to track stock exploitation or evaluate the effectiveness of management measures. Key obstacles include technical and methodological inconsistencies, data access and trust issues, resource and capacity deficits, institutional and policy barriers, and lack of incentives for data providers. To overcome these obstacles, the study proposes establishing standardized frameworks and legal protocols for information exchange, alongside efforts to strengthen technical and financial capacity and integrate community-based monitoring. By leveraging digital tools to streamline data flow, the provided roadmap offers a clear path toward standardized data-sharing guidelines. Ultimately, these recommendations aim to foster institutional collaboration and improve decision-making to ensure the long-term sustainability of fishery resources across the WIO region.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究针对西印度洋（WIO）小规模渔业管理缺乏及时、统一数据的问题，运用Integrated Data Harmonization Framework（IDHF）评估了区域现有数字数据采集系统的缺口与局限，识别了SSF数据协调面临的挑战与解决方案，并制定了国家和区域数据整合的战略路线图。利益相关方普遍认为现有数据系统表现不足，过度侧重传统捕捞指标而忽视市场价值链、价格和成本等社会经济指标，难以提供追踪stock exploitation或评估管理措施效果的实时信息。主要障碍包括技术方法不一致、数据获取与信任问题、资源能力不足、制度政策壁垒及数据提供者缺乏激励。研究建议建立标准化信息交换框架与法律协议，加强技术与资金能力并整合社区监测，以促进机构协作和WIO区域渔业资源的长期可持续性。

papers.title: Water and endangered fish in the Klamath River basin revisited: Does old age or Upper Klamath Lake surface elevation and water quality affect adult Lost River Sucker and Shortnose Sucker survival? A response to Kann and Walker
papers.authors: Krause, Jacob R; Janney, Eric C; Burdick, Summer M; Caldwell, John; Hayes, Brian S
papers.journal: North American Journal of Fisheries Management
papers.abstract: Lay Summary Our update responds to recent scientific critiques and again finds no evidence that lake levels or water conditions influence adult sucker survival. This reaffirms our prior work (Krause et al., 2022) and suggests that recent declines in adult survival may reflect an aging population.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究回应了Kann和Walker对Klamath River流域濒危鱼类研究的批评，重新检验了Upper Klamath Lake水位与水质对成年Lost River Sucker和Shortnose Sucker存活率的影响。分析未发现湖泊水位或水环境条件与成鱼存活率之间存在关联，重申了Krause等（2022）的结论，并提示近期成鱼存活率下降可能反映种群老龄化。

papers.title: Large-scale spatial distribution of the soft flesh-inducing fish parasite Kudoa thyrsites (Cnidaria, Myxozoa) in the NE Atlantic
papers.authors: Giulietti, Lucilla; Storesund, Julia E.; Bruvold, Are Sæle; Karlsbakk, Egil; Mæhle, Stig; Slotte, Aril; Nøttestad, Leif; Cipriani, Paolo; Bao, Miguel; Wienerroither, Rupert
papers.journal: Reviews in Fish Biology and Fisheries
papers.summary_cn: 该研究聚焦于东北大西洋中诱导鱼肉软化病的寄生虫 *Kudoa thyrsites*（刺胞动物门，黏体动物），旨在揭示其在大尺度空间上的分布格局。由于摘要缺失，具体方法与结果无法获知，建议查阅全文以了解采样设计与空间分布特征。

papers.title: Viral Profiles in Aquaculture Fish from Kazakhstan: A Metagenomic Survey
papers.authors: Sabyrzhan, Temirlan; Nuralibekov, Sardor; Abdybekova, Aida; Kumar, Marat; Karamendin, Kobey; Kassymbekov, Yermukhammet; Suleimenova, Symbat; Khan, Yelizaveta; Yessentureyeva, Meruyert; Zhaksylykova, Ainur
papers.abstract: Viral diversity in aquaculture fish from Kazakhstan remains poorly characterized. This study investigated candidate virus-associated sequences in ten pooled tissue libraries representing four commercially important fish groups: silver carp, grass carp, sturgeon, and rainbow trout. RNA-enriched libraries were sequenced using an Illumina MiSeq platform, and viral assignments were evaluated through a metagenomic analysis pipeline. Of 21 initially identified taxonomic bins, eight were retained for fish-focused analyses. The most prominent finding was an Orthoreovirus-like sequence signal concentrated in two rainbow trout libraries from the Almaty region. A 2356-nt partial L1-region sequence showed 99.96% nucleotide identity to a previously reported piscine orthoreovirus 3 (PRV-3) reference, and phylogenetic analysis supported its placement among PRV-3 sequences. Candidate viral taxonomic profiles differed between the sampled sturgeon and rainbow trout libraries (PERMANOVA R2 = 0.455, exact p = 0.0286), although host species, sampling location, and tissue type were confounded. Taxonomic filtering also substantially influenced the observed diversity estimates. These findings provide preliminary evidence of candidate viral diversity in Kazakhstan’s aquaculture fish and identify PRV-3-like sequences in rainbow trout as a priority for further investigation. Broader sampling, targeted molecular confirmation, and additional genomic characterization are needed to clarify the distribution and potential clinical significance of these viruses.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在填补哈萨克斯坦养殖鱼类病毒多样性数据的空白，采用Illumina MiSeq对银鲤、草鱼、鲟鱼和虹鳟四个商业鱼种共10个混合组织文库进行宏基因组测序分析。最突出的发现是Almaty地区两个虹鳟文库中检出类Orthoreovirus信号，其2356-nt部分L1区序列与已报道的piscine orthoreovirus 3（PRV-3）参考序列核苷酸一致性达99.96%，系统发育分析支持其归入PRV-3分支。鲟鱼与虹鳟文库的候选病毒分类谱存在差异（PERMANOVA R2=0.455，p=0.0286），但宿主种类、采样地点与组织类型存在混杂，且分类过滤对多样性估计影响显著。研究提示哈萨克斯坦养殖鱼存在候选病毒多样性，虹鳟中PRV-3样序列值得优先开展靶向分子确认与基因组表征。

papers.title: Towards a situated engagement with coastal futures: Aquaculture, limits to growth, and anticipatory ruinations in Divtasvuodna/Tysfjord
papers.authors: Cossette-Laneville, Èva
papers.journal: Environment and Planning E: Nature and Space
papers.abstract: In contrast to its modest beginning in the 1970s, the Norwegian aquaculture industry is increasingly advocated by state officials and industry actors as vital to Norway's future, both in terms of economic growth and mainstay of coastal settlements. However, these views assume unity in terms of interests and values, often disregarding the lived realities on the ground. Based on fieldwork in Divtasvuodna/Tysfjord, Sápmi/northern Norway, this paper argues for a situated engagement with the way coastal futures are imagined, and how dominant discourses on emerging technologies in the industry may influence these visions. Drawing on Kasia Paprocki's concept of anticipatory ruination, I explore how the aquaculture industry anticipates future threats which are then used to legitimise its operations and emerging technologies as an instrument for more sustainable futures. This paper observes how this process unfolds in Divtasvuodna/Tysfjord and the way it is represented, manifested, and simultaneously contested by local people. The article shows ambivalent responses regarding the aquaculture industry's future role, contrasting with state and industry-led growth goals. While aquaculture is seen as important for maintaining a certain way of life, the reliance on a capital- and technology-intensive industry also brings uncertainties and insecurities. The research further argues for the need to recentre local agency and highlight the values, worldviews, and relationships that underpin everyday engagements with place.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于挪威北部Sápmi地区Divtasvuodna/Tysfjord的田野调查，探讨沿海未来的想象方式及水产养殖业主导话语对地方愿景的影响，运用“anticipatory ruination”概念分析行业如何以预期威胁 legitimise 其运营与新兴技术。研究发现，当地人对水产养殖业的未来角色态度矛盾：一方面认可其对维持特定生活方式的重要性，另一方面对资本与技术密集型产业的依赖带来不确定性与不安全感，与国家和行业主导的增长目标形成反差。作者主张重新聚焦地方能动性，重视支撑日常地方实践的价值观、世界观与关系。

papers.title: Comparative assessment of Open-Sea and Integrated Mangrove Aquaculture Systems (IMAS) for Asian seabass (<i>Lates calcarifer</i>) culture: implications for growth performance, physicochemical characteristics and mangrove cover assessment
papers.authors: Jeyaashriee, Kingston; Edward, L. Loveson; Athithan, Saminathan; Ranjith, Lakshmanan
papers.abstract: The present study compared the growth performance, feed utilization, water quality, primary productivity and sediment characteristics of Asian seabass (Lates calcarifer) cultured in an Open-Sea Cage culture system (OSC) and two Integrated Mangrove Aquaculture Systems (MP1 and MP2). Asian seabass were stocked at 10 fish m⁻³ in six HAPAs within each culture system and reared for 60 days. Growth, feed-utilization indices, water-quality parameters, primary productivity and sediment characteristics were monitored throughout the culture period. Body weight increased progressively in all systems, with significantly higher final weight in MP2 (27.01±0.34 g) than in MP1 (25.83±0.30 g) and OSC (23.22±0.11 g). MP2 recorded the highest weight gain, specific growth rate, feed conversion efficiency and protein efficiency ratio, while feed conversion ratio was lowest. Water-quality and productivity characteristics differed significantly among systems and sampling periods, with MP2 showing higher gross and net primary productivity and chlorophyll-a. Sediment characteristics also differed significantly with MP2 recording higher organic carbon, organic matter, total nitrogen and carbon stock. The findings highlight IMAS as a promising production-with-ecological-conservation approach enhancing aquaculture performance while retaining mangrove-based ecosystem functions, thereby supporting environmentally responsible seafood production and progress towards the SDGs.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较了开放海域网箱（OSC）与两种红树林综合养殖系统（MP1、MP2）养殖尖吻鲈（Lates calcarifer）的生长性能、饲料利用、水质、初级生产力和沉积物特征，养殖密度10尾/m³，周期60天。MP2终末体重（27.01 g）显著高于MP1（25.83 g）和OSC（23.22 g），且增重、特定生长率、饲料转化效率和蛋白质效率比最高、饲料转化率最低。MP2的总初级生产力、净初级生产力和叶绿素a较高，沉积物有机碳、有机质、总氮及碳储量也较高。结果表明IMAS可在维持红树林生态系统功能的同时提升养殖表现，是一种兼顾生产与生态保护的有前景模式。

papers.title: Photovoltaic Shading Alters Water Quality and Sustains Diatom-Dominated Microbial Communities in Shrimp–Crab Aquaculture Ponds
papers.authors: Dongping, Zhang; Shaolei, Cai; Junhao, Zhang; Dongsheng, Chen; Ramzan, Muhammad Naeem; Raza, Bilal; Encai, Bao
papers.abstract: Fishery–photovoltaic systems are expanding rapidly in coastal China, yet their effects on pond water quality and microbial communities remain poorly understood. We compared three PV-shaded and three unshaded (NPV) earthen ponds co-culturing Pacific white shrimp (Litopenaeus vannamei) and mud crab (Scylla paramamosain) in August and September 2025. Water quality measurements and 16S and 18S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing were conducted on 60 samples. PV ponds had lower temperature (28.9 vs. 31.2 °C), turbidity (31.6 vs. 40.9 NTU), dissolved oxygen (5.76 vs. 6.91 mg L−1), and ammonium, nitrite, phosphate, total nitrogen and total phosphorus concentrations. Shading explained 8.0% and 10.4% of bacterial and eukaryotic community variation respectively, while alpha diversity remained largely unchanged. Diatom relative abundance was higher under shading (46.2% vs. 26.7%), whereas dinoflagellate abundance was lower. From August to September, NPV communities shifted from diatom to ciliate dominance, with ciliate abundance increasing from 2.1% to 45.4% and Vibrio from 0.6% to 9.8%. In contrast, diatom abundance remained stable and Vibrio remained below 2.5% in PV ponds. Shaded communities exhibited lower dispersion and broader niche breadth, although assembly processes did not differ between treatments. Cross-kingdom networks contained fewer bacteria–eukaryote associations under shading, but cohesion and resampled network topology remained comparable. Overall, PV shading was associated with cooler, less nutrient-rich water and persistent diatom dominance; however, reduced dissolved oxygen highlights the importance of aeration management in fishery–PV systems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较了光伏遮荫与无遮荫的虾蟹混养塘（Litopenaeus vannamei 与 Scylla paramamosain）在2025年8—9月的水质及微生物群落差异，基于60份样品的16S/18S rRNA基因扩增子测序。光伏塘水温、浊度、溶解氧及铵盐、亚硝酸盐、磷酸盐、总氮、总磷均较低，遮荫分别解释细菌和真核群落变异的8.0%和10.4%，α多样性基本不变。遮荫下硅藻相对丰度较高（46.2% vs. 26.7%），甲藻较低；无遮荫塘群落由硅藻转向纤毛虫优势（2.1%→45.4%），Vibrio由0.6%升至9.8%，而光伏塘硅藻稳定、Vibrio低于2.5%。遮荫群落离散度更低、生态位更宽，跨界网络细菌—真核关联较少但凝聚力相当；溶解氧降低提示 fishery–PV 系统需重视增氧管理。

papers.title: Effects of Fish-derived Liquid Fertilizer on Growth of Wolffia globosa during the Monsoon Season
papers.authors: Jaroenchai, Chutinan
papers.abstract: Introduction Wolffia globosa has been considered a functional food formulation due to its excellent nutritional value and rapid growth. Organic liquid fertilizer from fish (OLF) has been used as a source of nutrients for plant growth. However, there is limited information regarding the use of OLF for the cultivation of W. globosa . This research aimed to cultivate W. globosa using OLF during the monsoon season. Methods Two outdoor experiments were conducted during the monsoon of 2025. Experiment 1 comprised eight treatments of OLF, being 0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0, and 3.5 mL/L. The plant was grown on rainwater in 11-L plastic containers covered with 50% black shade cloth and harvested at 11 days. Experiment 2 resembled the cultivation system in small-scale farms and comprised three treatments: 1.5, 2.5, and 3.5 mL/L, with OLF added during the experiment. OLF was made from fish waste collected from a local supermarket. The plant was grown on tap water in open 1.2-m diameter cement ponds. Biomass (g) was monitored every five days for 30 days. Daily rainfall was collected during the two experiments. Results Biomass gain was lower in Experiment 1 (1.8-2.4 times the starting mass) than in Experiment 2 (2.6-4.1 times the starting mass). Biomass was greater at higher rates of OLF in both experiments, although differences were not always statistically significant;biomass per unit area (g/m 2 ), average daily biomass gain (g/day), and daily productivity (g/m 2 /day) were greater at higher rates in Experiment 2. Biomass per unit area exceeded 2 kg/m 2 in treatment 3.5 mL/L after 30 days. In the three treatments, average daily biomass gain was the highest at 15 days (48.85-66.76 g/day), while daily productivity was the highest at five days (89.08-105.77 g/m 2 /day). Discussion OLF as high as 3.5 mL/L could fertilize W. globosa under the conditions of this study. Conclusion It is practical to cultivate W. globosa using OLF without changing media for a 30-day period. However, farmers may harvest the plant at 15 days, as average daily biomass gain reached a peak, and then restart the whole process of cultivation with the new media.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估鱼源有机液体肥料（OLF）在季风季节培养浮萍Wolffia globosa的效果，通过两个户外实验（容器实验设0–3.5 mL/L共8个浓度，水泥池实验设1.5、2.5、3.5 mL/L）监测生物量变化。结果表明，生物量随OLF浓度升高而增加，水泥池实验中3.5 mL/L处理30天后单位面积生物量超过2 kg/m²，平均日增重在第15天达峰（48.85–66.76 g/day），日生产力在第5天最高（89.08–105.77 g/m²/day）。作者认为3.5 mL/L OLF可在不换水条件下培养W. globosa达30天，但建议农户在第15天日增重达峰时收获并重新开始培养。

papers.title: A species distribution model integrating at-sea behaviour, phenology, and population size to inform marine risk exposure for a threatened seabird during breeding
papers.authors: Hedd, April; Studholme, Katharine R.; McFarlane Tranquilla, Laura A.; Cunningham, Joshua T.; Robertson, Gregory J.; Collins, Sydney M.; Fifield, David A.; Gjerdrum, Carina; Hoeg, Rielle; Jones, Patricia L.
papers.abstract: Seabirds face myriad threats on land and at sea resulting in widespread population declines. Predictive species distribution models (SDMs) provide a powerful tool to estimate numbers of birds exposed to risks, and to attribute them to source populations. The Atlantic population of Leach’s Storm-petrel ( Hydrobates leucorhous ) has declined rapidly in recent decades; however, information on their exposure to threats at sea is lacking. We address this knowledge gap for the breeding period using a multi-year GPS tracking dataset ( n = 451 birds, 2016-2023) collected from six colonies which together comprise &gt; 90% of the Atlantic population. As threat exposure can differ according to behaviour, we used a Hidden Markov Model (HMM) to classify behavioural states and define associated risk categories (primarily in-air or on-water). We also summarized results by time of day because attraction to, and disorientation from, artificial light at night (ALAN) poses risks to Leach’s Storm-petrels. We developed a dynamic SDM predicting monthly relative densities at sea (June-September), for the western North Atlantic regional population, accounting for all 16 colonies with &gt; 10,000 individuals. Reflecting geographic patterns in colony size, regional densities were highest east of Newfoundland in deepwater areas off the northern Grand Bank (Orphan Basin and Flemish Pass), and south of the Flemish Cap (Newfoundland Basin). At-sea densities increased through summer, being lowest in June when one parent is incubating, and highest in September when both parents forage at sea. Case studies indicated that relative to risks within Grand Bank oil and gas production areas, commencement of deepwater drilling in the Orphan Basin and Flemish Pass has substantially increased risks for Leach's Storm-petrels, because bird densities in these offshore areas are 2–4 times higher. Within our region, risks from ALAN were consistently estimated to be higher than risks from hypothetical oil spills. Though offshore facilities have been removed from the Scotian Shelf, ongoing bids for exploration licences suggest future risks for specific populations in Nova Scotia. We focused on oil and gas; however, our framework can be applied to other individual or cumulative risks to inform conservation planning for this threatened species.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用2016–2023年6个繁殖群体（覆盖大西洋种群>90%）的451只GPS追踪数据，结合隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）划分Leach's Storm-petrel的行为状态（空中/水面）及风险类别，构建动态物种分布模型（SDM）预测西北大西洋区域种群6–9月的月度海上相对密度。结果显示，区域密度以纽芬兰以东深水区最高（Orphan Basin、Flemish Pass及Flemish Cap以南），且随夏季推进而升高（6月最低、9月最高）。案例评估表明，Orphan Basin和Flemish Pass深水钻探的启动显著增加了该物种的风险暴露（该区域鸟类密度为Grand Bank油气区的2–4倍），而人工光害（ALAN）风险始终高于假想溢油风险。该框架可推广至其他单一或累积风险评估，为受胁物种保护规划提供依据。

papers.title: Genomic changes revealed by repeated sampling of kelp exposed to an extreme marine heatwave
papers.authors: Edgeloe, Jane M.; Wernberg, Thomas; Starko, Samuel; Wood, Georgina V.; Minne, Antoine J. P.; Vranken, Sofie; Wheeler, David; Batley, Jacqueline; Coleman, Melinda A.
papers.abstract: Abstract Extreme climatic events are increasingly recognised as potent evolutionary forces, imposing sudden pressures on natural populations. Among these, marine heatwaves (MHWs) are major drivers of ecological change, causing mass mortality, range shifts, and community reorganisation, particularly in habitat-forming kelps. While their ecological impacts are well documented, the genomic consequences remain less clear. Specifically, MHWs can not only induce demographic bottlenecks but also potentially drive selection on loci associated with thermal tolerance, shifting allele frequencies in affected populations. Here, we leveraged historical samples to investigate temporal genetic changes in the kelp Ecklonia radiata (order Laminariales) at three locations in Western Australia over 16 years, spanning the severe 2011 MHW. Overall genetic diversity and composition remained largely stable before (2006, 2008) and after (2012, 2018, 2022) the event, likely reflecting population resilience. However, a subset of loci, including known temperature-associated loci, showed shifts in allele frequencies following the event. Moreover, the strongest and most numerous changes occurred at warmer, lower-latitude sites where ecological impacts of the MHW were greatest, potentially consistent with MHW-driven natural selection. These results demonstrate that MHWs, while not dramatically altering genome-wide diversity, may alter allele frequences at specific loci linked to thermal response, highlighting their role as episodic yet powerful drivers of evolutionary change in marine foundation species.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用历史样本，对西澳三个地点的巨藻 *Ecklonia radiata* 在2011年极端海洋热浪（MHW）前后16年间的时序遗传变化进行分析。结果显示整体遗传多样性与组成在事件前后基本稳定，反映种群韧性；但部分位点（包括已知温度相关位点）的等位基因频率发生偏移。变化最强且数量最多的位点出现在热浪生态影响最大的低纬度暖水站点，可能与MHW驱动的自然选择一致。研究表明MHW虽未显著改变全基因组多样性，但可改变热响应相关特定位点的等位基因频率，是海洋基础物种 episodic 进化变化的重要驱动力。

papers.title: Validation of a lateral flow assay for the qualitative detection of okadaic acid-group toxins in shellfish
papers.authors: Khan, Daud H; Turner, Andrew D; Alexander, Ryan P; Page, Shamina; Dean, Karl J; Saebi, Rozhin; Baig, Maarij; Safavieh, Hosseinali
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Okadaic acid (OA)-group toxins, including OA, dinophysistoxin-1 (DTX1), DTX2, and their acyl esters, cause diarrhetic shellfish poisoning. Regulatory monitoring commonly relies on LC-MS/MS, which is accurate but resource-intensive, creating a need for validated rapid screening methods. Objective To evaluate the Sensoreal DSP Alert™ lateral flow assay (LFA) for qualitative determination of OA-group toxins in bivalve mollusks through single-laboratory validation based on AOAC International and Interstate Shellfish Sanitation Conference guidance. Methods The assay was evaluated for probability of detection, sensitivity, false-positive and false-negative rates, ruggedness, and selectivity using mussel and oyster samples across defined toxin concentrations. Naturally contaminated mussels, oysters, scallops, clams, cockles, and razor clams from multiple regions were tested in parallel by LFA and LC-MS/MS. Performance across OA/DTX profiles and semi-quantitative Low/Medium/High interpretation using SensoRead™ test-to-control ratios were also assessed. Results At 135 µg OA eq/kg threshold (which is 84% of the regulatory limit of 160 µg OA eq/kg), the LFA achieved sensitivity of 1.000, specificity of 0.959, overall agreement of 0.975, and Cohen’s kappa of 0.950 in validation samples, with no false negatives. Ruggedness was unaffected by variations in kit lots, reagents, analysts, temperature, incubation time, or testing day. No interference was observed from domoic acid, paralytic shellfish toxins, azaspiracids, microcystins, or tetrodotoxin. Among 180 naturally contaminated samples, sensitivity was 1.000, specificity 0.944, overall agreement 0.972, and kappa 0.944. Performance was not affected by OA/DTX profile variation, and scanner classifications provided useful secondary interpretive information. Conclusion The Sensoreal DSP Alert™ LFA is a robust, sensitive, and user-friendly screening method for qualitative determination of OA-group toxins in bivalve mollusk shellfish. The assay demonstrated excellent agreement with the LC-MS/MS reference method, no false-negative results at the selected decision threshold, reliable ruggedness, and strong selectivity. The scanner-based Low/Medium/High classification provides additional practical value for shellfish hazard management and end-product testing.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在对Sensoreal DSP Alert™侧向层析检测法（LFA）进行单实验室验证，以定性检测双壳贝类中OA组毒素（包括OA、DTX1、DTX2及其酰基酯），验证依据AOAC International和ISSC指南，并以LC-MS/MS为参比方法。验证样品在135 µg OA eq/kg阈值下敏感性为1.000、特异性0.959、总体一致率0.975、Cohen's kappa为0.950，无假阴性；180份自然污染样品（贻贝、牡蛎、扇贝、蛤、鸟蛤和蛏）中敏感性1.000、特异性0.944、一致率0.972。该方法不受试剂批次、分析人员、温度、孵育时间等因素影响，对软骨藻酸、PSP毒素、氮杂螺环酸、微囊藻毒素及河豚毒素无交叉干扰，且OA/DTX谱型变化不影响性能。Sensoreal DSP Alert™ LFA是一种稳健、灵敏、易用的OA组毒素快速筛查工具，其扫描仪Low/Medium/High半定量分类可为贝类危害管理和终产品检测提供实用参考。

papers.title: Linking reproduction and recruitment: Identifying demographic bottlenecks limiting the spread of Bighead Carp and Silver Carp in the Ohio River
papers.authors: Shepta, Erin; Arantes, Caroline C; Rota, Christopher T; Herod, Jeffrey; Weihe, Maris; Hiller, Rebecca A; Murry, Brent A
papers.journal: Transactions of the American Fisheries Society
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective Reproduction and recruitment represent distinct demographic processes that may independently limit establishment and spread of an invasive species. We evaluated reproduction and recruitment success of Bighead Carp Hypophthalmichthys nobilis and Silver Carp H. molitrix in the Ohio River basin across multiple spatial and temporal scales to identify potential demographic bottlenecks. Methods We assessed detection/nondetection data on Bighead Carp and Silver Carp eggs/larvae and young of the year (age 0) to provide information on these species’ reproduction and recruitment, respectively. Data were assessed at reach-level (i.e., pool) and site-level spatial scales and at annual and intra-annual temporal scales throughout the Ohio River basin, relating patterns of egg/larval and young-of-the-year occurrence to adult relative abundance, hydrologic conditions, and nursery habitat availability. Results Estimated occurrence of Bighead Carp eggs/larvae and young of the year was inconsistent throughout the study area, suggesting limited establishment success in the Ohio River. Silver Carp egg/larval persistence probability was primarily associated with adult densities rather than variation in flow or temperature, and eggs were estimated to occur across a large portion of the basin. However, Silver Carp young-of-the-year occurrence appeared to be spatially restricted. Annual pool and intra-annual site young-of-the-year persistence probability was correlated with the availability of nursery habitat at both scales. Young of the year were consistently detected at only one location, a floodplain lake (Hovey Lake) in the John T. Myers pool, indicating the presence of a potential localized source population in this location. Conclusions Silver Carp eggs/larvae were detected across much of the invaded portion of the Ohio River, suggesting that reproduction is widespread. However, young-of-the-year occurrence was most strongly associated with nursery habitat. In the Ohio River, the lack of widespread nursery habitat may be limiting the recruitment success of young-of-the-year Silver Carp into the population, potentially creating a demographic bottleneck that constrains their spread in this basin.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了俄亥俄河流域鳙（Bighead Carp）和鲢（Silver Carp）在不同时空尺度上的繁殖与补充过程，以识别限制其定殖和扩散的种群瓶颈。通过分析鱼卵/仔鱼及当年幼鱼（age 0）的检出数据，并结合成鱼相对丰度、水文条件和育幼栖息地可得性，发现鲢的鱼卵/仔鱼在流域大部分区域均有分布，表明繁殖广泛；但当年幼鱼的出现主要与育幼栖息地（nursery habitat）可得性相关，且仅在一处洪泛平原湖泊（Hovey Lake）持续检出。结果表明，俄亥俄河育幼栖息地的匮乏可能构成recruitment瓶颈，限制了鲢当年幼鱼的成功补充及种群扩散。

papers.title: Paracoccus marcusii IHA034 Protects Larimichthys polyactis Against Oxidized Fish Oil and H2O2-Induced Intestinal Injury: Divergent Keap-1/Nrf2 Responses In Vivo and In Vitro
papers.authors: Zhang, Yu; Hu, Haoyang; Zhang, Yang; Liang, Xiao; Lou, Bao
papers.abstract: Paracoccus marcusii is an astaxanthin-synthesizing bacterium with antioxidant potential, but its mechanisms mitigating intestinal oxidative injury in fish remain unclear. Herein, we explored the protective function of P. marcusii IHA034 (CGMCC No. 25301) in juvenile Larimichthys polyactis, combining an in vivo oxidized-fish-oil challenge model and an in vitro H2O2-stimulated primary intestinal cell model. A 51-day feeding trial showed that 1.0 g/kg dietary P. marcusii supplementation improved growth performance, enhanced intestinal antioxidant enzyme activities, and restored epithelial ultrastructural damage. A strikingly high relative abundance of Paracoccus (90.50%) was detected in the gut digesta of the PM1.0 group, accompanied by reduced microbial α-diversity. In vivo intestinal transcriptomics and qPCR showed downregulated nrf2 mRNA, alongside activated complement and anti-apoptotic responses. However, P. marcusii pigment-rich crude extracts activated the Keap-1/Nrf2 pathway and rescued H2O2-induced cell injury in vitro. These findings demonstrate multi-modal protective effects of P. marcusii IHA034 and uncover contrasting Keap-1/Nrf2 regulatory patterns between in vivo intestinal tissue and in vitro cell models, providing mechanistic support for the application of this astaxanthin-producing bacterial resource in aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探究了合成虾青素的细菌 Paracoccus marcusii IHA034 对幼鱼 Larimichthys polyactis 肠道氧化损伤的保护作用，采用体内氧化鱼油胁迫模型与体外 H2O2 刺激原代肠道细胞模型相结合的方法。51天投喂试验表明，1.0 g/kg 日粮添加该菌可改善生长性能、增强肠道抗氧化酶活性并修复上皮超微结构损伤，同时肠道内容物中 Paracoccus 相对丰度高达90.50%，微生物 α 多样性下降。体内肠道转录组和 qPCR 显示 nrf2 mRNA 下调，伴补体激活和抗凋亡反应；而体外富含色素的粗提物则激活 Keap-1/Nrf2 通路并缓解 H2O2 诱导的细胞损伤。结果揭示了该菌的多模式保护效应及体内外 Keap-1/Nrf2 调控模式的差异，为产虾青素细菌在水产养殖中的应用提供机制依据。

papers.title: Beyond total arsenic: rethinking seafood-related arsenic risk assessments
papers.authors: Hauser-Davis, Rachel Ann; Maciel, Oswaldo Luiz de C.
papers.abstract: Seafood is an important component of human nutrition worldwide but also represents a major dietary pathway of arsenic (As) exposure. Assessing seafood-related health risks remains challenging because As toxicity depends strongly on chemical speciation rather than total concentration alone. Although seafood often contains high total arsenic (tAs), most occurs as organic compounds such as arsenobetaine, generally regarded as low in toxicity and rapidly excreted in humans. In contrast, inorganic arsenic (iAs), primarily arsenite [As(III)] and arsenate [As(V)], is highly toxic and carcinogenic. Emerging evidence further challenges the traditional assumption that organic arsenicals are uniformly harmless, as methylated intermediates have demonstrated cytotoxic and genotoxic properties, and some arsenolipid subclasses, particularly arsenic-containing hydrocarbons, have demonstrated cytotoxicity. Despite the importance of As speciation assessments, routine species-specific analysis remains limited in seafood monitoring due to the limited availability of validated methods and certified reference materials, as well as relatively high operational costs, and limited laboratory accessibility. Consequently, many exposure assessments rely on tAs concentrations and generalized assumptions regarding iAs fractions, despite substantial variability among seafood taxa, habitats, and geographic regions. Human exposure assessments are further complicated by marked differences in seafood consumption patterns and demographic susceptibility, with coastal and fishing-dependent communities often experiencing substantially greater dietary exposure than population averages suggest. This review synthesizes current knowledge on As occurrence and speciation in seafood, analytical approaches, toxicological implications of different arsenic species, and human exposure and risk assessment frameworks, including Estimated Daily Intake (EDI), Estimated Weekly Intake (EWI), Target Hazard Quotient (THQ), Hazard Index (HI), and Target Cancer Risk (TCR). Particular emphasis is placed on taxonomic variability in iAs occurrence, localized seafood consumption, demographic heterogeneity, and emerging toxicological evidence. Collectively, the evidence supports a transition from tAs-based screening toward more realistic, speciation-informed and context-dependent seafood risk assessment.
papers.summary_cn: 海产品砷（As）健康风险评估因砷毒性高度依赖化学形态而非总浓度而面临挑战：海产品总砷（tAs）虽高，但多以低毒、易排泄的砷甜菜碱等有机形态存在，而无机砷（iAs）毒性强且致癌；新证据还显示部分甲基化中间体及砷脂类（尤其含砷烃类）具细胞毒性，挑战了有机砷一律无害的传统假设。受限于经验证方法、标准参考物质、成本及实验室可及性，海产品监测中常规形态分析仍有限，许多暴露评估依赖tAs浓度及对iAs比例的笼统假设，而iAs占比在海产品类群、生境和区域间差异显著。人类暴露评估还受消费模式与人群易感性差异影响，沿海及依赖渔业社区的实际膳食暴露常远高于人群平均值。本综述整合海产品砷赋存与形态、分析方法、各砷形态毒理学意义及人类暴露与风险评估框架（EDI、EWI、THQ、HI、TCR），强调iAs赋存的分类学差异、地方化消费、人群异质性与新兴毒理学证据，支持从基于tAs的筛查转向更贴近实际、基于形态且依赖情境的海产品风险评估。

papers.title: Why might corals settle on Lithophyllum prototypum? A hypothesis linking non-geniculate coralline algal architecture to coral recruitment
papers.authors: Carvalho, Rodrigo T.; Bahia, Ricardo G.; Moraes, Fernando C.; Santos, Jacques A.; Salgado, Leonardo T.; Pereira, Renato C.
papers.abstract: Coral recruitment depends on the ability of larvae to identify suitable benthic substrates, and non-geniculate coralline algae are among the most important natural facilitators of this process. Within this group, members of the Lithophyllum prototypum complex are repeatedly associated with high coral settlement responses, but the mechanisms underlying this effect remain incompletely understood. Most explanations have emphasized chemical and microbial cues, whereas the distinctive surface architecture of this morphotype has received little ecological attention. Here, we characterize the applanate surface architecture of the Lithophyllum prototypum complex using scanning electron microscopy and quantitative morphometry. Repeated thallus superimposition generates applanate branches, characterized by overlapping lamellae, elevated margins, narrow crevices and interstitial spaces distributed across the algal surface. The mean spacing between adjacent applanate branches was 533 ± 213 µm, while overhanging lamellar margins formed shallow cavities averaging 29.1 ± 5.6 µm in height. These dimensions suggest that the surface of this morphotype produces larval-scale microhabitats rather than deep cryptic shelters. We hypothesize that this architecture may enhance coral settlement by increasing contact opportunities, promoting larval retention and modulating the local expression of chemical and microbial cues. This physical–chemical–microbial microhabitat hypothesis provides a testable framework for re-evaluating how NGCA morphology contributes to coral recruitment.
papers.summary_cn: 研究旨在探究非膝状珊瑚藻Lithophyllum prototypum复合群促进珊瑚幼体附着的机制，弥补以往仅强调化学与微生物线索而忽视表面形态的不足。采用扫描电镜与定量形态计量学表征其扁平表面结构，发现相邻扁平分枝平均间距533±213 µm，悬垂片层边缘形成平均高29.1±5.6 µm的浅腔，属幼体尺度微生境而非深隐庇护所。据此提出物理–化学–微生物微生境假说，认为该结构通过增加接触机会、促进幼体滞留并调节局部化学与微生物线索表达来增强珊瑚附着，为重新评估NGCA形态对珊瑚补充的贡献提供可检验框架。

papers.title: Size-based food web structure in contrasting eddy ecosystems
papers.authors: Kwong, Lian E.; Garside, Peter; Everett, Jason D.; Schilling, Hayden T.; Mazumder, Debashish; Henschke, Natasha; Kas, Lucas; Stewart, Andrew L.; Jeffs, Andrew; Miskiewicz, Tony

papers.title: The influence of accountability on procurement performance: a case study ministry of blue economy and fisheries Zanzibar
papers.authors: Manzi, Abdillah; Sama, Hamisi
papers.abstract: Accountability is a foundational pillar of procurement governance, yet quantitative evidence on how accountability mechanisms specifically shape procurement outcomes within individual government ministries in Zanzibar remains scarce. This study examined the influence of accountability on procurement performance at the Ministry of Blue Economy and Fisheries (MoBEF), Zanzibar. Guided by Institutional Theory and attached in a positivist research philosophy, study adopted a descriptive and explanatory quantitative design where a structured, five-point Likert-scale questionnaire was administered to 85 respondents drawn from a target population of 108 procurement officers, tender board members, finance officers, user department representatives, internal auditors, and registered suppliers, selected through stratified random sampling using Yamane’s (1967) formula. Data were analyzed descriptively and inferentially using IBM SPSS version 23, incorporating reliability testing, correlation, and multiple linear regressions. Descriptive results revealed that accountability practices were generally well established at MoBEF, with mean scores ranging from 3.90 to 4.12. Review and approval procedures and documentation practices attracted the strongest endorsement, while disciplinary enforcement for procurement irregularities recorded both the lowest mean (M = 3.90) and the greatest variability (SD = 0.89), indicating a structural enforcement gap within the Ministry’s accountability system. Multiple regression analysis confirmed that accountability significantly and positively predicted procurement performance (β = 0.27, SE = 0.07, t = 3.57, p = .001), alongside fairness (β = 0.31, p < .001) and transparency (β = 0.29, p = .002); the overall model was statistically significant (F(3, 81) = 28.45, p < .001, R² = 0.520). The null hypothesis was rejected. These findings confirm that while formal accountability structures are well established within MoBEF, inconsistent disciplinary enforcement limits their full effect on procurement performance. The study recommends strengthening audit follow-through, enforcing consistent sanctions for non-compliance, and institutionalizing structured monitoring systems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以桑给巴尔蓝色经济与渔业部（MoBEF）为例，基于制度理论，采用描述性与解释性定量设计，通过问卷对85名采购相关人员调查，检验问责机制对采购绩效的影响。结果显示问责实践总体建立良好，但违规纪律执行得分最低且变异最大，存在结构性执行缺口。多元回归表明问责显著正向预测采购绩效（β=0.27, p=.001），公平性与透明度亦为显著预测因子（模型R²=0.520）。研究建议强化审计跟踪、统一违规惩戒并制度化监测体系。

papers.title: Influence of a thermohaline front on the trophic ecology of the small pelagic fish Lycengraulis grossidens (Clupeiformes: Engraulidae)
papers.authors: Marcilese, María Manuela; Parietti, Manuela; Temperoni, Brenda; Buratti, German Esteban; Buratti, Claudio César
papers.abstract: Abstract Lycengraulis grossidens is economically important for artisanal fisheries and prey of top predators in the Río de la Plata (RP) (SW Atlantic). In particular, Samborombón Bay (SB)—RAMSAR site and key marine summer feeding area for the species—is strongly affected by climate variability. Diet composition, feeding strategy and dietary shifts related to fish size and to an existing thermohaline front between two SB zones were determined in late austral summer (April). A high incidence of brackish/marine prey was hypothesized, varying ontogenetically and in relation with the front. Trophic incidence exceeded 90%. Neomysis americana (Mysidacea) dominated the diet, followed by decapod larvae, gastropods and teleosts. The feeding strategy was specialist at the population level for N. americana but generalist for other prey. Both nMDS and GLM analyses supported the hypothesis, as N. americana , copepods and gastropods were more consumed in North SB, while teleosts South SB, linked to the thermohaline front affecting prey distribution. Smaller individuals (<100 mm) consumed copepods and decapod larvae, whereas larger individuals (>150 mm) increasingly fed on N. americana and gastropods. Unlike previous studies reporting piscivory at larger sizes, SB specimens maintained a zooplankton‐based diet, with a strong preference for N. americana . Results highlight the species' trophic plasticity and the influence of environmental and ontogenetic factors. This study provides valuable new information on the trophic ecology of L. grossidens in marine waters after a gap of over 60 years, contributing to a better understanding of its trophic role in highly dynamic estuarine and coastal ecosystems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究分析了热盐锋对Samborombón湾小型中上层鱼类*Lycengraulis grossidens*摄食生态的影响，通过胃含物分析确定其食物组成、摄食策略及随鱼体大小和锋面位置的变化。结果显示该鱼种摄食发生率超过90%，以*Neomysis americana*为主，种群水平表现为专食性但整体为广食性；热盐锋通过影响猎物分布导致南北湾食物组成差异，且小型个体摄食桡足类和十足目幼体、大型个体更多摄食*N. americana*和腹足类。研究表明该鱼种在海洋环境中维持浮游动物食性并具有较强摄食可塑性，填补了60余年来其摄食生态的研究空白。

papers.title: Microbial contamination of fish production waste after processing in eco biocomposters
papers.authors: Khomenko, R. M.; Alexandrov, V. V.; Knysh, I. V.; Simeyko, A. V.
papers.abstract: Currently, the problem of processing various types of organic waste from agricultural and food production is becoming the most urgent, as they often have to be disposed of by paying for this service. At the same time, the cost of protein components of feed and, consequently, compound feeds is constantly increasing. In this regard, the development of new technologies and technical solutions for processing agricultural and food waste for possible use in animal feeding is becoming relevant. One of these technologies, which allows the production of animal feed products, is the biothermal processing of organic waste using special installations, for example, biothermal composters "ECO" produced by LLC Radian Proekt and JSC PK ECO. Technological solutions used in ECO biocomposters have made it possible to create a fully autonomous machine for the disposal of food and organic waste of various volumes. The article presents the results of a chemical analysis of the resulting compost after processing fish waste (adult rainbow trout) for compliance with certain qualitative indicators. In the conducted studies, it was found that the average mass of waste and bacteria (bio-mixture) loaded for processing at one time decreased by 16.1 times and amounted to 1,9 ± 0,2 kg, the moisture content was 1.9%, the mass fraction of water-soluble carbohydrates increased to 6,8%, the protein content increased to 10,5% compared with the initial product.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了生态生物堆肥机处理虹鳟成鱼加工废弃物后所得堆肥的化学与微生物质量，旨在探索鱼类加工废弃物的资源化利用途径。研究测定了堆肥前后物料质量、含水量、水溶性碳水化合物及蛋白质含量等指标。结果显示，单次处理物料（废弃物与菌剂混合物）平均质量降至1.9±0.2 kg（减少16.1倍），含水量为1.9%，水溶性碳水化合物升至6.8%，蛋白质含量升至10.5%。

papers.title: Long-Term Low- and Normal-Temperature Operation of Commercial Recirculating Aquaculture System Biofilters: Contrasting Microbial Communities and Predicted Nitrogen-Cycling Profiles
papers.authors: Jiang, Wenwen; Fu, Qi; Liu, Tingting; Li, Li; Wang, Guodong; Guo, Enmian
papers.abstract: Microorganisms in biofilters are essential to recirculating aquaculture systems (RASs). Low temperature is an important environmental stress influencing the performance of the biofilter in RASs. However, how the microorganisms in the biofilters respond to low temperature remains unclear. In this study, we compared the microbial communities of two commercial RAS biofilters operating under low- and normal-temperature regimes across four seasons. Both biofilters generally kept low ammonia and nitrite concentrations, although the low-temperature biofilter exhibited higher nitrite levels overall with a more pronounced seasonal increase. The low-temperature biofilter also exhibited lower bacterial diversity, fewer detected taxa, and substantial shifts in community composition. The microbial communities were strongly associated with TOC, alkalinity, and inorganic nitrogen. Its co-occurrence network was smaller and more centralized, with greater clustering and shorter average path lengths, indicating highly concentrated microbial associations. Predicted nitrogen-cycle profiles also differed between the two biofilters. The predicted nitrification profile did not differ significantly, whereas the predicted denitrification profile was lower in the low-temperature biofilter. These findings indicate that the two commercial systems harbored distinctly different microbial communities, reflecting differences in specific processes. Collectively, mature RAS biofilters sustained ammonia and nitrite removal despite substantial community simplification, whereas individual predicted nitrogen-cycling processes exhibited distinct predicted patterns under the two operating regimes.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较了两套商业RAS生物滤器在低温与常温运行下四个季节的微生物群落差异。低温滤器亚硝酸盐水平更高且季节波动更明显，细菌多样性较低、检出类群更少，群落组成变化显著，并与TOC、碱度和无机氮密切相关；其共现网络更小、更集中。预测氮循环中硝化谱无显著差异，但低温滤器反硝化谱较低。结果表明成熟RAS生物滤器在群落显著简化的条件下仍能维持氨和亚硝酸盐去除，但各氮循环过程在两种运行模式下呈现不同预测格局。

papers.title: Labeling and accounting of salmon species aquaculture facilities in cage farming in the context of modern regulatory and legal regulation in the Russian Federation and integration into veterinary information systems
papers.authors: Akimova, N. S.; Markov, T. I.
papers.abstract: The article is devoted to the analysis of the current state of the system of labeling and accounting of salmon aquaculture facilities in cage farming. The regulatory framework for regulating this area in the Russian Federation is being considered, including Federal Law No. 148-FZ "On Aquaculture (Fish Farming)", Decree of the Government of the Russian Federation No. 550 "On Approval of the List of Animal Species Subject to Labeling and Accounting" and EAEU Technical Regulation 040/2016 "On the Safety of Fish and Fish Products". The practical aspects of the introduction of fish identification systems using group and individual labeling methods, the specifics of the use of product traceability technologies are analyzed. The key problems of the existing accounting system have been identified, from the technological difficulties of installing microchips to insufficient integration of information systems. The necessity of modernizing labeling approaches is substantiated, taking into account the biological characteristics of salmon and the technological conditions of cage cultivation. The directions of improving the regulatory framework and practical accounting mechanisms for aquaculture facilities are proposed.
papers.summary_cn: 该文分析俄罗斯网箱养殖鲑科鱼类设施的标签与追溯体系现状，梳理了联邦法律第148-FZ号、政府令第550号及EAEU技术法规040/2016等监管框架。研究评估了群体与个体标记方法及产品追溯技术的实践应用，识别出从微芯片植入的技术难点到信息系统整合不足等关键问题。文章论证了结合鲑鱼生物学特性与网箱养殖技术条件现代化标签方法的必要性，并提出完善法规框架与核算机制的方向。

papers.title: Deep-Learning-Assisted Discovery of Marine Antimicrobial Peptides: A Roadmap Integrating Omics Mining, Structure-Guided Diffusion Design, and Sustainable Aquaculture Translation
papers.authors: Liu, Bo; Liu, Hanjing; Jia, Yunna; He, Jie; Wang, Ye; Jiang, Haiyan; Xue, Zhiyang; Guo, Shuqi; Zhu, Yuanquan; Kong, Lingcong
papers.abstract: Antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) offer diverse antibacterial mechanisms, but candidate generation alone does not resolve the linked demands of potency, host safety, stability, manufacturability, and application-specific exposure. This review presents a roadmap that integrates two complementary computational routes for marine AMP discovery. De novo generation expands sequence space, whereas omics mining preserves biological provenance and enables recovery of encoded or encrypted peptides from marine organisms and microbiomes. Structure-guided diffusion is positioned as a selective third route when a defined target, motif, or stable structural template is available, rather than as a universal replacement for sequence-based AMP models. We further examine aquaculture as a translational setting in which efficacy must be evaluated together with salt and feed tolerance, environmental fate, tissue residues, resistance risk, and export-related requirements. Current evidence remains limited at the direct intersection of marine provenance and deep learning, particularly for target-conditioned structural design. We therefore propose an evidence-based workflow that links marine sequence resources, model selection, matched experimental validation, and application-specific deployment. This framework is intended to move marine AMP research from candidate prediction toward reproducible and testable translation.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述提出整合组学挖掘与深度学习生成的海源抗菌肽（AMP）发现路线图：de novo生成扩展序列空间，omics mining保留生物来源并回收编码/加密肽，结构引导扩散仅在明确靶标或结构模板时作为选择性第三条路线。水产养殖被作为转化场景，需同时评估盐度与饲料耐受性、环境归趋、组织残留及耐药风险。当前海源来源与深度学习直接交叉的证据有限，作者据此提出连接海洋序列资源、模型选择、匹配实验验证与应用部署的循证工作流。

papers.title: Recombinase Polymerase Amplification Combined With the Programmable Nuclease Pf Ago for Rapid Detection of Perkinsus olseni in Shellfish
papers.authors: Wang, Pei; Qin, Yuxin; Huang, Yidan; Ren, Yuxuan; Lin, Yan; Wu, Huiling; Zhu, Huabiao; Ding, Hong; Li, Yanan; Gao, Song
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Perkinsus olseni is a major pathogenic parasite that threatens shellfish aquaculture and can trigger mass mortality and considerable economic losses. Conventional culture‐based assays and PCR‐based detection protocols for P. olseni recommended by the World Organization for Animal Health (OIE) involve long assay durations and heavy dependence on sophisticated instruments, making them unsuitable for on‐site rapid screening. To establish a simple, rapid and highly sensitive detection method for early warning of P. olseni at aquaculture sites, this study integrated isothermal recombinase polymerase amplification (RPA) with the specific‐recognition capacity of Pf Ago nuclease to construct an RPA‐ Pf Ago detection assay. The assay achieved favourable specificity with a limit of detection as low as 30 copies. Its practical applicability was validated using 55 real‐world shellfish samples. Performing at constant temperatures, the RPA‐ Pf Ago detection assay features a simple procedure and short turnaround time, effectively addressing the drawbacks of conventional detection approaches. This assay is suitable for shellfish seed quarantine and routine pathogen surveillance in shellfish farms, and provides solid support for the early prevention and control of perkinsosis caused by P. olseni .
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对威胁贝类养殖的致病性寄生虫Perkinsus olseni，将等温重组酶聚合酶扩增（RPA）与Pf Ago核酸酶的特异性识别能力相结合，构建了RPA-Pf Ago快速检测方法。该方法特异性良好，检测限低至30拷贝，并经55份实际贝类样品验证了实用性。该检测在恒温下操作简便、周转时间短，适用于贝类苗种检疫和养殖场常规病原监测，为perkinsosis的早期防控提供支持。

papers.title: Energetic costs of catch and release angling in B rook T rout ( S alvelinus fontinalis ) at two temperatures
papers.authors: Hodgson, Ryan Y.; Holder, Peter E.; Nowell, Liane B.; Cooke, Steven J.; Brownscombe, Jacob W.
papers.abstract: Abstract Catch and release (C&R) angling is a common practice in recreational fisheries, which can involve a range of acute stressors for fish that lead to physiological and behavioural impairments. Following a C&R event, energy is expended to fuel recovery, while a cessation in feeding can limit energy intake. While the physiological and behavioural consequences of C&R have been extensively studied, the extent of the bioenergetic impacts has rarely been characterized. This study aimed to assess the energetic impacts of C&R stressors on Brook Trout ( Salvelinus fontinalis )—a cold‐water salmonid sensitive to temperature perturbations and air exposure. Adult Brook Trout were subjected to simulated angling events (i.e. 30s chase, 30s chase and 10s air exposure) or served as controls at 10°C and 15°C. Respirometry was used to measure energy expenditure through excess post‐exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), while a feeding experiment determined the time to return to feeding. Energy expenditure and reductions in energy consumption were incorporated into a bioenergetics model to predict growth outcomes following captures (i.e. 1, 3, 5) over 30 days. The stressors simulated here resulted in a maximum growth deviation of 4.1% (95% CI [2.8–6.5]) after a single capture and 21.0% (95% CI [14.6–33.4]) after five captures. Across temperatures, Brook Trout experienced higher peak metabolic rates at 15°C, but rapid recovery resulted in similar energetic costs of recovery to 10°C. However, our bioenergetic simulations revealed that prolonged (24 h) elevated daily temperature (15°C) occupancy raised metabolic energy expenditure negating the benefits of a faster resumption of feeding. Nevertheless, the moderate simulated C&R stressors tested here within the optimal temperature range of Brook Trout resulted in relatively small energetic consequences, even with numerous simulated captures. Future research should explore the bioenergetic effects of more intense (but still reasonably common) C&R stressors, including longer air exposure periods, hooking injuries and temperature extremes.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在量化模拟捕获放流（C&R）应激对溪红点鲑（Brook Trout, Salvelinus fontinalis）的能量学影响。成鱼在10°C和15°C下接受模拟钓捕处理（30秒追逐、30秒追逐+10秒暴露空气）或作为对照，通过呼吸测定法测定运动后过量耗氧（EPOC），并结合摄食恢复实验将能量消耗与摄食减少纳入生物能量学模型预测30天生长。结果显示，单次捕获后最大生长偏差为4.1%，五次捕获后达21.0%；15°C下峰值代谢率更高但恢复迅速，能量恢复成本与10°C相似，然而持续24小时处于15°C会因代谢能耗增加而抵消摄食恢复加快的收益。总体而言，在溪红点鲑适宜温度范围内，中等强度的C&R应激即使多次捕获也仅产生较小的能量学后果，未来需关注更强烈应激源（如长时间暴露空气、钩伤及极端温度）的影响。

papers.title: India and the WTO Fisheries Subsidies Agreement: The Unfinished Equity Question
papers.authors: Acharya, Kamlesh Kumar; Sirohi, Smita
papers.abstract: India formally accepted the World Trade Organization (WTO) Agreement on Fisheries Subsidies in July 2026, but this did not bring the negotiations to an end. The Agreement bans subsidies tied to illegal and unregulated fishing and overfished stocks, but broader subsidy rules contributing to overcapacity and overfishing remain unsettled. This article highlights India’s evolution from prioritizing the protection of small-scale and artisanal fisheries to currently challenging the use of aggregate subsidy levels for differentiation. Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) data from 2020 to 2022 indicate that while total support figures for OECD members and non-members appear similar, the average support per fisher significantly differs, at $5,722 for members and $283 for non-members. This comparison supports India’s argument, but environmental harm depends on subsidy type, fleet capacity, fishing location, stock condition and fisheries management rather than support per fisher alone. India’s acceptance endorses current agreements and raises concerns about equitable burden distribution for further regulations among countries with varied fishing sectors and historical subsidies. JEL Classification: F13, F53, Q22, Q28
papers.summary_cn: 印度于2026年7月正式接受WTO《渔业补贴协定》，但谈判并未终结：该协定禁止与IUU捕捞和过渔种群相关的补贴，而涉及产能过剩和过度捕捞的更广泛补贴规则仍未落定。文章梳理了印度从优先保护小规模和个体渔业，到当前质疑以补贴总量作为差异化依据的立场演变。OECD 2020–2022年数据显示，OECD成员与非成员的总支持额相近，但人均支持差距悬殊（成员5722美元，非成员283美元），这支持了印度的主张；然而环境损害取决于补贴类型、船队产能、作业区域、种群状况和渔业管理，而非仅人均支持水平。印度接受协定既认可现有安排，也凸显在不同渔业部门和历史补贴背景下公平分担进一步监管负担的关切。

papers.title: Floating Net Karamba Technology in Aquaculture Fisheries Business in Cirata Reservoir, Margalaksana Village, Cipeundeuy District, West Bandung Regency: A Case Study
papers.authors: Suryana, Asep Agus Handaka; Millatina, Nabilah Sani; Andriani, Yuli; Maulina, Ine
papers.journal: Asian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Research
papers.abstract: This study examines the application of Floating Net Karamba (KJA) technology in aquaculture in Cirata Reservoir, particularly in Margalaksana Village, Cipeundeuy District, West Bandung Regency. It focuses on KJA construction, water-quality conditions and cultivators' technological adaptations. The case study was conducted from August 2024 to April 2025 in three KJA blocks (Gandasoli, Cikuda and Cipicung) and involved 70 purposively selected respondents cultivating red tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) and common carp (Cyprinus carpio). Data were collected through observations, interviews and questionnaires, supported by secondary literature and documents, and analysed qualitatively. Water-quality measurements indicated that temperature (28.9–29.3°C) and pH (6.5–6.7) met the cited SNI standards, whereas dissolved oxygen (DO) concentrations (2.9–4.1 mg/L) raised concerns about potential stress and mortality. KJA construction was dominated by bamboo and iron frames, 200-litre plastic drum floats, polyethylene (PE) nets with mesh sizes of 1–1.5 inches, and inner and outer anchoring systems. Some cultivators used double netting to reduce fish escape, while others adopted aeration technology to improve DO availability. Aeration was reported to improve fish appetite and reduce mortality. Overall, aquaculture in Cirata Reservoir continues to face water-quality challenges, particularly concerning DO. Cultivators have responded by modifying KJA construction and selectively adopting aeration. These practices may support production while acknowledging the reservoir's carrying-capacity constraints.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究考察印尼Cirata水库Margalaksana村浮式网箱（KJA）养殖技术的应用，聚焦网箱结构、水质状况及养殖者的技术适应。案例调查于2024年8月至2025年4月在三个KJA区块开展，选取70户养殖红罗非鱼（Oreochromis niloticus）和鲤（Cyprinus carpio）的养殖户，通过观察、访谈和问卷收集数据并作定性分析。水质测定显示温度和pH符合SNI标准，但溶解氧（2.9–4.1 mg/L）偏低，存在应激和死亡风险。网箱以竹木和铁架为主，配200 L塑料桶浮体、1–1.5英寸聚乙烯（PE）网衣及内外锚固系统；部分养殖户采用双层网防逃，或加装增氧设备改善DO，增氧后鱼摄食改善、死亡率下降。总体而言，该水库养殖仍面临以DO为核心的水质挑战，养殖户通过改造网箱结构和选择性增氧加以应对，在承载能力约束下维持生产。

papers.title: Fish density estimation for smart marine aquaculture using a multi-granularity counting consistency network
papers.authors: Chen, Miao; Wu, Junfeng; Cheng, Shaojiang; Zheng, Saibei; Wu, Peihua; Sha, Yida; Zhou, Yizhi; Wang, Miao
papers.abstract: Abstract Fish density estimation is an important task in precision aquaculture, supporting feeding management, stocking regulation, and production monitoring. However, accurate estimation in aquaculture scenes remains challenging due to severe occlusion, lighting variation, water turbidity, and background interference. Existing fish density estimation methods mainly focus on image-level count accuracy or pixel-level density-map supervision but often lack explicit constraints on local count consistency, which may lead to inaccurate spatial distributions in dense scenes. Furthermore, features learned mainly from visual appearance are easily affected by complex visual backgrounds in aquaculture scenes. To address these issues, we propose MGCC-Net, a multi-granularity counting consistency network for fish density estimation in aquaculture scenes. MGCC-Net introduces two components: a multi-granularity local patch count loss to enforce local count consistency across multiple spatial scales and a dual-projection channel attention module that generates channel weights from two learned projections of the global visual descriptor and is jointly optimized with the density-estimation objective. We also construct AquaFish-Count, a real-world fish density dataset containing images from aquaculture and natural marine environments, organizing it into FD-High and FD-Low based on the annotated fish count in each image. Experimental results show that MGCC-Net achieves the best performance on FD-High and remains competitive on FD-Low, with its clearest advantage observed in dense scenes with severe fish overlap. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of MGCC-Net for fish density estimation and its potential application in marine biological environment perception and smart aquaculture monitoring systems.
papers.summary_cn: 针对养殖场景中遮挡、光照变化和水体浑浊等因素导致的鱼群密度估计难题，提出多粒度计数一致性网络MGCC-Net，通过多粒度局部块计数损失约束多空间尺度的局部计数一致性，并设计双投影通道注意力模块从全局视觉描述子的两个学习投影生成通道权重，与密度估计目标联合优化。同时构建包含养殖与自然海洋环境图像的真实鱼群密度数据集AquaFish-Count，并按标注鱼数划分为FD-High和FD-Low。实验表明MGCC-Net在FD-High上性能最优、在FD-Low上保持竞争力，在鱼体严重重叠的密集场景中优势最为明显，展示了其在smart aquaculture监测系统中的应用潜力。

papers.title: Proteomic signatures of vaccine-induced immunity in teleost fish: from antigen discovery to correlates of protection
papers.authors: Rao, Shreesha Sadashiva; Prasad, T. S. Keshava
papers.abstract: Fish-vaccine efficacy in teleosts is still established primarily through pathogen-challenge experiments, which determine whether a formulation protects but provide limited insight into the antigens and immune mechanisms responsible. Proteomics addresses part of this limitation by measuring pathogen proteins and host responses induced by vaccination. This critical narrative review evaluates pathogen-focused and host-response proteomics from antigen discovery through biomarker validation and translational decision-making. We assess quantitative mass spectrometry, immunoproteomics, surfaceome and secretome profiling, and their integration with reverse and systems vaccinology. Across the limited teleost evidence base, vaccination-associated changes involve complement and acute-phase pathways, antigen processing, redox regulation, hemostasis, tissue repair and exosome-associated antigen presentation. Cross-study replication remains weak, and the reported proteins largely represent study-specific vaccine-responsive profiles. More importantly, most studies do not test whether pre-challenge signatures predict subsequent survival, pathogen control or tissue protection. Within the literature reviewed here, no candidate proteomic signature has yet been prospectively replicated in an independent teleost vaccination cohort; therefore, none currently meets the requirements of a validated, transferable correlate of protection. The main obstacles include heterogeneous study designs, incomplete reference proteomes, teleost-specific protein-inference challenges, small cohorts, limited longitudinal sampling and scarce external validation. We argue that the principal bottleneck is now study design and validation rather than mass-spectrometric capability alone. We therefore outline a development sequence that begins with infection relevant antigen selection and proceeds through longitudinal profiling, targeted verification, predictive modeling, independent validation and field evaluation. This framework separates vaccine responsiveness, protection association, prediction and mechanism, using proteomics to support vaccine-development decisions while retaining challenge testing.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述评估了硬骨鱼疫苗免疫蛋白质组学研究，涵盖定量质谱、免疫蛋白质组学及表面/分泌蛋白质组分析，并整合反向疫苗学与系统疫苗学方法。现有有限证据显示，疫苗接种相关变化涉及补体与急性期通路、抗原加工、氧化还原调控、止血、组织修复及外泌体相关抗原呈递。但跨研究重复性弱，且多数研究未检验预攻毒特征能否预测存活或病原控制，目前尚无候选蛋白质组特征在独立硬骨鱼疫苗队列中前瞻性验证，因而缺乏可转化的保护相关标志物（correlate of protection）。作者认为主要瓶颈在于研究设计与验证而非质谱能力，并提出从抗原筛选到纵向分析、靶向验证、预测建模、独立验证及现场评估的开发路径。

papers.title: System Dynamics-Based Assessment of Climate Resilience among Milkfish Aquaculture Households in Sibulue District, Bone Regency
papers.authors: Riskiyani, Riskiyani; Normawati, Sitti; Zailan, Ahmad; Mualam, Al; Mas’ud, Rizka Maulidiyah
papers.abstract: Climate change increasingly threatens aquaculture livelihoods through extreme weather events, seasonal variability, and production uncertainty, potentially undermining household resilience and enterprise sustainability. This study aimed to assess aquaculture household resilience to climate change and evaluate alternative adaptation policies using a System Dynamics approach in Sibulue District, Bone Regency, Indonesia. A mixed-methods approach was employed involving 30 aquaculture households. Quantitative data were analyzed descriptively to construct resilience indicators, while qualitative findings were used to identify key factors and relationships influencing household resilience. These findings were integrated into a System Dynamics simulation model developed using Vensim to evaluate alternative policy scenarios. The overall household resilience index was 53.87, indicating a moderately resilient condition. The resilience perception index was 54.38, while the dependency resilience index reached 60.25 and was classified as resilient. The climate change adaptation and recovery adaptation indices were 47.08 and 53.75, respectively, both indicating moderately resilient conditions. Simulation results indicated that alternative policy scenarios generated different projected trajectories of household resilience and aquaculture enterprise sustainability under changing climatic conditions. These findings highlight the importance of integrated adaptation strategies combining financial support, government intervention, and technical adaptation measures to strengthen aquaculture household resilience and sustainability. However, the simulated outcomes represent model-based projections rather than empirically observed policy effects.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在评估印度尼西亚Bone县Sibulue区遮目鱼养殖户的气候变化韧性，并利用System Dynamics方法评价替代适应政策。研究采用混合方法调查30个养殖户，构建韧性指标并建立Vensim仿真模型。结果显示家庭整体韧性指数为53.87（中等韧性），气候适应与恢复适应指数分别为47.08和53.75。模拟表明，结合财政支持、政府干预和技术适应措施的综合策略有助于提升养殖户韧性与企业可持续性，但结果为模型预测而非实证政策效果。

papers.title: The potential for large-scale genome editing in finfish aquaculture via germline stem cell culture and transplantation
papers.authors: Raudstein, Mari; Datsomor, Alex Kojo; Stewart, Robert; McGrew, Mike; Fraslin, Clémence; Crespo, Diego; Kleppe, Lene
papers.abstract: Genome editing has emerged as a promising tool to complement selective breeding programmes and accelerate genetic gain in aquaculture. Although CRISPR-based genome editing has been successfully applied in several economically important fish species, its application at an industry-relevant scale remains challenging due to limitations of current delivery methods, which primarily rely on manual embryo microinjection. This approach is labour-intensive, technically demanding, and frequently results in high levels of mosaicism in founder individuals, necessitating additional generations of breeding to establish stable genotypes. In this mini review, we discuss the potential of combining germline stem cell (GSC) culture and transplantation approaches as an alternative platform for further improved genome editing in fish. By enabling genetic changes to be introduced, validated, and expanded in vitro prior to germline transmission, this approach has the potential to improve scalability, reduce mosaicism, and shorten breeding timelines. Although several technical challenges remain, continued progress in GSC culture and transplantation methodologies could facilitate the practical implementation of tailored genome editing for improved genetic gain, fish health, and welfare in aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 基因组编辑可补充选择育种并加速水产养殖遗传增益，但现有胚胎显微注射递送方式劳动密集、技术门槛高且常导致嵌合体，难以规模化应用。本文综述了生殖系干细胞（GSC）培养与移植相结合作为鱼类基因组编辑替代平台的潜力，该方法可在体外引入、验证和扩增遗传修饰后再进行生殖系传递。该策略有望提高可扩展性、降低嵌合率并缩短育种周期，但GSC培养与移植技术仍面临若干挑战。
