papers.title: Government Support for Small Scale Aquaculture
papers.authors: Dhall, Reeth
papers.abstract: Aquaculture policy must reconcile rising food demand with ecological limits and equitable livelihoods. This narrative review examines whether governments should prioritise small-scale producers when allocating public support. It draws on international production statistics, comparative environmental research, a Bangladesh producer study, evidence on rice–fish integration and Indian policy documents. The evidence supports targeted assistance where finance, information or shared infrastructure constrain viable small-scale production. It does not support treating farm size as a reliable proxy for sustainability. Commercial production can improve food access, while small farms can also contribute to pollution and disease risks. A policy framework is proposed that combines accessible extension services, shared facilities and carefully tested risk protection with environmental conditions applying across scales. Public programmes should be evaluated through additional gains in income, food access, and environmental performance, rather than output or expenditure alone.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述探讨政府在水产养殖公共支持分配中是否应优先小规模生产者，综合国际生产统计、环境比较研究、孟加拉国生产者调查、稻鱼共作证据及印度政策文件。证据支持在金融、信息或共享基础设施制约可行小规模生产时提供定向援助，但不支持将养殖规模作为可持续性的可靠代理指标。商业生产可改善食物获取，小农场同样可能带来污染与病害风险。作者提出结合推广服务、共享设施、经审慎测试的风险保护及跨规模环境条件的政策框架，并主张以收入、食物获取和环境绩效的增量收益而非产出或支出评估公共项目。

papers.title: Marine heatwave exposure is changing unevenly across Scottish aquaculture sites
papers.authors: Toledo-Jaime, Camila; Graham, Jennifer; Hudson, Ben; Moffat, David; Townhill, Bryony; Palmer, Steven
papers.abstract: Introduction Marine heatwaves (MHWs) are an increasing climate hazard for coastal aquaculture, yet regional assessments may not resolve how exposure varies across the locations where farms operate. Methods Here, we analysed daily ~5-km OSTIA sea surface temperature data from 1990 to 2025 at the locations of 361 active Scottish finfish and shellfish farms, represented by 218 unique grid cells, and compared satellite temperatures with in situ records from eight farms. We used principal component analysis and hierarchical clustering to describe long-term MHW exposure, and mixed-effects models to assess temporal changes. Results Two broad exposure profiles were identified. Cluster 1 was characterised by higher mean, maximum and cumulative intensity, whereas differences in event duration and frequency between clusters were smaller. Temporal trends, however, differed more strongly. MHW frequency increased at similar rates in both clusters, while event duration, cumulative intensity and severity increased more rapidly in Cluster 2. Between 1990 -2019 and 2020 -2025, estimated event duration increased by 44.6% in Cluster 1 and 89.9% in Cluster 2, while cumulative intensity increased by 50.0% and approximately 127.5%, respectively (cluster × period, p &lt; 0.001). The estimated probability of a Severe or Extreme event rose from 2.2% to 26.2% in Cluster 2, compared with 1.8% to 6.1% in Cluster 1 (cluster × period, p &lt; 0.001). Mean event intensity changed comparatively little. Discussion These findings show that MHW exposure across Scottish aquaculture is multidimensional, spatially uneven and changing at different rates through time. The resulting hazard -exposure landscape helps bridge regional MHW assessments and individual-farm monitoring, providing a foundation for more targeted monitoring and future assessment of aquaculture vulnerability and climate risk.
papers.summary_cn: 研究基于1990–2025年约5 km分辨率的OSTIA海表温度数据，分析了苏格兰361个活跃鱼类和贝类养殖场（218个网格单元）的marine heatwave（MHW）暴露特征，并与8个养殖场的现场记录进行比对。通过主成分分析和层次聚类识别出两类暴露剖面，并利用混合效应模型评估其时间变化。结果显示，Cluster 1以较高的平均、最大和累积强度为特征，而Cluster 2的事件持续时间、累积强度和严重程度增长更快：1990–2019年至2020–2025年间，持续时间分别增加44.6%和89.9%，累积强度分别增加50.0%和约127.5%；Cluster 2发生Severe或Extreme事件的概率从2.2%升至26.2%，远高于Cluster 1的1.8%至6.1%。研究表明苏格兰水产养殖的MHW暴露具有多维性、空间不均衡性和差异化时间变化趋势，为针对性监测和养殖脆弱性评估提供了基础。

papers.title: Ecology drives the degree of convergence in the gene expression of extremophile fishes
papers.authors: Tobler, Michael; Greenway, Ryan; Kelley, Joanna L.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the Royal Society B: Biological Sciences
papers.abstract: Abstract Convergent evolution is common and a testament to the repeatability of evolution. Still, non-convergence is also widespread, and a major question is whether idiosyncratic, lineage-specific changes are reflective of chance events inherent to evolutionary processes, or whether they are influenced by deterministic genetic or ecological factors. To address this question, we quantified the degree of convergence in gene expression across lineages of livebearing fishes (Poeciliidae) that span 40 million years of divergence and have colonized toxic, hydrogen-sulfide-rich springs. We asked whether the degree of convergence across lineage pairs was related to their phylogenetic relatedness and the ecological similarity of their habitats. Using phylogenetic comparative analyses, we showed that the degree of convergence in gene expression was variable across lineage pairs. While closely related lineages did not exhibit higher degrees of convergence than distantly related ones, we uncovered a strong relationship between degree of convergence and the ecological similarity among lineages. These results suggest that variation in environmental conditions that is often overlooked in simplified descriptions of habitat differences can play an important role in shaping adaptive evolution. Our study highlights the importance of multivariate approaches that capture the complexities of selective regimes and organismal responses when assessing the repeatability of evolution.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以跨约4000万年分化的卵胎生鱼类（Poeciliidae）为对象，量化其独立定殖富含硫化氢有毒泉水的多个谱系间基因表达趋同程度，检验趋同程度是否与系统发育亲缘关系及栖息地生态相似性相关。系统发育比较分析表明，基因表达趋同程度在各谱系对间存在差异，近缘谱系并未表现出比远缘谱系更高的趋同性，但趋同程度与谱系间生态相似性呈强相关。结果表明，常被简化栖息地差异描述所忽略的环境条件多维变异在塑造适应性进化中具有重要作用，强调在评估进化可重复性时需采用多变量方法刻画选择压力与生物响应的复杂性。

papers.title: Cross-domain risk governance of transboundary marine policies for blue carbon ecosystem protection: a fuzzy AHP evaluation framework applied to the nuclear wastewater discharge case
papers.authors: Huang, WeiLun
papers.abstract: Introduction Blue carbon ecosystems sequester carbon at rates that dwarf most terrestrial forests yet occupy less than 0.5% of the global ocean surface, making their protection under transboundary marine policy shocks both ecologically imperative and analytically underserved. Unilateral marine policy decisions in one coastal state, whether discharging pollutants, restructuring fishery regimes, or altering spatial zoning, generate externalities that propagate simultaneously across political, economic, industrial, and environmental channels into the blue carbon systems of neighboring states. No existing risk assessment tool captures this cross-domain, transjurisdictional character in a single integrated procedure. Methods This study develops and applies a Cross-Domain Risk Management Procedure (CDRMP) calibrated explicitly to blue carbon governance contexts. Grounded in polycentric governance theory, ecosystem services economics, and a transboundary externality model, the CDRMP framework embeds 36 evaluation criteria constructed via Nominal Group Technique and weighted via Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process (FAHP) across 114 respondents from government, industry, and public constituencies. The framework is applied to Japan's Fukushima Daiichi nuclear wastewater discharge into the Pacific Ocean as an illustrative transboundary case. Results Three principal findings emerge. First, geopolitical contestation (weight 0.197) nearly matches direct environmental contamination (0.206) in CDRMP severity, indicating that political governance instability and ecological contamination are mutually reinforcing rather than sequential risk events. Second, five of the seven highest-ranked criteria are blue-carbon-relevant, three of them blue-carbon-specific additions introduced by the ecological extension of the standard environmental domain, suggesting that frameworks without such calibration may systematically underdetect the most severe governance risks. Third, policy evaluation under optimistic, pessimistic, and equal-probabilities decision criteria shows no single policy dominating across all rules and analytical levels: marine environmental policy is preferred under two of three criteria at the dimension level and attains the single lowest aggregate deviation observed (0.856 under equal-probabilities), marine spatial policy is preferred under the pessimistic criterion at both levels, and marine economic policy is preferred under the optimistic criterion at the criterion level. Discussion The contingent pattern of policy preference is consistent with, though not a direct test of, complementary rather than substitutable governance roles across environmental, spatial, and economic instruments. The study contributes the first quantitatively operational CDRMP framework to the literatures on polycentric governance, blue carbon ecosystem services, and multi-criteria marine policy evaluation, providing coastal states with a replicable assessment procedure for transboundary marine policy risks.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究构建了跨域风险管理程序（CDRMP），基于多中心治理理论、生态系统服务经济学与跨境外部性模型，通过名义群体技术确定36项评价标准，并运用模糊层次分析法（FAHP）对来自政府、产业与公众的114名受访者进行权重赋值，以日本福岛第一核电站核废水排海为案例评估跨境海洋政策风险。结果显示，地缘政治争议（权重0.197）与直接环境污染（0.206）的风险严重性几乎相当，表明政治治理不稳定与生态污染相互强化而非序贯发生；7项最高排名标准中有5项与蓝碳相关，提示未经蓝碳校准的框架可能系统性低估最严重的治理风险。在乐观、悲观与等概率三种决策准则下无单一政策始终占优：海洋环境政策在维度层三项准则中的两项下最优（等概率下聚合偏差最低为0.856），海洋空间政策在悲观准则下两级均最优，海洋经济政策在准则层乐观准则下最优。

papers.title: Transoceanic migration of a female tiger shark (Galeocerdo cuvier) demonstrates connectivity in the southern Atlantic
papers.authors: Ostrovski, Raquel L.; Cochran, Jesse E. M.; Rangel, Bianca S.; Richardson, Eloise B.; Rodrigues, Alexandre; Santander-Neto, Jones; Jones, Burton H.; Moreira, Renata G.; Gomes, Fernando R.; Berumen, Michael L.
papers.abstract: Abstract The tiger shark is a highly migratory apex predator with distinct populations in the Atlantic and Indo-Pacific regions. Regional analyses in the western Atlantic Ocean have revealed additional genetic differentiation between northern (Caribbean) and southern (Brazilian) populations, particularly in maternally inherited mitochondrial DNA. The eastern Atlantic Ocean, however, remains understudied, leaving connectivity between American and African populations unresolved. Using a fin-mounted satellite transmitter, we document the complete eastward transatlantic movement of a female tiger shark (2.9 m total length), tracked from Fernando de Noronha Archipelago, Brazil, to the coastal waters of Sierra Leone, West Africa. Following an initial prolonged residency of around Fernando de Noronha, the individual undertook a 6,764 km migration across the Atlantic over 116 days (mean ~58 km day -1 ). Surfacing behavior differed significantly between the residency and migration phases, shifting from predominantly nocturnal to predominantly diurnal detections. This movement corroborates previous findings that female tiger sharks can disperse across basin scales and suggests that equatorial migration may facilitate genetic connectivity between the western and eastern Atlantic. In the absence of genetic data from West Africa, the demographic and genetic consequences of such movements remain undetermined, underscoring the need to integrate telemetry with expanded population genetic sampling to better understand connectivity in highly mobile marine predators.
papers.summary_cn: 研究利用鳍载卫星发射器追踪一条雌性虎鲨（Galeocerdo cuvier，全长2.9 m）从巴西Fernando de Noronha群岛迁至西非塞拉利昂沿海，完成6,764 km跨大西洋迁移，历时116天（日均约58 km）。该个体在迁出前于群岛附近长时间停留，迁移期间水面活动节律由夜行性转为昼行性。结果证实雌性虎鲨可跨洋盆扩散，提示赤道迁移可能促进西大西洋与东大西洋种群间的遗传连通性；但西非缺乏遗传数据，其种群与遗传后果仍待结合telemetry与扩展种群遗传采样进一步评估。

papers.title: Within‐lake length adjustment improves otolith shape discrimination among lake trout Salvelinus namaycush populations
papers.authors: Howell, Bradley E.; Navarroli, Giulio; Mullen, Eric J.; Morissette, Olivier; Hasler, Caleb T.
papers.abstract: Abstract Distinguishing fish populations is a long‐standing challenge in fisheries management, and otolith shape provides a low‐cost marker of population structure. Fish size strongly influences otolith shape; however, within‐lake size variation can obscure differences among populations. Here, a within‐lake length adjustment of otolith elliptic Fourier descriptors increased the otolith shape differences detected among three populations of Manitoban lake trout Salvelinus namaycush ( n = 153). The adjustment estimated and removed the relationship between each descriptor and fish total length within each population while retaining that population's mean shape. Lake of origin explained 3.2% of otolith shape variation before adjustment and 4.9% after, and all three pairs of lakes differed significantly after adjustment compared with one of three before. Classification assigned fish to the three lakes more evenly after adjustment, with correct assignment of Second Cranberry Lake fish rising from 13% to 34%. The within‐lake adjustment recovered more of the shape variation among lakes than the shapeR package while keeping all 28 Fourier coefficients. Reconstructed mean outlines identified Clearwater Lake otoliths as the most distinctive, carrying a more pronounced rostrum than the two other lakes. Despite a shared stocking history among the three lakes, otolith shape still differed among them, consistent with growth environment as a source of these differences. The within‐lake length adjustment provides a low‐cost description of population structure for inland fisheries that rely on archived otolith material.
papers.summary_cn: 研究旨在评估湖内体长校正对提高湖鳟（Salvelinus namaycush）种群耳石形状判别力的效果。对马尼托巴省三个湖泊共153尾湖鳟的耳石椭圆傅里叶描述子进行湖内体长校正，即在各种群内估计并剔除各描述子与体长的关系，同时保留种群平均形状。校正后湖泊来源解释的耳石形状变异由3.2%升至4.9%，三对湖泊间均呈显著差异（校正前仅一对显著），Second Cranberry Lake的正确判别率由13%升至34%。该方法较shapeR包保留更多湖泊间形状变异且保留全部28个傅里叶系数，为依赖存档耳石的内陆渔业种群结构评估提供了低成本手段。

papers.title: Rebuilding‐Time Based Reference Points: A Forward‐Looking Risk‐Equivalent Framework for Fisheries Management
papers.authors: Kell, Laurence T.; Mildenberger, Tobias K.; Griffiths, Christopher A.; Taylor, Marc H.; Cardinale, Massimiliano; Berg, Casper W.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Biomass‐based reference points are used to define stock status and set sustainable exploitation levels. Risks should be equivalent across stocks, regardless of the data and knowledge available to assess them by maintaining comparable probabilities of achieving targets and avoiding limits across agreed time scales. This study introduces , the lowest biomass from which a stock can rebuild to a target within an agreed time‐frame under a specified fishing scenario, and , the time required to rebuild from a given state. Once (or an equivalent biomass threshold), , and a harvest control rule defining are agreed, is a random variable with a probability distribution. can serve as a limit or a trigger in harvest control rules. Using age‐structured projections for 82 Northeast Atlantic stocks, we summarise the relationship between and life‐history covariates (, steepness) across stock–recruitment scenarios. Recovery is faster for stocks with higher per capita productivity (i.e., ) and steepness, with little difference between Beverton–Holt and Ricker forms once these characteristics are accounted for. The approach shifts emphasis from recruitment impairment to rebuilding capacity, makes the trade‐off with yield during rebuilding explicit, and provides a common currency for risk‐equivalent advice across assessment models and data tiers.
papers.summary_cn: 研究提出以重建时间为基础的参考点框架，引入最低可重建生物量（B_rebuild）和重建所需时间（T_rebuild）两个指标，旨在使不同数据条件的种群在达成目标与规避限值上具有等效风险。利用82个东北大西洋种群的年龄结构投影，分析了B_rebuild与生活史协变量（如steepness）在不同stock–recruitment情景下的关系。结果表明，单位补充生产力较高和steepness较大的种群恢复更快，且在控制这些特征后Beverton–Holt与Ricker模型差异甚小。该方法将管理重点从补充受损转向重建能力，明确了重建期产量权衡，并为跨评估模型和数据层级的风险等效建议提供统一度量。

papers.title: Management Can Make Shark Fisheries Sustainable: Evidence From Long‐Term Surveys
papers.authors: Al Ashad, Achmad N.; Walker, Terence I.; Day, Robert W.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Sustainable management of shark fisheries is challenging because sharks are highly vulnerable to fishing mortality. By analysing data from three independent scientific surveys between the early 1970s and late 2000s across three fishing regions in southern Australia, we show that conservative fisheries management following severe depletion facilitated full stock recovery of the gummy shark ( Mustelus antarcticus ), a species of moderate biological productivity. Conversely, the school shark ( Galeorhinus galeus ), a species of particularly low productivity, showed little sign of recovery, despite low levels of immigration from New Zealand, and recruitment likely collapsed during the first decade of the present century in response to the Millennium Drought. Only very recently have independent, innovative close‐kin mark‐recapture techniques demonstrated a rise in the school shark stock. The results indicate that management controls can successfully rebuild some shark stocks, but outcomes vary among species. Effective shark fisheries management requires species‐specific regulation and continued fishery‐independent monitoring covering all sizes to detect depletion, recovery and emerging pressures such as climate change.
papers.summary_cn: 基于澳大利亚南部三个独立科学调查（1970年代初至2000年代末）的长期数据，分析了保守型渔业管理对鲨鱼种群恢复的效果。研究发现，生物学生产力中等的gummy shark（Mustelus antarcticus）在严重资源衰退后实现了种群完全恢复，而生产力极低的school shark（Galeorhinus galeus）恢复迹象甚微，其补充量可能在本世纪头十年因千年干旱而崩溃，直至近期才通过close-kin mark-recapture技术检测到种群回升。结果表明，管理措施可成功重建部分鲨鱼种群，但效果因种而异，有效的鲨鱼渔业管理需采取物种特异性规制并持续开展覆盖所有体型的渔业独立监测，以探测资源衰退、恢复及气候变化等新兴压力。

papers.title: Multidimensional Fisheries and Aquaculture Sector Performance in Selected EU Countries: A Hybrid MCDM Approach
papers.authors: Balcı, Beytullah Ahmet; Kaya, Neylan; Tonguç, Güray; Ünal Uyar, Güler Ferhan; Arslan, Muhammed Nurullah
papers.abstract: The fisheries and aquaculture sector is of strategic importance to European Union (EU) countries regarding food security, economic value added, employment, and the sustainability of marine ecosystems. However, sectoral performance is multidimensional and cannot be fully characterized by production or economic indicators alone, as ecological and governance dimensions also provide relevant information. This study aims to comparatively assess the multidimensional performance of the fisheries and aquaculture sectors in selected EU countries using a multi-criteria decision-making (MCDM) framework integrating production, economic, consumption, ecological, and governance-related indicators. The analysis covers 15 EU Member States with complete and comparable observations across all eight criteria, primarily referring to 2021, while governance data were collected in 2019–2020; countries with missing or non-comparable observations were excluded without data imputation. Country performance was evaluated across eight criteria: total fisheries and aquaculture production, per capita production, fisheries and aquaculture exports, sustainable fisheries value added as a share of GDP, annual per capita consumption of aquatic animals, the proportion of biologically sustainable fish stocks, the extent of marine protected areas within marine waters, and fisheries governance capacity. The CRITIC method was used to derive objective, data-driven criterion weights based on contrast intensity and inter-criterion relationships, while EDAS and ARAS were applied to obtain comparative country rankings. The consistency between the country rankings obtained via the EDAS and ARAS methods was further assessed using Spearman’s rank correlation and Kendall’s tau-b coefficients. Ranking sensitivity was additionally examined under an equal-weight scenario and two leave-one-criterion-out scenarios excluding total production (C1) and per capita production (C2). The CRITIC results assigned the highest data-driven weight to per capita production and the lowest weight to annual per capita consumption of aquatic animals. The EDAS and ARAS results identified Spain as the top-performing country and Bulgaria as the lowest-performing country under both methods. The EDAS and ARAS rankings showed very strong concordance (Spearman’s ρ = 0.993; Kendall’s τ − b = 0.962). Sensitivity analysis also showed strong rank stability, with Spearman correlations of 0.989, 0.982, and 0.900 between the baseline EDAS ranking and the equal-weight, C1-exclusion, and C2-exclusion scenarios, respectively. Overall, the findings indicate that fisheries and aquaculture sector performance in the selected EU countries is multidimensional and cannot be characterized by production scale alone; economic, consumption, ecological, and governance-related indicators provide complementary information for comparative sectoral assessment.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在构建整合生产、经济、消费、生态与治理指标的多准则决策（MCDM）框架，比较评估15个欧盟成员国渔业与水产养殖部门的多维绩效（数据主要基于2021年，治理数据为2019–2020年）。采用CRITIC法确定客观权重，结合EDAS与ARAS法进行国家排序，并通过Spearman秩相关和Kendall tau-b系数检验排序一致性及敏感性。结果显示人均产量权重最高、人均水产品消费量权重最低；两种方法均将西班牙列为绩效最高国家、保加利亚列为最低国家，排序高度一致（Spearman ρ=0.993），且在等权重及剔除产量指标的敏感性情景下保持稳健。研究表明该部门绩效具有多维性，仅凭生产规模无法充分表征，经济、消费、生态与治理指标提供互补信息。

papers.title: ENVIRONMENTAL MANAGEMENT OF PELANTAR FISHERIES PORT, TANJUNGPINANG, INDONESIA
papers.authors: Wirangga, Wirangga; Mustaruddin, Mustaruddin; Muninggar, Retno
papers.abstract: Pelantar Tanjungpinang Fisheries Port is the only fish landing site in Tanjungpinang City. It supports small-scale capture fisheries, but its multifunctional use for fisheries, cargo, and passenger activities has increased sanitation and water-quality pressures. This study aims to evaluate environmental management performance and formulate priority strategies for eco-fishing port development. Fieldwork was conducted in April 2025 using observations, laboratory water-quality analysis from three purposively selected sampling stations, questionnaires, and stakeholder interviews. We assessed environmental and operational performance using a 1–5 scoring system; calculated sub-index mean scores; measured gaps against ideal eco-fishing port criteria; and determined priority strategies using the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP). The environmental sub-index was 2.38, and the operational sub-index was 2.50, producing an overall index of 2.44 out of 5.00 and placing the port in the low category. The most critical issue was biological contamination, with total coliform reaching 2,400 MPN/100 mL, exceeding the 1,000 MPN/100 mL threshold for port waters. The largest gaps occurred in water-quality monitoring and wastewater treatment, environmental documentation, environmental monitoring and enforcement, and hygienic fish handling. AHP prioritized water-quality management (17.2%), environmental documentation and management systems (15.4%), and monitoring and enforcement (11.4%). Environmental rehabilitation through wastewater treatment, sanitation improvement, routine monitoring, and institutional strengthening should precede physical expansion to support Pelantar's transition toward an eco-fishing port.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了印尼Tanjungpinang市Pelantar渔港的环境管理绩效，旨在为其向生态渔港转型制定优先策略。研究于2025年4月通过实地观测、三站点水质实验室分析、问卷调查及利益相关者访谈，采用1–5评分体系和AHP方法进行评估。结果显示环境子指数2.38、运营子指数2.50，综合指数2.44（低类别），总大肠菌群达2,400 MPN/100 mL，远超港口水域1,000 MPN/100 mL标准，水质监测与废水处理缺口最大。AHP确定的优先策略依次为水质管理（17.2%）、环境文档与管理系统（15.4%）及监测执法（11.4%），建议在物理扩建之前先行实施废水处理、卫生改善和制度强化等环境修复措施。

papers.title: Defining Sustainability for Multispecies Fisheries and Challenges in Application of Global Certification and Labeling Schemes
papers.authors: Leadbitter, Duncan; Sharma, Rishi
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Most fisheries in the world do not focus on the capture of only one or two species but harvest multiple species. Multispecies fisheries are challenging to understand and manage, with single species management options often insufficient and/or inappropriate. This paper analyses how two certification schemes, the Marine Stewardship Council and Marin Trust, address multispecies fisheries. These are both global in scope, based on the FAO Code of Conduct for Responsible Fisheries and reference the FAO Guidelines for the Ecolabelling of Fish and Fishery Products from Marine Capture Fisheries among several other global norms relating to fisheries. Both of these schemes were created in the Global North, with a focus on single species fisheries. There are complex interactions between the requirements of international law/agreements/guidance coupled with market‐based claims around sustainable/responsible sourcing which create a series of challenges that remain to be fully resolved, and these are amplified in species‐rich tropical ecosystems. There have been some significant gains in fisheries assessment approaches, ecosystem modelling and ways of thinking about sustainable fisheries from an ecosystem perspective since the FAO's Ecosystem Approach to Fisheries Management was adopted in 2001. There is a need for a comprehensive update of advice to help better align a growing number of global norms and, with that, some changes to the ways that fishery certification schemes handle complex multispecies fisheries. There would be benefits for updating the Code of Conduct for Responsible Fisheries, Sustainable Development Goal 14.4.1 and the FAO Ecolabelling Guidelines (FAO 2009) to ensure that these fisheries are explicitly included in the push for sustainable use. We provide five recommendations that could be considered by both intergovernmental bodies and the scheme owners which could assist better integration of multispecies fisheries into the wider push for sustainable use.
papers.summary_cn: 本文分析海洋管理委员会（MSC）与Marin Trust两大全球认证体系如何应对多物种渔业，指出二者均源于全球北方、以单物种渔业为设计基础，其基于FAO《负责任渔业行为守则》及生态标签准则的要求在物种丰富的热带生态系统中面临更大挑战。研究认为，自2001年FAO采纳生态系统渔业管理方法以来，渔业评估与生态系统建模已有显著进展，但认证体系对复杂多物种渔业的处理方式仍需更新。作者建议更新《负责任渔业行为守则》、SDG 14.4.1及FAO生态标签准则，使多物种渔业明确纳入可持续利用议程，并提出五项可供政府间机构和认证体系采纳的建议。

papers.title: Author Correction: Rice–fish co-culturing reduces schistosomiasis risk and increases yields and incomes
papers.authors: Selland, Emily K.; Jouanard, Nicolas; Guisse, Amadou; Seck, Momy; Lund, Andrea J.; López-Carr, David; Sack, Alexandra; Magblenou, Louis Dossou; De Leo, Giulio A.; Doruska, Molly J.
papers.summary_cn: 该文为作者更正（Author Correction），针对稻渔共作降低血吸虫病风险并提高产量与收入的研究，无摘要可供总结。

papers.title: Fish and aquatic biodiversity of the Kura River under pollution, flow alteration and climate pressures
papers.authors: Arifzade, Elnur; Gojali, Gunay; Fatalizade, Ali; Bashirova, Malak; Adigozalov, Mahammadali; Gurbanov, Rza; Isgandarli, Ayla
papers.journal: Journal of Green Economy and Optimization Research
papers.abstract: The Kura River supports a diverse aquatic community that includes fish, benthic organisms, mollusks, crustaceans, plankton and semi-aquatic mammals, while also sustaining fisheries, water supply and other ecosystem services. This study develops a five-author school research project into a structured academic synthesis of aquatic biodiversity and the pressures affecting river organisms. The original project used online research, textbooks, visual materials, Google Earth and NASA WorldWind, and focused on fish and other aquatic animals, pollution, changing water levels, overfishing and climate-related stress. The present article preserves the project’s original organism profiles and visual diagrams while comparing them with recent peer-reviewed and regional evidence. The literature confirms that the Kura supports multiple freshwater fish taxa and that its aquatic biota is exposed to interacting water-quality, habitat, flow and exploitation pressures. Recent studies document downstream hydrochemical changes, fish-health stress at the Kura mouth, parasite occurrence in freshwater fish, and broader Caspian sturgeon conservation concerns. The numerical decline diagrams prepared in the original project are retained for transparency but are treated as illustrative indices rather than verified population time series because the underlying raw dataset was not available. The study concludes that pollution prevention, fishery control, habitat and riparian protection, ecological monitoring and restoration should be pursued together. These measures also have green-economy relevance because aquatic biodiversity supports fisheries, recreation, landscape value and the natural capital on which resilient local development depends.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究将一项学生调研项目整合为关于库拉河水生生物多样性及其所受压力的学术综述，通过文献比较梳理了鱼类等水生生物类群面临的污染、流量改变、过度捕捞和气候胁迫等多重交互压力。近期研究记录了下游水化学变化、河口鱼类健康应激、淡水鱼寄生虫出现及里海鲟鱼保护问题。原文中的数量下降图示因原始数据不可得仅作示意性指标保留。研究结论主张污染防控、渔业管理、栖息地与河岸带保护、生态监测和修复应协同推进。

papers.title: Marker-Centered Evaluation of De Novo Assemblers Using Validated Microsatellite Loci in the Endangered Korean Fish Pseudopungtungia nigra
papers.authors: Kim, Kang-Rae; Kim, Keun-Sik; Bang, In-Chul
papers.abstract: The recovery of experimentally validated microsatellite loci from short-read assemblies may provide an application-specific measure of assembly quality that complements conventional genome-wide statistics. In this study, four de novo assemblers—SPAdes, ABySS, SOAPdenovo2, and MaSuRCA—were evaluated using genomic reads from two individuals of the endangered Korean freshwater fish Pseudopungtungia nigra. Assembler performance was assessed based on assembly contiguity, BUSCO completeness, computational requirements, and the recovery of 20 PCR-validated microsatellite loci and their flanking regions. SPAdes produced the most contiguous assemblies and the highest BUSCO completeness among the tested assemblers, with N50 values of 5.5–7.0 kb and BUSCO completeness of 30.2–35.2%, and recovered all 20 loci and their flanking sequences at high confidence in both individuals. Marker recovery by ABySS, SOAPdenovo2, and MaSuRCA varied according to k-mer size and sample, with high-confidence recovery decreasing at larger k-mer sizes in several configurations and reaching 9 of 20 loci in the least favorable condition. SPAdes used 32.1–34.2 GB of peak memory, compared with up to 135.0 GB in the most memory-intensive SOAPdenovo2 runs. Reference-guided comparisons retained substantially greater total aligned sequence with the two Pseudorasbora references than with the more divergent Cyprinus carpio reference, although the mean identity of the smaller retained C. carpio alignment set was slightly higher. All 20 validated marker sequences produced high-confidence provisional placements in both Pseudorasbora reference genomes. As an exploratory downstream application, the SUC6832-derived pseudo-reference enabled joint genotyping of the two samples and yielded 2,012,643 filtered candidate variants across 25 guide-assigned scaffolds. These results indicate that SPAdes provided the most favorable balance of validated marker recovery, relative assembly quality, and memory efficiency among the tested configurations, although all assemblies remained fragmented at the genome-wide level. Marker-centered benchmarking can therefore complement conventional assembly statistics when short-read assemblies are generated primarily for microsatellite development, while pseudo-reference-based genomic analyses should remain provisional because of assembly fragmentation, reference bias, and limited biological sampling.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以韩国濒危淡水鱼 Pseudopungtungia nigra 两个个体的基因组短读长为数据，比较 SPAdes、ABySS、SOAPdenovo2 和 MaSuRCA 四种 de novo 组装器在组装连续性、BUSCO 完整性、计算资源需求及 20 个经 PCR 验证的微卫星位点及其侧翼序列回收方面的表现。SPAdes 组装连续性最佳（N50 5.5–7.0 kb）、BUSCO 完整性最高（30.2–35.2%），并在两个个体中高置信度回收全部 20 个位点；其余组装器的标记回收率随 k-mer 大小和样本而异，最低仅回收 9/20 个位点。SPAdes 峰值内存为 32.1–34.2 GB，而 SOAPdenovo2 最高达 135.0 GB。结果表明，以标记为中心的评估可补充常规组装统计，SPAdes 在标记回收、相对组装质量和内存效率间取得最佳平衡，但所有组装在基因组水平仍较碎片化。

papers.title: Marine Heatwaves Associated with Hypoxia in Coastal Bivalve Aquaculture and Management Implications
papers.authors: Feng, Yuelin
papers.abstract: Marine heatwaves alter coastal dissolved oxygen dynamics and exacerbate hypoxia risk for farmed bivalves, yet causal relationships between warming and low oxygen remain poorly differentiated in aquaculture assessments. This paper establishes a three-category attribution framework to distinguish hypoxia directly induced by marine heatwaves, background hypoxia amplified during thermal anomalies, and merely coincident high-temperature and low-oxygen events. Compiled physiological and experimental evidence demonstrates that combined heat and hypoxia impose species-specific impacts on feeding, metabolism, antioxidant defence and survival, with nocturnal oxygen minima driving growth losses hidden by daily mean dissolved oxygen values. Molecular stress markers reflect cellular defence activation but cannot reliably predict harvest biomass or economic outcomes. Site characteristics, organismal traits and exposure recurrence modify stress responses, so universal oxygen thresholds are unsuitable for farm risk management. Integrated high-frequency monitoring and targeted aeration can mitigate oxygen-related damage, though thermal injury persists. This synthesis highlights the necessity of site-specific adaptive strategies to improve climate resilience of coastal bivalve aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 该文建立三类归因框架，区分由 marine heatwaves 直接诱导的低氧、热异常期间放大的背景低氧及仅与高温低氧同时发生的事件，以厘清增温与低氧的因果关系。综合生理与实验证据表明，热与低氧复合胁迫对双壳类的摄食、代谢、抗氧化防御和存活具物种特异性影响，夜间氧最低值可掩盖日均溶解氧所隐藏的生长损失。分子应激标志物仅反映细胞防御激活，无法可靠预测收获生物量或经济产出；站点特征、生物性状与暴露频次调节应激响应，通用氧阈值不适用于养殖风险管理。高频监测与针对性增氧可减轻氧相关损害，但热损伤仍持续，需制定站点特异性适应策略以提升沿海双壳类养殖的气候韧性。

papers.title: Digitalization of Automatic Monitoring and Control for Aquaculture Based on Internet of Things
papers.authors: Kusumaningrum, Tiara Hande Dias; Daud Siringoringo, Roytua; Sayekti, Ilham; Kusumastuti, Sri
papers.journal: Jurnal Teknik Elektro dan Komputer TRIAC
papers.abstract: Fish pond management is highly dependent on water quality parameters such as temperature, pH level, and water level. In practice, monitoring and controlling these parameters are often performed manually, resulting in inefficiency and delayed response to environmental changes. This study presents the design and implementation of an Internet of Things-based monitoring and control system for fish pond maintenance. The system utilizes an ESP32 microcontroller integrated with a DS18B20 temperature sensor, a pH sensor, and an HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor. The control method combines automatic and manual control. In automatic mode, the ESP32 activates the water pumps, aerator, and feeder based on predefined sensor thresholds, while in manual mode, control commands are issued through the Node-RED dashboard and transmitted to the ESP32 via the MQTT protocol. Experimental results show that the system achieved average percentage errors of 3.83% for temperature measurement, 2.56% for pH measurement, and 2.70% for water level measurement, while all actuators responded reliably to user commands through real-time communication. The developed system provides an effective and practical solution to improve efficiency and accessibility in aquaculture management.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究设计并实现了一套基于物联网的鱼塘监测与控制系统，采用ESP32微控制器集成DS18B20温度传感器、pH传感器和HC-SR04超声波传感器，结合自动与手动两种控制模式，自动模式下依据预设阈值触发水泵、增氧机和投饵机，手动模式通过Node-RED仪表板经MQTT协议下发指令。实验结果显示温度、pH和水位测量的平均百分比误差分别为3.83%、2.56%和2.70%，所有执行器均能通过实时通信可靠响应用户指令。该系统为提升水产养殖管理效率和可及性提供了一种实用有效的解决方案。

papers.title: Phase-Specific Water-Quality Responses to Enhancement Harvesting and Filter-Feeding Fish Stocking: A Dense Sentinel-2 Time-Series Assessment
papers.authors: Tang, Hao; Zhu, Zhizhou; Jiang, Liang; Shi, Shuai; Hua, Qi; Gong, Haibo
papers.abstract: Enhancement harvesting and filter-feeding fish stocking are increasingly applied in shallow eutrophic lakes, but their water-quality effects are difficult to evaluate because management signals overlap with seasonal and hydrometeorological variability. We analyzed dense Sentinel-2 observations of Taibo Lake during 2019–2026 using three management stages, phase-specific event windows, and matched forbidden-fishing controls. Regressions adjusted for antecedent precipitation and month used 25 scenes from the 2024 and 2025 events. Chlorophyll-related proxies were descriptively lower during enhancement harvesting than in the 2019 reference year, with no consistent advantage over forbidden fishing. The contrast with 2019 remains confounded by year-specific environmental conditions. Integrated optical and turbidity-related indicators showed no uniform directional change, and representative September scenes revealed substantial within-lake heterogeneity. Event-window comparisons showed no consistent immediate directional response to harvesting or stocking. Exploratory models suggested higher post-stocking normalized difference chlorophyll index (NDCI) values and high-NDCI ratios; only NDCI remained nominally significant after Bonferroni adjustment (adjusted p = 0.036 versus 0.204). Limited event replication and unmodeled temporal dependence precluded confirmatory inference. These findings support phase-specific water-quality monitoring with seasonally matched baselines and continued observation through the post-stocking period to inform adaptive enhancement-fishery management.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用2019–2026年密集Sentinel-2时序影像，结合分阶段事件窗口与禁渔对照，评估太湖增强捕捞和滤食性鱼类放流对水质的影响，并校正前期降水与月份效应。结果显示，增强捕捞期叶绿素相关指标虽低于2019年参考年，但相对禁渔对照无一致优势，且受年际环境条件混淆；光学与浊度指标无统一方向性变化，湖内异质性显著。放流后NDCI值及高NDCI比例呈升高趋势，但仅NDCI经Bonferroni校正后边缘显著（校正p=0.036），事件重复有限难以确证。研究支持采用季节匹配基线的分阶段水质监测，并持续观测放流后期以支撑适应性增强渔业管理。

papers.title: Sex-Specific DNA Methylation in the Liver of Ancherythroculter nigrocauda, a Fish with Female-Biased Size Dimorphism
papers.authors: Chen, Jian; Li, Pei; Luo, Lifei; Guo, Hongxi; Sun, Yanhong
papers.abstract: Sexual size dimorphism (SSD) is widespread in teleost fishes, yet the epigenetic mechanisms underlying sex-specific growth remain poorly understood, particularly in non-model species. Here, we performed genome-wide DNA methylation profiling of liver tissue in Ancherythroculter nigrocauda, a species exhibiting female-biased SSD, using the MethylRAD approach. MethylRAD sequencing of five females and five males generated approximately 1.0–1.5 million unique methylated loci per sample. Comparative analysis identified 82,872 differentially methylated sites (DMSs), which clearly separated sexes and were significantly enriched in promoters and CpG islands. Gene ontology analyses revealed that sex-biased methylation preferentially affected pathways related to intracellular signaling, cell adhesion, cytoskeletal organization, and protein modification, processes closely associated with hepatic growth and metabolic regulation. Chromosomal binning uncovered large contiguous male-biased methylation domains on Superscaffold15 and Superscaffold20, consistent with recombination-suppressed regions and suggesting candidate sex-linked loci, with Superscaffold20 supported by prior sex-specific coverage differences. Integration with liver transcriptome data revealed a threshold-dependent regulatory architecture: genes harboring dense methylation clustering (>20 DMS) were approximately six-fold more likely to exhibit sex-biased expression, and directional concordance between methylation and transcription further supported functional coupling. Together, these findings demonstrate that sex-biased DNA methylation in the liver is widespread yet concentrated within regulatory hotspots and discrete chromosomal domains, highlighting epigenetic regulation as a key contributor to hepatic sexual dimorphism and providing new insights into the molecular basis of SSD in teleost fishes.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以雌性偏大性二态（SSD）的鱼类黑尾近红鲌（Ancherythroculter nigrocauda）为对象，采用MethylRAD方法对雌雄各5尾个体的肝脏组织进行全基因组DNA甲基化分析，鉴定出82,872个差异甲基化位点（DMSs），这些位点显著富集于启动子和CpG岛，主要涉及细胞内信号传导、细胞黏附及细胞骨架组织等与肝脏生长代谢相关的通路。染色体分析在Superscaffold15和20上发现雄性偏倚的大片段连续甲基化区域，提示候选性连锁位点。整合转录组数据表明，密集甲基化簇（>20 DMS）的基因呈现性别偏倚表达的可能性约为六倍，提示肝脏性别偏倚DNA甲基化集中于调控热点和特定染色体区域，是肝脏性二态及SSD的重要表观遗传基础。

papers.title: Editorial: Adaptation and evolution in marine extreme environments
papers.authors: Giordano, Daniela; Núñez-Pons, Laura; Carlot, Jérémy; Purcarea, Cristina
papers.summary_cn: 该社论聚焦海洋极端环境下的生物适应与演化研究，探讨相关物种在高压、高温、低温或高盐等胁迫条件下的适应机制与演化过程。

papers.title:
Psychoactive
Pollutant
Impacts Baseline Immune Traits
but Not Behavior and Microbiome in a Fish
papers.authors: Melhado, Gabriel; Eastment, Rhiannon V.; Marques, Francine Z.; Aich, Upama; Peters, Anne; Wong, Bob B. M.
papers.abstract: Abstract Pharmaceutical pollution is an increasing global threat to freshwater ecosystems. Psychoactive drugs, such as antidepressants, are of particular concern because they affect evolutionarily conserved neuroendocrine pathways in nontarget organisms. As these pathways regulate interconnected biological systems, understanding the ecological consequences of pharmaceutical exposure requires an integrative approach. Here, we investigated the effects of 28-day exposure to control (freshwater), low (4.2 ± 0.3 ng/L), and high (637.5 ± 173.84 ng/L) fluoxetine concentrations on behaviors, baseline immune traits, and skin mucus microbiome composition in the Murray River rainbowfish (Melanotaenia fluviatilis). Fluoxetine exposure did not impact fish behavior, including activity, freezing behavior, shelter use, or microbiome composition. In contrast, immune traits were significantly altered. Both fluoxetine concentrations reduced total white blood cell (WBC) count, while only fish exposed to the low concentration showed reduced lymphocyte counts and elevated neutrophil counts, consistent with a stress-associated WBC redistribution response. Our findings show that different, but interconnected, biological systems can differ in their sensitivity to pollutants and suggest that immune traits may be an early, sensitive indicator of exposure to psychoactive pharmaceuticals. These findings highlight the importance of integrating multiple biological end points to obtain a more comprehensive understanding of the ecological consequences of pharmaceutical contamination.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以Murray River rainbowfish为对象，探究28天暴露于低浓度（4.2 ng/L）和高浓度（637.5 ng/L）氟西汀对行为、基础免疫特征及皮肤黏液microbiome组成的影响。结果显示氟西汀暴露未改变活动性、冻结行为、庇护所利用及microbiome组成，但显著降低总白细胞计数，且低浓度组淋巴细胞减少、中性粒细胞升高，符合应激相关白细胞重分布反应。研究表明不同生物系统对污染物敏感性存在差异，免疫指标可作为精神活性药物暴露的早期敏感指示物。

papers.title: Chemical cues affect behaviour in fish lice ( Argulus spp.) and three‐spined stickleback hosts ( Gasterosteus aculeatus )
papers.authors: Encel, Stella A.; Ward, Ashley J. W.
papers.abstract: Abstract We found evidence of mutual recognition of chemical cues between fish lice ( Argulus spp.) and three‐spined sticklebacks ( Gasterosteus aculeatus ). Each manifested changes in movement in response to chemical cues from one another; Argulus increased speed while G. aculeatus decreased theirs. As Argulus use active searching behaviours to locate hosts, higher speeds indicate increased searching activity. Conversely, G. aculeatus may slow down to augment visual detection while also reducing mechanical cues which attract lice. This represents the first evidence that G. aculeatus may use chemical cues to mitigate the risk of parasitism from lice.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨鱼虱（Argulus spp.）与三刺鱼（Gasterosteus aculeatus）之间是否存在化学信号的相互识别。实验观察两者对彼此化学信号的运动行为反应。结果发现鱼虱提高游动速度以增强主动搜寻宿主的活动，而三刺鱼则降低速度，可能既增强视觉探测又减少吸引鱼虱的机械信号。这是三刺鱼利用化学信号降低寄生风险的首个证据。

papers.title: Dose-Dependent Effects of Dietary Tetrastigma hemsleyanum Supplementation on Growth Performance, Digestive Function, Antioxidant Capacity, and Immunity of Juvenile Leopard Coral Grouper (Plectropomus leopardus)
papers.authors: Cui, Zhengyi; Xie, Nan; Zhang, Wei; Fang, Yi; Chu, Tianjiang
papers.abstract: Tetrastigma hemsleyanum (TH) is a traditional Chinese medicinal herb with well-documented anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties, but its effects on aquatic animals remain unknown. To determine the effects of dietary TH supplementation, growth performance, digestive function, antioxidant capacity, and immune status were investigated in juvenile leopard coral grouper (Plectropomus leopardus). Five isonitrogenous and isolipidic experimental diets were formulated with TH tuber powder included at 0, 0.25%, 0.5%, 1%, and 2%. A total of 450 fish (initial body weight, 6.62 ± 0.16 g) were randomly allocated into five groups, with three replicate tanks per group. Each tank was stocked with 30 fish, and fish were fed the assigned diet for 8 weeks. Results showed that 0.25–0.5% TH significantly increased final body weight, weight gain rate, specific growth rate, and the specific activities of intestinal amylase, lipase, and trypsin without compromising feed conversion, whereas higher doses (1–2%) inhibited digestive enzyme activity and impaired feed utilization. In contrast, 1–2% TH markedly enhanced hepatic and serum antioxidant capacity, as indicated by elevated total antioxidant capacity and catalase, superoxide dismutase, and glutathione peroxidase activities, and reduced malondialdehyde content. Histological analysis revealed that high-dose TH improved intestinal villus morphology and appeared to ameliorate hepatocellular vacuolation. High-dose TH also upregulated intestinal tight junction and mucin genes (occludin, zo2, zo3, and mucin 2), downregulated hepatic pro-inflammatory cytokines (tnf-α, il-1β, il-6, il-8, ifn-γ), and upregulated anti-inflammatory il-10, accompanied by enhanced serum alkaline phosphatase, acid phosphatase, and lysozyme activities. In conclusion, low-dose (0.25%) TH promotes growth and feed efficiency, whereas high-dose (1–2%) TH enhanced antioxidant capacity, immune indices, and intestinal barrier function but impaired feed conversion, indicating that the inclusion level of TH should be carefully optimized according to production goals.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨饲料中添加不同剂量三叶青（Tetrastigma hemsleyanum, TH）对豹纹鳃棘鲈（Plectropomus leopardus）幼鱼生长性能、消化功能、抗氧化能力及免疫状态的影响，配制TH块茎粉添加量为0、0.25%、0.5%、1%和2%的五组等氮等脂饲料，进行为期8周的养殖实验。结果表明，低剂量（0.25%–0.5%）TH显著提高终末体重、增重率、特定生长率及肠道淀粉酶、脂肪酶和胰蛋白酶活性，且不影响饲料转化；而高剂量（1%–2%）抑制消化酶活性并损害饲料利用。高剂量TH显著增强肝脏和血清抗氧化能力（提高T-AOC、CAT、SOD、GSH-Px活性，降低MDA含量），改善肠道绒毛形态，上调肠道紧密连接和黏蛋白基因（occludin、zo2、zo3、mucin 2），下调肝脏促炎细胞因子（tnf-α、il-1β、il-6、il-8、ifn-γ）并上调抗炎因子il-10，同时增强血清AKP、ACP和溶菌酶活性。综上，低剂量（0.25%）TH促进生长和饲料效率，高剂量（1%–2%）TH增强抗氧化、免疫及肠道屏障功能但损害

papers.title: Changing coral disease dynamics with the emergence of stony coral tissue loss disease on reefs at Carrie Bow Cay, Belize Barrier Reef
papers.authors: Aeby, Greta Smith; Work, Thierry Martin; Jones, Scott; Houk, L. Jay; Harper, Leah M.; Altman-Kurosaki, Noam T.; Toth, Kathryn; Shortal, Colleen; Paul, Valerie J.
papers.abstract: Coral reefs in the Caribbean Sea continue to experience unprecedented declines driven by the combined impacts of emerging infectious diseases and increasingly frequent marine heatwaves. This study assessed temporal changes in coral health, disease prevalence, and community composition at nine sites on the Belize Barrier Reef surveyed before and after the emergence of stony coral tissue loss disease (SCTLD) and the 2023 Caribbean mass bleaching event. During our study period (2019-2024), disease became a major driver of mortality, albeit with an epidemiologic transition with shifts in the main diseases driving these patterns. Surveys in 2019 documented relatively healthy reefs with low disease prevalence (avg. 0.5%) characterized by numerous endemic coral diseases. Following the arrival of SCTLD, disease prevalence increased more than tenfold by 2022 (avg. 6.2%), with SCTLD affecting 12 coral species and a previously undescribed chronic tissue loss disease with bleached or purple discoloration (cTLD) emerging in Siderastrea siderea . By 2024, overall average disease prevalence was 4.2% but SCTLD prevalence had declined markedly while S. siderea cTLD became the dominant disease (90% of the diseased colonies), indicating a shift in disease patterns through time. Hard and soft coral cover declined, and sponge cover increased significantly from 1.3% in 2019 to 4.5% in 2024. Coral community structure changed substantially throughout the study, with reductions in colony densities (73.4% decline), and species richness (33% decline). The abundance of SCTLD-susceptible taxa declined following disease emergence, followed by additional losses of thermally sensitive corals after the 2023 bleaching event. Roving diver surveys documented SCTLD to be widespread along the Belize Barrier Reef. Histopathological analyses confirmed that Belizean SCTLD lesions resembled those previously described from the U.S. Virgin Islands and that bleached lesions on Orbicella annularis represented manifestations of SCTLD. Collectively, these findings show that coral disease outbreaks and bleaching events produce different patterns of coral mortality and community change, while their cumulative impacts are reshaping Caribbean coral assemblages. The emergence of cTLD in the increasingly dominant, stress-tolerant coral S. siderea highlights the need for continued disease surveillance, investigation of newly emerging coral diseases, and integrated monitoring programs that consider both disease and bleaching as interacting drivers of reef decline.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了伯利兹堡礁9个站点在stony coral tissue loss disease（SCTLD）出现前后及2023年加勒比海大规模白化事件期间珊瑚健康、疾病流行率和群落组成的时间变化（2019–2024年）。2019年珊瑚礁相对健康，疾病流行率低（平均0.5%）；SCTLD到达后，2022年疾病流行率增加逾十倍（平均6.2%），影响12种珊瑚，并在Siderastrea siderea中新发现一种伴白化或紫色变色的慢性组织损失病（cTLD）。至2024年，SCTLD流行率显著下降而S. siderea cTLD成为优势疾病（占患病群体的90%），硬珊瑚和软珊瑚覆盖率下降、海绵覆盖率从1.3%升至4.5%，珊瑚群体密度下降73.4%、物种丰富度下降33%。组织病理学分析证实伯利兹SCTLD病灶与美属维尔京群岛此前描述的病变相似，且Orbicella annularis的白化病灶为SCTLD表现。研究表明疾病暴发与白化事件产生不同的珊瑚死亡和群落变化模式，其累积影响正在重塑加勒比海珊瑚群落，并强调对新发珊瑚疾病持续监测的必要性。

papers.title: Contrasting the Evolutionary Pathways of Small‐ and Large‐Scale Fishing
papers.authors: Thambithurai, Davide; Olsen, Esben M.; Kuparinen, Anna
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Fishing‐induced evolution (FIE) has emerged as a key concern in fisheries science, yet it remains unclear how different fishing sectors contribute to evolutionary change. Here we examine how large‐scale fisheries (LSF) and small‐scale fisheries (SSF) may differ in the pathways through which fishing mortality becomes trait‐dependent in fish populations. We synthesise how fishery characteristics—including fishing intensity, spatial and temporal targeting, gear diversity, technological capacity, target breadth and governance structures—may influence the timing, consistency and targets of selection, thereby shaping evolutionary outcomes. We suggest that SSF may generate more heterogeneous selection regimes, acting on individual variation in behavioural, ecological and vulnerability‐related traits through partial harvesting, diverse gear use and localised fishing practices. In contrast, LSF may generate consistent patterns of trait‐dependent mortality because of operational scale, greater catch capacity, advanced technologies and standardised management frameworks. These differences do not necessarily imply stronger or weaker overall selection, but suggest that SSF and LSF may differ in the mechanisms through which phenotypes become exposed to fishing mortality and the traits most likely to be affected. Differences in target specificity, bycatch and discard practices may also contribute to divergent evolutionary pathways between sectors. While high mortality remains an important driver of life‐history evolution, sector‐specific mechanisms may shape trait trajectories, including behaviour, growth, habitat use and migration. We highlight key knowledge gaps and emphasise the need to integrate evolutionary perspectives into both LSF and SSF management, especially given technological advancement and potential future regulation and standardisation of SSF practices.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究探讨大规模渔业（LSF）与小规模渔业（SSF）在渔业诱导进化（FIE）路径上的差异，综合分析了捕捞强度、时空靶向、渔具多样性、技术能力、目标广度和治理结构等渔业特征如何影响选择的时间、一致性和靶标。研究提出，SSF通过部分捕捞、多样化渔具和本地化作业产生更异质的选择机制，作用于行为、生态和易感性相关性状的个体变异；而LSF因作业规模、捕捞能力、先进技术和标准化管理框架形成一致性的性状依赖死亡模式。两部门在目标特异性、兼捕和丢弃实践上的差异也可能导致进化路径分化，需将进化视角纳入LSF和SSF管理。

papers.title: Management strategy evaluation for real-time closures in the short mackerel fishery in the Gulf of Thailand
papers.authors: Meeanan, Chonlada; Noranarttragoon, Pavarot; Sinanun, Piyachoke; Sanitmajjaro, Wirat; Takahashi, Yuki; Kaewnern, Methee; Matsuishi, Takashi Fritz
papers.summary_cn: 该研究针对泰国湾短体鲭渔业，采用 management strategy evaluation 框架评估实时禁渔区（real-time closures）的管理效果，旨在平衡资源养护与渔业生产。

papers.title: A Bering Sea marine heatwave triggers unprecedented crab hybridization, challenging fisheries management
papers.authors: Fedewa, Erin J.; Ryznar, Emily R.; Cleary, Connor P.; Gardner, Jennifer L.; Hennessey, Shannon M.; Long, W. Christopher; Richar, Jon I.; Zacher, Leah S.; Litzow, Michael A.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
papers.abstract: Marine heatwaves are increasingly recognized for their capacity to generate ecological surprises, yet the pathways that propagate these unexpected responses are often poorly understood. Here, we document an unanticipated ecological response 7 y after a Bering Sea marine heatwave, in which formerly rare snow crab ( Chionoecetes opilio ) × Tanner crab ( C. bairdi ) hybrid abundance increased 13.4-fold, and the proportion of commercial-sized hybrid males increased 13.1-fold, relative to historical averages. Using causal modeling, we show that the hybrid crab surge was mediated by a heatwave-induced collapse of snow crab rather than direct thermal effects on hybrid survival or increased spatial overlap between mature snow and Tanner crab. Our results reveal an indirect cascading pathway through which an extreme climate event triggered unexpected ecological consequences and unforeseen challenges for fisheries management in the Bering Sea. The dramatic increase in abundance of harvestable hybrid crab, coupled with their exclusion from existing management frameworks, highlights the vulnerability of inflexible management systems to unanticipated ecosystem responses.
papers.summary_cn: 研究记录了白令海海洋热浪发生7年后，雪蟹（Chionoecetes opilio）与Tanner蟹（C. bairdi）杂交种的丰度较历史均值增加13.4倍，商业规格雄性杂交个体比例增加13.1倍。因果模型表明，杂交种激增由热浪导致的雪蟹种群崩溃间接介导，而非热效应对杂交种存活或亲本空间重叠的直接影响。可捕捞杂交蟹的急剧增加及其被排除在现有管理框架之外，凸显了刚性渔业管理制度面对突发生态系统响应的脆弱性。

papers.title: Hidden population declines revealed by integrating long-term fisheries data with fishers’ knowledge
papers.authors: Nishimoto, Makoto; Aoki, Yoshinori; Matsubara, Naoto; Hamer, Paul; Kim, Kyuhan; Tsuda, Yuichi
papers.abstract: Abstract Technological creep, the gradual increase in fishing power due to technological innovation, can mask population declines and bias fisheries assessments, yet information on historical technology adoption is rarely available. Here, we integrate long-term fisheries statistics (1972–2022) with structured interviews with experienced fishers to reconstruct technological change in the Japanese pole-and-line skipjack tuna ( Katsuwonus pelamis ) fishery. We estimate population trajectories over five decades using a Bayesian state-space model with time-varying catchability informed by questionnaire data. Biomass estimates decline substantially when catchability increases over time, by approximately 3.5-fold over the study period, equivalent to about 2.5% annually, relative to models assuming constant catchability. The resulting biomass trajectory indicates that the stock off Japan is below levels compatible with maximum sustainable yield (MSY). Fishers’ perceptions corroborate the inferred decline in skipjack tuna abundance despite apparently stable catch rates. Our findings highlight the importance of incorporating dynamic catchability into population models and provide a scalable framework for correcting for technological creep using fishers’ knowledge.
papers.summary_cn: 研究将1972–2022年长期渔业统计与经验渔民结构化访谈相结合，重建日本竿钓鲣鱼（Katsuwonus pelamis）渔业的技术变迁，并采用以问卷信息驱动时变可捕性的贝叶斯状态空间模型估算五十年种群轨迹。结果显示，捕捞能力在研究期内约增长3.5倍（年均约2.5%），考虑时变可捕性后生物量估算显著下降，日本近海种群已低于MSY兼容水平。渔民感知印证了尽管CPUE表观稳定但资源实际衰退，表明种群模型须纳入动态可捕性，渔民知识可为校正技术蠕变提供可扩展框架。

papers.title: The Perceived Impact of the Single-Use Plastics Implementation for Micro Fish Vendors in Island Garden City of Samal
papers.authors: T. Debalos, Shania Mariz; A. Galanido, Christine; O. Loreño, Rhea Jane; R. Monteroso, Cornelio Jr.
papers.journal: International Journal of Innovative Research in Multidisciplinary Education
papers.abstract: The study evaluated the perceived effects of implementing single-use plastic regulations on micro fish vendors in the Island Garden City of Samal. It used a quantitative descriptive-comparative study design to examine the vendors' demographic characteristics and their perceptions of the regulation's impact on their business operations. The study also found no differences in perceived impact among vendors when divided into groups by age, gender, and educational attainment. A structured questionnaire, which was adopted, was used to collect data from the registered micro fish vendors in the three districts of the Island Garden City of Samal. The results highlighted that the vendors were mostly female, of working age, and with secondary-level education. The vendors felt that the implementation of single-use plastic had a moderate impact, mainly on packaging practices, operating costs, and customer-related aspects of the business. In addition, statistical analysis revealed no significant differences in perceived impacts when vendors were grouped by age, gender, and educational attainment, suggesting that regulatory difficulties were fairly evenly distributed across groups. The findings were analyzed using Kurt Lewin's Change Management Theory and Nudge Theory to provide insights into how vendors respond to regulatory changes and adjust their approach towards more sustainable methods. The study sheds light on the need for inclusive and accessible support mechanisms, such as information campaigns, capacity building, low-cost, eco-friendly packaging options, and livelihood support, to help micro fish vendors adapt to environmental regulations while continuing their economic activities. The study offers relevant suggestions for the local government and various stakeholders to balance environmental protection with the livelihoods and economic sustainability of micro fish vendors.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了萨马尔岛花园城市一次性塑料禁令对微型鱼类销售商的影响，采用定量描述比较设计，通过结构化问卷对三个区注册微型鱼贩进行调查。结果显示，销售商以女性、劳动年龄、中等教育水平为主，认为该禁令对包装实践、经营成本和客户相关业务产生中等程度影响；按年龄、性别和教育程度分组，感知影响无显著差异。研究基于Kurt Lewin变革管理理论和助推理论分析，建议地方政府提供信息宣传、能力建设、低成本环保包装和生计支持等包容性配套措施，以平衡环境保护与微型鱼贩的经济可持续性。

papers.title: Effects of Fish Farming Prior to Farm Removal on Macrozoobenthic Crustacean and Molluscan Assemblages in a Major Turkish Aquaculture Gulf: Integrating Historical Data with Literature Insights
papers.authors: Aslan, Berivan Elif; Mutlu, Erhan
papers.abstract: Fish farming can significantly impact benthic ecosystems, particularly through alterations in water and sediment quality, potentially disrupting ecosystem functioning and biodiversity. This study investigates the effects of fish-farming on crustacean and molluscan assemblages in Güllük Gulf and Bozburun bay along Turkey’s Aegean coast. Macrozoobenthic samples were collected from fish farm sites and corresponding control sites, representing a baseline prior to the relocation of many farms to offshore areas in the 2010s. A total of 114 crustacean and 54 molluscan species were identified at farm sites, compared to 88 crustaceans and 52 molluscs at control sites. Crustaceans, particularly amphipods, were the most diverse group, while bivalves dominated the molluscan assemblages. Species such as Moerella donacina and Varicorbula gibba (Bivalvia) were most abundant at farm sites, whereas Chondrochelia savignyi (Tanaidacea) and Apseudopsis latreillii (Tanaidacea) were dominant at control sites. Ecological differences between Güllük Gulf and Bozburun bay, as well as between farm and control sites, were evident, with faunal abundance at farm sites showing stronger correlations with environmental variables, including orthophosphate, silicate, and temperature. Biomass emerged as a key indicator for assessing ecological status, alongside abundance and species composition. Fish-farm capacity, as determined by the number of fish cages, played a significant role in shaping faunal patterns, with higher capacity farms exhibiting greater ecological disturbance. This study provides a crucial baseline for future research on the long-term ecological impacts of fish farming, including ecosystem recovery and the role of environmental variables. The findings suggest the importance of incorporating biomass-based indicators and considering farm capacity and site-specific conditions in fish-farming management strategies to mitigate environmental degradation.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于土耳其爱琴海沿岸Güllük湾和Bozburun湾鱼类养殖场迁移前的基线调查数据，比较了养殖场站点与对照站点大型底栖甲壳类和软体动物群落差异。共鉴定甲壳类114种、软体动物54种（养殖场站点）对88种和52种（对照站点），养殖场站点以双壳类Moerella donacina和Varicorbula gibba为优势种，对照站点以端足类Chondrochelia savignyi和Apseudopsis latreillii为主。养殖场站点动物丰度与环境变量（正磷酸盐、硅酸盐、温度）相关性更强，生物量可作为评估生态状况的关键指标，养殖容量（网箱数量）越大生态扰动越明显。研究强调在鱼类养殖管理策略中应纳入基于生物量的指标并考虑养殖容量和站点特异性条件。

papers.title: Global, depth-resolved marine fish occurrences from digitized natural history collections
papers.authors: Singer, Randal A.; Owens, Hannah L.
papers.summary_cn: 基于数字化自然历史馆藏构建了全球、按深度解析的海洋鱼类出现记录数据集，为海洋鱼类分布格局与生物多样性研究提供基础数据支撑。

papers.title: SAG-DETR: spatio-spectral adaptive gating with prompt-aware state-space refinement for underwater fish detection
papers.authors: Li, Guoyan; Zhang, Haochen; Mei, Yupeng; Liu, Meng; Yang, Ling
papers.summary_cn: 该研究提出SAG-DETR模型，用于水下鱼类检测，融合空间-光谱自适应门控与提示感知状态空间细化机制。模型旨在提升复杂水下环境中鱼类目标的检测精度与鲁棒性。

papers.title:
A Greener Acid-free
Microwave-Assisted Digestion Method
for Multielement Analysis of Fish Tissues by ICP–MS
papers.authors: Pereira, Marcos V. S.; Fonseca, Elisânia K. B.; de Jesus, Jemmyson R.; Arruda, Marco A. Z.
papers.abstract: Abstract Trace element monitoring in fish tissues requires reliable and sustainable sample preparation methods, particularly for complex biological matrices. In this study, an acid-free microwave-assisted digestion (AFMAD) method based exclusively on H2O2 was developed and optimized for multielement determination in fish tissues by ICP–MS. A central composite design coupled with response surface methodology was employed to evaluate the influence of H2O2 concentration, ramp time, and digestion temperature on matrix decomposition efficiency using 100 mg of dry fish tissue subsamples throughout the method development. The optimized conditions consisted of 30% (v/v)H2O2, 8 min ramp time, a 20 min hold time and 240 °C, resulting in residual carbon contents below 20%, which indicates efficient oxidation of the organic matrix using H2O2 in the absence of HNO3. The analytical performance of the proposed method was evaluated using cod muscle certified reference material (BCR-422), providing recoveries ranging from 76 to 101% for Fe, Cu, Zn, Mn, As, and Cd. Excellent linearity was obtained for all analytes (R2 &gt; 0.990) within the 0–50 μg L–1 range. Limits of detection ranged from 0.0004 to 0.04 μg g–1, demonstrating suitable sensitivity for trace elemental analysis in fish matrices. The applicability of the method was demonstrated through the analysis of five commercial fish species collected in the Mariana-MG region. Concentrations of toxic elements were found in Megaleporinus conirostris (Cd, 0.003 mg kg–1) and Cichla ocellaris (As, 0.07 mg kg–1) and remained below the maximum limits established by Brazilian legislation. The proposed AFMAD method demonstrated satisfactory analytical performance for complex fish matrices while eliminating the use of concentrated mineral acids, reducing hazardous reagent consumption, and improving the sustainability characteristics of sample preparation procedures for elemental analysis.
papers.summary_cn: 研究开发了一种仅以H2O2为试剂的免酸微波消解（AFMAD）方法，结合ICP–MS用于鱼组织多元素分析，并通过中心复合设计优化了H2O2浓度、升温时间和消解温度。优化条件为30%（v/v）H2O2、8 min升温、20 min保持、240 °C，残碳率低于20%，表明无HNO3条件下有机基质被有效氧化。以鳕鱼肌肉标准参考物质BCR-422验证，Fe、Cu、Zn、Mn、As、Cd回收率为76–101%，检出限0.0004–0.04 μg g–1；应用于Mariana-MG地区5种商品鱼，有毒元素（Megaleporinus conirostris中Cd 0.003 mg kg–1、Cichla ocellaris中As 0.07 mg kg–1）均低于巴西法规限量。该方法在复杂鱼基质中分析性能良好，避免了浓矿物酸使用，提升了样品制备的可持续性。

papers.title: Spatial Heterogeneity and Ecological Risks of Microplastics in Freshwater Aquaculture Ponds Across Poyang Lake Basin
papers.authors: Yao, Na; Hu, Chao; Zhou, Yurou; Li, Jiaying; Zhang, Yuanyan; Wang, Qipei; Liu, Zugen; Zhang, Meng
papers.abstract: Freshwater aquaculture ponds are increasingly recognized as potential reservoirs and sources of microplastic (MP) pollution, yet the spatial heterogeneity and potential environmental drivers of MPs in inland aquaculture systems remain poorly understood. Water and surface-sediment samples were collected from 12 representative ponds in four regions of the Poyang Lake Basin (Jiangxi Province, China) during October–November 2022. MPs were extracted by density flotation and digestion and characterized by stereomicroscopy and Raman spectroscopy; spatial patterns were evaluated using one-way analysis of variance, principal component analysis, correlation analysis, and linear regression, and the polymer-related ecological risk was assessed with the polymer hazard index (PHI). MP abundances averaged 893.10 ± 87.61 items m−3 in surface water and 608.87 ± 186.68 items kg−1 dry weight in sediment; fibers dominated (about 51%), and 86.58–91.33% of particles measured 0.02–1 mm. Polyethylene (67.86%) and polypropylene (21.43%) dominated the water column, whereas polyamide (PA: 21.43%) was markedly enriched in sediment, and the first two principal components explained 90.0% of the total variance. MP abundance was positively associated with stocking density and with NH4+-N (r = 0.623, p < 0.05). PHl values indicated low polymer-related risk in the water column (mean: 8.79) but moderate risk in sediment (mean: 17.90). Sediment therefore acts as a long-term accumulation sink for denser and more hazardous polymers and warrants priority in monitoring and source-control strategies.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了鄱阳湖流域淡水养殖池塘中微塑料（MP）的空间异质性及生态风险，于2022年10—11月在4个区域的12口代表性池塘采集水体和表层沉积物样品，采用密度浮选、消解、显微观察和拉曼光谱进行MP表征，并结合ANOVA、PCA、相关分析和线性回归评估空间格局及聚合物危害指数（PHI）。结果显示，表层水MP丰度为893.10 ± 87.61 items m⁻³，沉积物为608.87 ± 186.68 items kg⁻¹干重，以纤维为主（约51%），86.58%–91.33%的颗粒粒径为0.02–1 mm；水体以聚乙烯（67.86%）和聚丙烯（21.43%）为主，沉积物中聚酰胺（PA）明显富集，前两个主成分解释90.0%的总方差。MP丰度与放养密度及NH₄⁺-N呈正相关（r = 0.623，p < 0.05）；PHI表明水体聚合物风险较低（均值8.79），沉积物为中等风险（均值17.90），沉积物是高密度及高危害聚合物的长期累积汇，应优先纳入监测和源头控制策略。

papers.title: Epidemiological surveillance reveals major pathogen dynamics in Brazilian Nile tilapia aquaculture from 2023 to 2025
papers.authors: Cardoso-Guimarães, Mateus; Fernandez-Alarcon, Miguel Frederico; Correa, Rodolfo; Miyoko-Natori, Mariene; Galetti, Renata; Brito de Souza, Adrielli; Squizatto, Ana Cristina; Silva, Rafael; Araújo de Almeida, Luana; Mota Sátiro, Thaise
papers.abstract: Introduction Brazil is among the world’s largest producers of Nile tilapia ( Oreochromis niloticus ), a species increasingly challenged by a complex of cocirculating pathogens that threatens production sustainability. Methods We conducted a structured epidemiological surveillance program across the three main tilapia-producing macro-regions of Brazil (Southeast, Central-West, and Northeast) between 2023 and 2025. A total of 26,057 diagnostic samples, generating 68,514 pathogen-specific tests, were analyzed for Aeromonas spp., Edwardsiella spp., Flavobacterium spp., Francisella orientalis , Infectious Spleen and Kidney Necrosis Virus (ISKNV), Lactococcus spp., and Streptococcus spp. using standardized bacteriological, real-time PCR, and MALDI-TOF MS protocols, and antimicrobial susceptibility (minimum inhibitory concentration, MIC) was determined for four antimicrobials. Generalized linear models (with a farm-clustered mixed-model sensitivity analysis), time-series analysis (ADF stationarity, ARIMA), co-detection network analysis, and Gamma-log MIC modelling were applied. Results The cumulative overall detection positivity rate (DPR) was 18.1%, with Flavobacterium spp. showing the highest cumulative positivity (21.6%) on the smallest testing base, and Lactococcus spp. (18.4%), ISKNV (23.3%), and Streptococcus spp. (15.2%) representing the dominant, most widely sampled agents; S. agalactiae serotype Ia was not detected by serotype-specific qPCR. Detection was structured principally by macro-region and pathogen-specific temporal dynamics, whereas host developmental stage exerted a heterogeneous, generally weak influence. Five of the seven pathogens showed stationary, endemically compatible dynamics; Streptococcus spp. was non-stationary, consistent with active geographic expansion into the Northeast, whereas non-stationarity in Flavobacterium spp. reflected sampling instability rather than directional change. Quarterly aggregation minimized forecast error among the frequencies evaluated. Co-detection was predominantly independent, with only a weak module linking the three dominant agents. Antimicrobial resistance was structured by pathogen and antibiotic, with significant pathogen-specific interactions, and the fry stage showed higher MICs. Discussion These findings reframe the historically Streptococcus -centered view of Brazilian tilapia health and, within the constraints of a structured but non-probabilistic design, provide a descriptive, data-driven baseline to inform regionalized early-warning systems and rational antimicrobial stewardship in Brazilian tilapia aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究于2023—2025年在巴西三大罗非鱼主产区开展结构化流行病学监测，对26,057份诊断样本进行68,514项病原特异性检测，覆盖Aeromonas spp.、Edwardsiella spp.、Flavobacterium spp.、Francisella orientalis、ISKNV、Lactococcus spp.和Streptococcus spp.，并结合广义线性模型、时间序列分析、共检出网络分析及MIC建模。总体检出阳性率为18.1%，Lactococcus spp.、ISKNV和Streptococcus spp.为采样最广泛的主要病原；检出格局主要由宏观区域和病原特异性时间动态决定，Streptococcus spp.呈非平稳动态，提示其向东北部活跃扩散。共检出以独立发生为主，抗菌药物耐药性因病原和药物而异，鱼苗阶段MIC较高。研究结果重塑了巴西罗非鱼健康以Streptococcus为中心的传统认识，为区域化早期预警和合理抗菌药物管理提供数据驱动基线。

papers.title: Behrangi’s The Little Black Fish: A Tale of Endless Resistance and Resilience
papers.authors: Şencan, Selin
papers.journal: Cankaya University Journal of Humanities and Social Sciences
papers.abstract: Reading Samad Behrangi’s The Little Black Fish (1968) as a children’s story of political and philosophical significance, this article examines how the fish’s movement from the pond toward the sea reconfigures relations among space, authority, and agency. Drawing on Beauvais’s distinction between adult authority and child might, the article argues that resistance develops as the younger subject tests inherited knowledge across changing spatial and social conditions. The pond establishes an enclosed order sustained by inherited knowledge and collective conformity, whereas the fish’s departure brings it into encounters that alter its understanding and capacity to act. The sea intensifies this tension by combining expanded mobility with continuing exposure to capture and violence. The article also considers the story’s framing structure, in which the grandmother fish recounts the journey to a younger generation and one red fish remains awake thinking about the sea. This final act of transmission gives the narrative a pedagogical dimension. The article argues that The Little Black Fish presents resistance as a relational process produced through questioning, encounter, and collective action, while resilience emerges through the capacity to retain, adapt, and reactivate knowledge across changing spatial conditions. Beauvais’s account of authority and child might consequently intersects with the tale’s changing geographies where agency develops through what the younger subject learns, carries forward, and makes usable under circumstances that could not have been anticipated in advance.
