papers.title: Physics-informed LSTMNet for short-term marine buoy trajectory prediction under dynamic ocean environmental conditions
papers.authors: Zhou, Tianrui; Wang, Jinggai; Li, Hao
papers.abstract: Introduction Marine buoys are essential aids to navigation, yet their positions can vary continuously under dynamic environmental forcing. It is therefore important for navigational safety, maintenance planning, and reducing search-and-recovery costs to achieve accurate short-term prediction of buoy displacement. Physics-based models often depend on accurately specified hydrodynamic and meteorological parameters, whereas many existing data-driven approaches employ shallow, unidirectional recurrent architectures that may not fully capture the temporal context embedded in historical observations. Methods To address these limitations, this study proposes LSTMNet, a two-layer bidirectional long short-term memory network for next-step buoy trajectory prediction. The model learns temporal dependencies from multivariate buoy observations and predicts future buoy positions under dynamic marine conditions. Results The model was evaluated using hourly observations collected from a marine buoy during May 2026. On the held-out test set, LSTMNet achieved a mean geodesic distance error of 18.297 m, representing a 9.747% reduction relative to a single-layer unidirectional LSTM baseline. These results indicate that combining stacked recurrent learning with bidirectional temporal encoding improves the extraction of contextual dependencies from recent observations and enhances short-term buoy trajectory prediction. Discussion The proposed framework provides a practical data-driven approach for forecasting buoy displacement and may support safer and more efficient management of marine navigation infrastructure.
papers.summary_cn: 针对动态海洋环境条件下浮标位置持续漂移、基于物理模型依赖精确参数且现有数据驱动方法多为浅层单向结构的问题，本研究提出LSTMNet——一种双层双向长短期记忆网络，利用多变量浮标观测数据学习时间依赖关系并预测下一时刻浮标位置。基于2026年5月某海洋浮标逐时观测数据的测试表明，LSTMNet的平均测地距离误差为18.297 m，较单层单向LSTM基线降低9.747%，说明堆叠循环学习与双向时间编码相结合可更有效提取近期观测中的上下文依赖。该框架为浮标位移预测提供了实用的数据驱动方法，有望支持海上导航基础设施的安全高效管理。

papers.title: Electrophysiological Evaluation of Paralytic Shellfish Toxins in Bivalves
papers.authors: Yonekura, Runa; Numano, Satoshi; Watanabe, Ryuichi; Yoshida, Ikkei; Obara, Fumiko; Okumura, Junko; Cho, Yuko; Kudo, Yuta; Nagasawa, Kazuo; Yotsu-Yamashita, Mari
papers.abstract: Paralytic shellfish toxins (PSTs) represented by saxitoxin (STX) are lethal; pre-shipment toxicity testing of shellfish is mandatory. In Japan, screening methods that reliably guarantee toxin concentrations below shipment regulatory limits (0.8 mg STX·2HCl eq./kg) are permitted. In this study, we aimed to develop an electrophysiological method for PSTs by utilizing their property of inhibiting voltage-gated sodium channels (Nav) expressed in mouse neuroblastoma Neuro 2a cells. In addition to the three reference standards of dcSTX, GTX2/3, and C1/2, extracts from the digestive glands of toxic Patinopecten yessoensis and those from the whole edible parts of P. yessoensis, Mimachlamys nobilis, Perna viridis, and Mytilus galloprovincialis were tested. As a result, the toxicity required to inhibit Nav by 50% was 1–4 µg STX·2HCl eq./kg, which was well below the shipment regulatory limits and roughly consistent across the three reference standards and all the bivalve extracts. A calibration curve was constructed by globally fitting the dose–response curves obtained from electrophysiological experiments using various bivalve extracts. The electrophysiological toxicity of each extract was then estimated using this calibration curve. The correlation coefficient (r) between the electrophysiological toxicity and the toxicity determined by LC-MS/MS was 0.90. Thus, these findings provide fundamental insights for establishing an electrophysiological screening method for PSTs.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在利用麻痹性贝类毒素（PSTs）抑制小鼠神经母细胞瘤Neuro 2a细胞电压门控钠通道（Nav）的特性，开发一种电生理检测方法。以dcSTX、GTX2/3和C1/2三种标准品及虾夷扇贝（Patinopecten yessoensis）消化腺、虾夷扇贝可食部、Mimachlamys nobilis、Perna viridis和Mytilus galloprovincialis全可食部提取物进行测试，抑制Nav 50%所需毒性为1–4 µg STX·2HCl eq./kg，远低于出货限量，且各标准品与贝类提取物间基本一致。基于全局拟合剂量-反应曲线构建校准曲线估算各提取物电生理毒性，其与LC-MS/MS测定毒性的相关系数r为0.90。研究为建立PSTs电生理筛查方法提供了基础依据。

papers.title: Pelatihan dan Pendampingan Scotch Fish Egg sebagai Menu Fusion Berbasis Ikan Lokal di Yogi Café & Resto, Pulau Merah, Banyuwangi
papers.authors: Rudi Tri Handoko; Diana Martalia; Yulianandaris Yulianandaris; Nur Wulan Indah Sari; Ary Manis Anggreni; Neza Aulia Efendi
papers.journal: Pandawa : Pusat Publikasi Hasil Pengabdian Masyarakat
papers.abstract: Yogi Café & Resto in the Pulau Merah tourism area, Banyuwangi, faced low ratings (3.5) due to long production times, inconsistent taste, limited menu innovation, and the absence of Standard Operating Procedures (SOP). This community service aimed to enhance the partner’s capacity through training and mentoring in processing Scotch Fish Egg as a fusion menu based on local fish. A participatory method with an experiential learning approach was applied through theoretical sessions and hands-on practice on April 28, 2026, followed by a Demi Chef competency test on May 1, 2026. The training involved ten participants consisting of the owner and operational staff of Yogi Café & Resto; two participants took the competency test. Evaluation instruments included pre-test/post-test, practical checklist, simple sensory observation, production-time observation, and the Demi Chef competency test. The results showed that participants who joined the practice were able to produce Scotch Fish Egg with a crispy exterior, soft interior, and no fishy odor. The provision of standard recipes and SOP served as written references expected to improve taste consistency and production efficiency. Two participants passed the Demi Chef competency test conducted with the Professional Certification Institute (LSP) PGSP; this result is not generalized to all partner staff. This innovation has the potential to become a signature menu, enhancing business competitiveness and supporting creative economy development and sustainable utilization of local fish resources.
papers.summary_cn: 该社区服务研究针对Banyuwangi Pulau Merah旅游区Yogi Café & Resto因出餐慢、口味不稳定、菜单创新不足及缺乏SOP导致评分偏低（3.5）的问题，通过参与式方法与体验式学习开展Scotch Fish Egg融合菜单加工培训与辅导。2026年4月28日进行理论授课与实操，5月1日开展Demi Chef能力测试，共10名业主及运营人员参加，其中2人参加测试。结果显示学员能制作出外酥内嫩、无鱼腥味的Scotch Fish Egg，标准配方与SOP的提供有望提升口味一致性与生产效率，2名学员通过LSP PGSP的Demi Chef能力测试（结果未推广至全体人员）。该创新有望成为招牌菜单，提升企业竞争力并促进本地鱼类资源的可持续利用。

papers.title: Biodiversity supports coastal nutrient cycling with a stable source of fish excretion
papers.authors: Subalusky, Amanda L.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
papers.summary_cn: 该研究探讨生物多样性对沿海营养循环的支撑作用，重点关注鱼类排泄物作为稳定营养来源的贡献。基于标题推断，可能通过比较不同生物多样性水平下鱼类排泄养分供给的稳定性，揭示多样性维持营养循环功能的机制。

papers.title: Detection and Characterization of Microplastics and Other Anthropogenic Particles in Seafood from Southern Thailand Markets
papers.authors: Saetang, Jirakrit; Benjakul, Soottawat; Mittal, Ajay; Nuthong, Pornpot; Singh, Avtar
papers.abstract: Market-sold seafood can integrate anthropogenic particles (APs) including artificial solid/microparticles from aquatic environments and introduced during capture, transport, storage, or retail handling. This study found visually suspected fiber-like or film-like particles in edible tissues of seven different widely consumed seafood commodities procured from three different fish markets of Southern Thailand. The mass-weighted market abundances were 0.382, 0.359, and 0.507 suspected fiber-like items g−1 wet tissue for Pattani, Songkhla, and Narathiwat, respectively. Among the different seafoods, seabass, black pomfret, green mussel, trevally, threadfin bream, short mackerel, and Pacific white shrimp showed the combined abundance of 0.681 items g−1, 0.545 items g−1, 0.477 items g−1, 0.396 items g−1, 0.393 items g−1, 0.287 items g−1, and 0.131 items g−1 of fiber-like items. In addition, clustered film-like particles were also observed in shrimp and short mackerel, but overlapping prevented complete enumeration. Raman spectroscopy classified two representative particles as probable poly(ethylene terephthalate), three as probable cellulose acetate, eight as cellulosic, one contained an indigo-type colorant without substrate identification, and seven were inconclusive. SEM supported fiber-/line-like and sheet-/film-like morphology. The location and seafood group patterns are therefore descriptive estimates of visually suspected particles including microplastics, cellulosic materials, etc.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究检测了泰国南部三个鱼市七种常见海产品可食组织中的疑似人为颗粒（APs），质量加权丰度在0.359–0.507 items g⁻¹湿重之间，其中海鲈和黑鲳较高、太平洋白虾最低。Raman光谱鉴定部分颗粒为 probable poly(ethylene terephthalate、cellulose acetate及cellulosic材料，SEM确认了纤维状和膜状形态。结果为该区域海产品中微塑料及纤维素类颗粒的污染水平提供了描述性基线数据。

papers.title: Management implications of misspecification in observed recreational removals for reef fish and coastal pelagic stocks
papers.authors: Peterson, Cassidy D; Sagarese, Skyler R; Vaughan, Nathan R.; Smith, Matthew W.; Denson, LaTreese; Siegfried, Kate I.
papers.journal: Canadian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Sciences
papers.abstract: Recreational removals of fishes are particularly challenging to estimate accurately. A recent pilot study indicated that U.S. East Coast recreational removals may be overestimated by 30-40%, which is concerning in the Southeast, where recreational removals often exceed commercial. Management strategy evaluation was used to identify the management implications of recreational removal misspecification on nine reef and coastal pelagic fishes in the U.S. Gulf of America. The R package SSMSE was used to test performance of “Status Quo” management across seven removal misspecification scenarios. When recreational removals were misspecified, absolute stock magnitude was not estimated accurately. However, relative status reference points were generally well estimated when there was constant or randomly varying misspecification (representative relative index of removals), such that Status Quo management was still able to meet biomass, exploitation, and yield targets. The ability to identify reference points and manage the stock was adversely impacted by abrupt shifts or annually time-varying trends in misspecification (non-representative index of removals). Results emphasize that a relative index of recreational removals is generally sufficient to successfully manage a stock.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究利用 management strategy evaluation（R package SSMSE）评估休闲渔业渔获量误估对美国墨西哥湾九种礁鱼和近海pelagic鱼类种群管理的影响，测试“Status Quo”管理在七种误估情景下的表现。结果表明，当误估为恒定或随机变化时，绝对种群规模估计不准确，但相对状态参考点通常可较好估计，管理仍能满足生物量、开发率和产量目标；而误估发生突变或呈年际时间趋势时，参考点识别与管理能力受到不利影响。研究强调，相对休闲渔获量指数通常足以支撑种群的成功管理。

papers.title: Molecular and morphological identification of yellow tonguefish ( Symphurus williamsi ) and darkcheek tonguefish ( Symphurus chabanaudi ) at the southern and entrance to the Gulf of California
papers.authors: Camacho‐Gastélum, Rosabel; Sánchez‐Velasco, Laura; Jiménez‐Rosenberg, Sylvia P. A.; García‐Rodríguez, Francisco J.; Díaz‐Viloria, Noé
papers.abstract: Abstract The genus Symphurus is a group of demersal fish with high diversity and taxonomic challenges during their early development. This study addressed the morphological and molecular identification of Symphurus larvae in La Bahía de la Paz and the entrance to the Gulf of California. Zooplankton samples were collected during the day and night at 58 stations in October 2022. Based on morphological characteristics such as meristics and pigmentation, seven Symphurus morphotypes were pre‐classified and genetically analysed using the mitochondrial genes cytochrome c oxidase subunit I (COI) and 16S rRNA (16S). Genetic analysis identified four morphotypes: three of them corresponded to a single species, Symphurus williamsi , with 100% similarity in the 16S gene, while the other morphotype was identified as Symphurus chabanaudi , with 100% similarity in both markers (COI and 16S). The pigmentation patterns described after molecular identification were consistent and allowed differentiation between the two species. S. williamsi presented three to five strongly stellate melanophores on the dorsal side and five to six melanophores on the ventral side during the preflexion to postflexion stages, while S. chabanaudi had three prominent melanophores in the central part of the notochord (lateral line), as well as a series of small melanophores positioned on the dorsal and ventral sides. S. williamsi larvae were located throughout the entire entrance to the Gulf of California, mainly in Transitional Water, while Symphurus chabanaudi was collected only in La Bahía de la Paz in Gulf of California Water. These results demonstrated that the integration of genetic and morphological tools is fundamental in taxonomic studies of ichthyoplankton, particularly for the identification of species in early developmental stages that exhibit high morphological similarity. In addition, water masses might be a signal of spawning habitat of different species.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对墨西哥拉巴斯湾及加利福尼亚湾入口海域的舌鳎属（Symphurus）仔鱼，结合形态学（计数特征与色素模式）和分子标记（COI、16S rRNA）进行种类鉴定。遗传分析将7个形态型归并为4个分子型，分别对应Symphurus williamsi（16S 100%相似）和S. chabanaudi（COI与16S均100%相似），并据此描述了两种仔鱼在屈曲前至屈曲后阶段可区分的色素特征。S. williamsi仔鱼广泛分布于加利福尼亚湾入口的Transitional Water，而S. chabanaudi仅见于拉巴斯湾的Gulf of California Water，提示水团类型可能反映不同种类的产卵生境。结果表明，遗传与形态工具的结合对早期发育阶段形态相似鱼卵仔鱼的分类鉴定至关重要。

papers.title: Fish symbolism in the Indus Civilisation: an ideographic reading of the fish sign as the soulof the deceased.
papers.authors: Ramasami, Jeyakumar
papers.abstract: After the jar sign, the fish sign is the most frequently attested element in the known corpus of Indus inscriptions; together with its graphic variants, it accounts for an estimated 10 percent of all recorded signs. Despite this prominence, no consensus exists on its meaning, and the widely repeated reading of the sign as 'star' is contested. (1) It leaves unexplained why such a complex pictogram would render such a common and abstract idea. This article develops an alternative ideographic hypothesis: that the fish sign denotes the soul of a deceased person, and more specifically the ancestral soul (Sanskrit piṭṛ, 'forefather'). The argument draws on three independent strands of evidence: Indus seal iconography; comparative funerary symbolism in Mesopotamia, Egypt, Syria, and the Greek world; and the fish iconography of the Mesolithic–Neolithic site of Lepenski Vir in the Danube Gorges. This paper offers a proposed reading of an Indus seal depicting a ritual fish-pit, using it as a case study. It argues that a funerary reading explains the sign's high frequency and its association with aquatic and ancestral imagery more economically than a stellar reading.
papers.summary_cn: 本文针对印度河文明印章中高频出现的鱼形符号，质疑其被广泛接受的“星”之义，提出鱼符号象形表意的新假说，即鱼象征死者之灵，尤指祖灵（梵语 piṭṛ）。论证综合印度河印章图像学、美索不达米亚、埃及、叙利亚及希腊世界的比较丧葬象征，以及多瑙河峡谷 Lepenski Vir 遗址的中石器至新石器时代鱼图像三方面证据，并以一枚描绘仪式性鱼坑的印章为案例进行分析。作者认为，丧葬解读比星辰解读更能经济地解释该符号的高频出现及其与水生和祖先意象的关联。

papers.title: Hybrid Wind–Solar-Powered Smart Fish Feeding For Sustainable Aquaculture
papers.authors: M Habib Aulia; Dewi, Tresna; Bow, Yohandri
papers.journal: AJARCDE (Asian Journal of Applied Research for Community Development and Empowerment)
papers.abstract: This research evaluated the performance of a hybrid photovoltaic (PV) and vertical-axis wind turbine (VAWT) energy system to power a smart fish feeding system and support sustainable aquaculture. The study used a quantitative experimental approach based on a Design and Development (D&D) methodology, collecting data over a 20-day period from April 28 to May 17, 2026, between 10:00 a.m. and 2:00 p.m. Western Indonesian Time (WIB) in Lubuk Bakung, Palembang, South Sumatra, Indonesia. The measured parameters included solar irradiance, wind speed, PV power, wind turbine power, hybrid system input power, output power, battery performance, and operational reliability. The results showed that an average solar irradiance of 611.26 W/m² produced an average PV power of 195.60 W, while an average wind speed of 2.64 m/s produced an average wind turbine power of 65.78 W. The hybrid system produced an average input power of 256.52 W, with an average system efficiency of 2.76%. The battery had a usable energy capacity of 192 Wh and provided approximately 6.40 hours of theoretical operational autonomy. During the experimental period, all 40 scheduled feeding operations were successfully completed, resulting in a 100% operational reliability rate. These findings show that integrating PV and VAWT technologies can provide an adequate, reliable standalone renewable energy supply for automatic fish feeding systems and support energy-efficient, sustainable aquaculture operations. Contribution to Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs):SDG 7 – Affordable and Clean EnergySDG 9 – Industry, Innovation and InfrastructureSDG 14 – Life Below Water
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了光伏（PV）与垂直轴风力机（VAWT）混合能源系统驱动智能投饵机的性能，在印尼南苏门答腊进行了为期20天的实地测试，监测辐照度、风速、发电功率及电池性能等参数。结果显示，平均辐照度611.26 W/m²下PV平均功率195.60 W，平均风速2.64 m/s下风力机平均功率65.78 W，混合系统平均输入功率256.52 W，系统效率2.76%，电池可用容量192 Wh，理论续航约6.40小时。实验期内40次计划投饵全部完成，运行可靠性达100%，表明PV-VAWT混合供电可为自动投饵系统提供可靠独立的可再生能源，支撑节能型可持续水产养殖。

papers.authors: Ma, Xiaoli; Su, Baofeng; Ye, Anxin; Wan, Renyu; Zhao, Keyan; Zhong, Liang; Yu, Wenxin; Liu, Yuhe; Wu, Jinyi; Cai, Wenlong
papers.abstract: Abstract Largemouth bass ( Micropterus salmoides ) is a globally significant freshwater aquaculture species known for its rapid growth, high‐quality flesh and excellent nutritional value. Given the increasing incidence of hypoxia in its aquaculture setting, understanding the molecular mechanisms underlying gill adaptation to hypoxic stress is critical for improving resilience in this species. To achieve this, we employed full‐length transcript sequencing using PacBio Iso‐Seq and high‐throughput Illumina RNA‐Seq to construct a comprehensive transcriptome profile. Histological analyses revealed apparent structural alterations in gill tissues under hypoxic stress (dissolved oxygen: 2.0 ± 0.5 mg/L, duration: 96 h), including curved and swollen gill filaments, apoptosis and epithelial cell vacuolation. Comparative transcriptomic analysis revealed pronounced shifts in the expression of genes involved in energy metabolism, angiogenesis, immune responses, cell proliferation and apoptosis. Notably, the down‐regulation of genes associated with cell cycle and proliferation suggests that M. salmoides may conserve energy by suppressing cell division under hypoxic conditions. In contrast, the increased expression of apoptosis‐related genes, including casp7 , indicates that apoptosis may play a protective role in maintain tissue homeostasis under hypoxia. Furthermore, the suppression of chemokine‐mediated immune pathways implies that hypoxia redirects energy toward essential metabolic processes at the cost of local immune responses. GO and KEGG enrichment analyses identified TNF‐α and chemokine‐mediated signalling pathways as key pathways involved in tissue homeostasis and adaptive responses to hypoxic stress. These findings enhance our understanding of the mechanisms underlying hypoxia adaptation and provide valuable genetic resources for breeding strategies aimed at enhancing hypoxia tolerance in M. salmoides .
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在解析大口黑鲈（Micropterus salmoides）鳃组织对低氧胁迫的适应机制。采用PacBio Iso-Seq全长转录组测序与Illumina RNA-Seq高通量测序相结合，并配合组织学分析，在溶解氧2.0 ± 0.5 mg/L、胁迫96 h条件下进行比较转录组研究。组织学结果显示鳃丝弯曲肿胀、细胞凋亡及上皮细胞空泡化等明显结构改变；转录组分析发现能量代谢、血管生成、免疫应答、细胞增殖与凋亡相关基因表达显著变化，细胞周期与增殖相关基因下调提示通过抑制细胞分裂节约能量，凋亡相关基因（如casp7）上调可能在维持组织稳态中起保护作用，趋化因子介导的免疫通路受抑制表明低氧将能量优先分配至关键代谢过程。GO与KEGG富集分析确定TNF-α及趋化因子介导的信号通路为组织稳态与低氧适应应答的关键通路，为耐低氧育种提供了遗传资源。

papers.title: Trans‐Basin Climate Events Modify Distribution and Catchability of Large and Small Size Classes of Bigeye Tuna ( Thunnus obesus ) in the Indian Ocean
papers.authors: Xu, Zhenqi; Liu, Yang
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The sustainability of global tuna fisheries exhibits regional divergence, with some stocks showing significant recovery while Indian Ocean bigeye tuna ( Thunnus obesus ) remains overfished. Particularly against the backdrop of intensifying global climate change, both large and small size classes of bigeye tuna are experiencing shifts in distribution and catch rate patterns influenced by trans‐basin climate events. This study focuses on the effects of trans‐basin climate change on the resource dynamics of bigeye tuna in the Indian Ocean, comprehensively considering the differing responses of large and small size classes to environmental changes. We systematically examined the causal relationship between trans‐basin climate events and tuna resource fluctuations by integrating fishery and climate data using the Convergent Cross‐Mapping (CCM) method. Concurrently, the Climate Events Synergy Model (CESM) was employed to analyze the interactions between these climate factors and the Indian Ocean Dipole (IOD) in shaping tuna habitat suitability. Results indicate that different trans‐basin climate events exert heterogeneous impacts on large and small size classes of bigeye tuna by altering water temperature, nutrient transport, and circulation patterns, and these events affect the resource dynamics in conjunction with the IOD. This study provides scientific evidence for elucidating the mechanisms underlying tuna resource fluctuations under multi‐scale climate drivers in the Indian Ocean, holding significant implications for formulating climate‐specific fisheries management strategies and addressing climate change challenges.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究整合渔业与气候数据，采用收敛交叉映射（CCM）方法系统解析跨洋盆气候事件与印度洋大眼金枪鱼（Thunnus obesus）资源波动的因果关系，并构建气候事件协同模型（CESM）分析气候因子与印度洋偶极子（IOD）对栖息地适宜性的交互作用。结果表明，不同跨洋盆气候事件通过改变水温、营养盐输运和环流格局，对大小两个体型的分布与捕获率产生异质性影响，并与IOD协同驱动资源变动。研究为多尺度气候驱动下印度洋金枪鱼资源波动机制提供了科学依据，对制定气候适应性渔业管理策略具有重要意义。

papers.title: Enhancing the hardness of low-carbon steel by pack carburizing using shellfish shell powder as a calcium carbonate activator
papers.authors: Adri, Junil; Parmanoan, Durain; Refdinal, Refdinal; Jasman, Jasman; Rahim, Bulkia; Marlianna, Meri; Sern, Lai Chee
papers.abstract: This study investigates the potential of shellfish shell powder as a natural source of calcium carbonate (CaCO₃) for improving the pack carburizing of AISI 1020 low-carbon steel. AISI 1020 Low-carbon steel is commonly used in engineering applications because of its favorable mechanical properties and machinability; however, its relatively low surface hardness may limit its wear resistance. Carburization was performed at 950 °C for 6 h using three conditions: an untreated control, charcoal only, and a mixture of charcoal shellfish shell powder. Surface characterization was conducted using FE-SEM/EDS, while hardness was evaluated using the Brinell Hardness test. The charcoal-shellfish shell powder specimen achieved the highest average hardness (481.44 BHN), which was significantly higher than those of the charcoal specimen (387.40 BHN) and the control specimen (216.77 BHN) (p < 0.001). FE-SEM observations showed that the charcoal–shellfish shell powder specimen exhibited distinct surface morphology, while EDS analysis revealed a higher surface carbon concentration and the presence of calcium, indicating a more effective carburizing environment than the charcoal-only treatment. These findings indicate that the shellfish shell powder effectively enhanced hardness, resulting in the formation of a carbon-enriched surface. The novelty of this study lies in the use of shellfish shell powder derived from shell waste as an alternative natural activator, and in the quantitative validation its effectiveness through statistical analysis, demonstrating its potential as a cost-effective and environmentally sustainable substitute for conventional carburizing activators.
papers.summary_cn: 以贝壳粉作为碳酸钙活化剂对AISI 1020低碳钢进行固体渗碳，在950 °C下处理6小时，比较未处理对照、仅木炭及木炭-贝壳粉混合三种条件。木炭-贝壳粉组表面平均硬度最高（481.44 BHN），显著高于仅木炭组（387.40 BHN）和对照组（216.77 BHN）（p < 0.001）；FE-SEM/EDS显示该组表面形貌独特、碳浓度更高并检出钙，表明渗碳环境更有效。研究表明贝壳粉可有效提高渗碳钢表面硬度，为传统渗碳活化剂提供了一种低成本、环境可持续的替代方案。

papers.title: Resources of mesopelagic fish in the Far Eastern Seas and adjacent Pacific waters of Russia: untapped potential for domestic fisheries
papers.authors: Ivanov, Oleg A.; Radchenko, Vladimir I.; Baitaliuk, Alexey A.
papers.abstract: Based on the authors’ personal experience, archival data, and literature sources, a brief overview for status of the mesopelagic fish stocks in the Far Eastern Seas of Russia and adjacent waters of the Pacific Ocean is presented. Unexploited biomass of the midwater species, as a biotopic group, amounts to 50[.] 10[6] to 80[.] 10[6] t that constitutes a substantial resource base for the national fishing industry. Feasibility of bringing this resource into commercial fisheries is considered from the standpoint of comprehensive assessment of ecological and economic sustainability of such fishery, including the fishing gear and the catch processing. Long-term researches of biological resource in the mesopelagic domain are implied.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究基于作者经验、档案数据和文献，概述了俄罗斯远东海域及毗邻太平洋水域中层鱼类资源状况，指出该生物类群未开发生物量达5000万至8000万吨，构成国家渔业的重要资源基础。研究从生态与经济可持续性综合评估角度，探讨了将这一资源纳入商业渔业的可行性，涵盖渔具与渔获加工环节，并强调需对中层水域生物资源开展长期研究。

papers.title: Design and Thermal Performance Analysis of a Multilayer Coolbox with Polyurethane as the Primary Insulation for Portable Fish-Hold Applications
papers.authors: Kamal, Mustopa
papers.journal: INTERNATIONAL JOURNAL OF MULTIDISCIPLINARY RESEARCH AND ANALYSIS
papers.abstract: Post-harvest handling of fresh fish by small-scale fishermen is highly dependent on effective temperature control to minimize quality deterioration during storage and transportation. This study aimed to design, fabricate, and evaluate the thermal performance of a 70-L portable coolbox using rigid polyurethane foam as the primary thermal insulation material. The coolbox was constructed using a 3-cm-thick multilayer composite wall consisting of fiberglass (1.0 cm), meranti plywood (0.5 cm), aluminum foil (0.5 cm), and rigid polyurethane foam (1.0 cm). A rubber sealing strip and clamp locks were incorporated to reduce heat infiltration through the lid interface. Thermal performance was evaluated experimentally over 168 h under two loading conditions: 30 kg of block ice and a combination of 30 kg of block ice and 20 kg of fresh fish. A one-dimensional steady-state heat conduction model was also applied to estimate the thermal resistance and equivalent thermal conductivity of the composite wall. The results yielded a total thermal resistance of 0.4291 K/W and an equivalent thermal conductivity of 0.0606 W/(m·K). Polyurethane contributed approximately 84.15% of the total thermal resistance, indicating that it was the dominant insulating layer in the composite structure. During the first 72 h, the internal temperature remained within approximately 0–4 °C under both loading conditions. After 72 h, the internal temperature gradually increased as the ice load decreased, reaching 18–19 °C by the seventh day. The total material cost for fabricating one prototype was IDR 1,445,000. These findings indicate that the multilayer polyurethane-based coolbox can provide effective passive thermal insulation for short-term chilled fish storage in small-scale fishing operations.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究设计并制作了一种70 L便携式保温箱，以硬质聚氨酯泡沫为主要隔热材料，采用玻璃纤维、胶合板、铝箔和聚氨酯构成3 cm厚多层复合壁，并通过橡胶密封条和卡扣减少盖口热渗透。实验在30 kg块冰及30 kg块冰加20 kg鲜鱼两种装载条件下进行168 h热性能测试，同时建立一维稳态导热模型估算复合壁热阻与等效导热系数。结果显示总热阻为0.4291 K/W，等效导热系数为0.0606 W/(m·K)，聚氨酯贡献约84.15%的总热阻；前72 h箱内温度维持在约0–4 °C，之后随冰量减少逐渐升高，第7天达18–19 °C。该多层聚氨酯保温箱可为小规模捕捞作业的短期冰鲜鱼贮藏提供有效被动隔热。

papers.title:
Nanotechnology
Strategies to Mitigate Antimicrobial
Resistance in Fish Aquaculture Systems
papers.authors: Marques Chagas, Paulo Augusto; Campanharo, Sarah Chagas; Pinto, Guilherme Henrique Alves; Santos, Lucas David Rodrigues; de Freitas, Lucas Victor Pereira; Pilarski, Fabiana; Paschoal, Jonas Augusto Rizatto; Oliveira, Wanderley Pereira
papers.abstract: Abstract Aquaculture plays an increasingly important role in global food production, but intensive freshwater fish aquaculture still faces major challenges related to infectious diseases and the use of antimicrobials. Antimicrobials are commonly administered orally through medicated feed, a practice often compromised by drug leaching before ingestion, heterogeneous feed intake, and temperature- and species-dependent pharmacokinetic variability. These factors can generate heterogeneous antimicrobial exposure in fish, ranging from subtherapeutic concentrations to compensatory overdosing practices while simultaneously increasing the entry and persistence of antimicrobial residues in water and sediments, thereby creating selective pressure that favors the emergence and maintenance of antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in aquatic microbial communities. This integrative review focuses primarily on intensive freshwater fish aquaculture systems and examines how antimicrobial use contributes to AMR through interconnected pharmacological, microbiological, and environmental pathways. The review discusses how water temperature, fish physiology, feeding behavior, and dosing inconsistencies influence antimicrobial absorption, disposition, therapeutic performance, residue persistence, and resistance selection. Intrinsic, acquired, and adaptive resistance mechanisms are also discussed with emphasis on the role of environmental contamination in maintaining resistance reservoirs. Within this framework, the review analyzes nanoenabled strategies designed to address these bottlenecks, including drug delivery systems that improve control over drug administration, gastrointestinal stability, bioavailability, and release, as well as nanotechnologies for residue removal and environmental monitoring. By integrating host- and environment-oriented perspectives, this Review highlights how nanotechnology may help reduce antimicrobial dependence, limit selective pressure, and support more sustainable fish aquaculture within a One Health framework.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述聚焦集约化淡水鱼类养殖中抗菌药物使用与 antimicrobial resistance (AMR) 的关联，分析了经口给药因药物浸出、摄食不均及温度/物种依赖性药代动力学差异导致的暴露异质性，以及残留进入水体和沉积物形成的耐药选择压力。文章系统讨论了水温、鱼体生理、摄食行为和给药不一致性对药物吸收、残留持久性与耐药选择的影响，并阐述内在、获得性和适应性耐药机制及环境污染物在维持耐药库中的作用。在此基础上，综述评估了纳米递药系统（改善给药控制、胃肠道稳定性、生物利用度和释放）及纳米技术在残留去除与环境监测中的应用潜力，指出纳米技术可在 One Health 框架下减少抗菌药物依赖和选择压力。

papers.title: CRISPR-Based Functional Characterization of Immune Genes Associated Pathogen Resistance in Aquaculture Species
papers.authors: Abul Hassan Khan; Syed Abid Ali Shah; Hamza Hassan; Hassan Imran Afridi; Masood Shah; Jawaria Alvi; Kinza Ejaz; Ambareen
papers.journal: Kashmir Journal of Academic Research and Development
papers.abstract: Streptococcosis caused by Streptococcus agalactiae constitutes a serious challenge to Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) aquaculture with increased mortality and heavy economic burden. Elucidation of the underlying molecular mechanism in the host immune system is important for designing effective disease intervention strategies. In this experiment, the functions of three immune-related genes tlr2, myd88, and il1b on Nile tilapia defense response to S. agalactiae were analyzed using CRISPR-Cas9 technology. The in-silico screening of candidate guide RNA revealed a promising on-target efficiency (79.2-88.0%) and off-target specificity (88.5-95.0%) with il1b being the most favorable. The genome editing verified that all the selected target sites were successfully modified in 83.3% of fish per gene group. After infection, the expression of all three genes was significantly increased in the unedited fish while gene-edited groups exhibited transcriptional inhibition of their target genes. The gene-modified fish displayed lower immune downstream signaling, lower inflammatory markers, higher bacterial burden (6.50–7.00 log10 CFU/g), and lower survival rate (50.0-66.7%) than that of the controls (75.0%). From this integration, the functions of tlr2, myd88, and il1b were determined to be important and interconnected for innate immunity and pathogen defense mechanisms. This information confirms the suggested signaling model of TLR2-MyD88-IL-1β, where the disruption of these genes reduces resistance to S. agalactiae in Nile tilapia.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用CRISPR-Cas9技术对尼罗罗非鱼（Oreochromis niloticus）的tlr2、myd88和il1b三个免疫相关基因进行功能敲除，以解析其在抗无乳链球菌（Streptococcus agalactiae）感染中的作用。向导RNA的in-silico筛选显示良好的on-target效率（79.2–88.0%）和off-target特异性（88.5–95.0%），各基因组83.3%的个体成功实现基因组编辑。感染后基因编辑组靶基因转录受抑，下游免疫信号和炎症标志物降低，细菌载量升高（6.50–7.00 log10 CFU/g），存活率（50.0–66.7%）低于对照组（75.0%）。结果证实TLR2-MyD88-IL-1β信号通路在罗非鱼先天免疫和抗病菌防御中具有重要且相互关联的功能，敲除这些基因会降低宿主对无乳链球菌的抗性。

papers.title: Pattern of Fish Consumption among School-Going Children in Tribal Areas of Tapi District, Gujarat, India
papers.authors: Kartu, S. C.; Lende, S. R.; Tandel, D. C.; Vala, F. D.; Pithiya, K. G.
papers.abstract: The present study assessed fish consumption patterns, food preferences, and socioeconomic characteristics among school-going children in tribal areas of Tapi District, Gujarat. A total of 100 children aged 8–13 years from two schools in Bavali and Pipalkuwa villages of Ukai Taluka were surveyed using a structured interview schedule and Food Frequency Questionnaire (FFQ) during September 2026. The study population comprised 52% boys and 48% girls. Agriculture was the predominant occupation among parents, accounting for 80% of fathers and 70% of mothers, while fishing was reported as the occupation of 10% of fathers. Regarding household income, 55% of families were in the reported low-income category (Rs. 2,000–3,000 per month), 36% in the middle-income category (Rs. 3,000–4,000), and 9% in the high-income category (Rs. 6,000–10,000). Fish was highly accepted among the children, with 94% reporting a preference for fish. Among the reported non-vegetarian food choices, chicken accounted for 45%, fish for 40%, eggs for 10%, and mutton for 5%. Catla, Rohu, Pangasius, Tilapia, Mrigal, and rice fish were the major fish species reported as consumed. The findings indicate that fish constituted an important component of non-vegetarian food choices among the surveyed children despite the predominance of agricultural livelihoods and relatively low household income. However, reported fish preference should not be interpreted as evidence of adequate or frequent fish intake.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了印度古吉拉特邦Tapi地区部落学龄儿童的鱼类消费模式、食物偏好及社会经济特征，采用结构化访谈和食物频率问卷（FFQ）对两所学校的100名8–13岁儿童进行了调查。结果显示，94%的儿童表示喜欢鱼类，鱼类占非素食选择的40%，主要消费品种包括Catla、Rohu、Pangasius、Tilapia、Mrigal和rice fish。尽管农业为主要生计且家庭收入普遍偏低，鱼类仍是当地儿童非素食饮食的重要组成部分，但偏好并不等同于充足或频繁的摄入。

papers.title: Au nanoparticle-loaded mixed-valence MnOₓ nanosheets as an oxidase-like nanozyme for rapid colorimetric determination of leucomalachite green in fish and water
papers.authors: Lai, Huasheng; Fu, Fangsi; Zhu, Siyu; Xu, Meng
papers.summary_cn: 该研究开发了负载Au纳米粒子的混合价态MnOₓ纳米片作为类氧化酶nanozyme，用于鱼体和水样中leucomalachite green的快速比色检测。

papers.title: Microplastic contamination in commercially important marine fishes from the Sohar Coast, Sea of Oman: occurrence, characterization, and polymer composition
papers.authors: Al Kharusi, Iman; Dutta, Sachinandan
papers.summary_cn: 该研究针对阿曼海Sohar沿岸商业重要海鱼，调查微塑料污染的发生情况、特征及聚合物组成，以评估海产品微塑料暴露风险。

papers.title: Disrtibution and environments of habitat for kelp Agarum clathratum at the coast of Primorye
papers.authors: Kulepanov, Vladimir N.
papers.abstract: Distribution of brown seaweed Agarum clathratum and environmental conditions of the habitat in coastal waters of Primorye are analyzed on the data obtained in April-November from 2004 to 2021. The species was found along the whole coastline, mostly with the projective cover below 4 %. The local areas of its predominance with the projective cover up to 80 % were small and located on bedrock or large rock blocks. The maximum biomass of the agarum developed on boulders and shell deposits (up to 7.584 kg/m², on average 0.546–0.999 kg/m²).
papers.summary_cn: 基于2004—2021年4—11月滨海边疆区沿海调查数据，分析了褐藻Agarum clathratum的分布及其生境环境条件。该种沿整个海岸线分布，投影盖度多低于4%，仅在基岩或大岩块上形成小面积优势斑块（盖度可达80%）。最大生物量出现在砾石与贝壳沉积底质上（最高7.584 kg/m²，平均0.546–0.999 kg/m²）。

papers.title: One Rule to Rule them All: Hybrid Harvest Control Rules Improve Bio-Economic Outcomes in an MSE Framework
papers.authors: Zahner, Joshua A; Goethel, Daniel R.; Cunningham, Curry James; Cheng, Matthew LH.; Williams, Benjamin C; Kapur, Maia Sosa
papers.abstract: Ramped threshold harvest control rules (HCRs), which reduce fishing pressure as a stock declines, are generally resilient to environmental stochasticity, but can struggle to provide good management advice when confronted with abrupt shifts in productivity. For instance, long-lived species with spasmodic recruitment present management dilemmas due to long periods of low recruitment followed by short bursts of extreme productivity, potentially causing market saturation and poor economic conditions. Using management strategy evaluation, we evaluate the performance of a “hybrid” HCR that couples ramped threshold HCRs with stability constraints to limit quota variability and harvest caps to mitigate excessive quota increases, with the goal of identifying whether multiple simple modifications can improve HCR performance for spasmodic species. For long-lived species like Alaskan sablefish, we demonstrate that the hybrid HCR can improve economic value, stabilize catches, and increase population size and resilience compared to a ramped threshold HCR or application of either constraint in isolation. Thus, the hybrid HCR exhibits potential to improve population resilience and harvest opportunity for species with environmentally-driven dynamic recruitment.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过 management strategy evaluation 框架，评估将斜坡阈值 harvest control rule（HCR）与配额稳定性约束和渔获上限相结合的混合 HCR，能否改善具有间歇性补充特征的长寿命鱼种的管理表现。以阿拉斯加黑鳕为案例，结果表明混合 HCR 相比单一斜坡阈值 HCR 或单独施加任一约束，可提升经济价值、稳定渔获量，并增加种群规模和恢复力。该混合 HCR 对受环境驱动、补充量动态变化的鱼种具有改善种群恢复力和捕捞机会的潜力。

papers.title: Revealing potential Atlantic salmon bycatch hotspots from pelagic fisheries landings across the Northeast Atlantic
papers.authors: Borland, Aislinn; Elliott, Sophie; Gillson, Jonathan P.; Utne, Kjell; Banas, Neil; Toms, Simon; Tyldesley, Emma; Bárðarson, Hlynur; Bull, Colin
papers.abstract: Abstract Atlantic salmon ( Salmo salar ) marine survival has declined markedly over the past five decades, leading to concerns about future population viability. While many studies have explored the impacts of stressors such as climate change and predation, less is known about bycatch from pelagic fisheries targeting finfish species. This study, focused on the first few months of the salmon marine migration period, narrows down the space–time domains where pelagic fisheries bycatch is most likely to occur. Landings from an International Council for the Exploration of the Sea‐led data call were used to assess bycatch exposure. Temporal patterns of monthly landings of six commercially important pelagic finfish species (mackerel Scomber scombrus , herring Clupea harengus , horse mackerel Trachurus trachurus , sardine Sardina pilchardus , capelin Mallotus villosus , and chub mackerel Scomber colias ) within the Northeast Atlantic region from 2000 to 2022 were considered alongside reconstructed salmon migration regions. This study indicated that bycatch exposure from herring and mackerel fisheries was higher than that of other pelagic fisheries along the shared salmon migration corridor between April and August, with cumulative exposure highest over time for the herring fishery. Southern salmon populations were also exposed to the horse mackerel and sardine fisheries in April. Temporal patterns of monthly pelagic landings were compared with patterns of marine return rates in salmon index populations, but no consistent relationships were present. Quantifying salmon bycatch rates at sea remains challenging due to highly variable and sparse data but, given the severity of declines across their range, conservation measures that address factors affecting marine survival of salmon are urgently needed. Future investigations using emerging technology in the pelagic fisheries identified in this study could provide opportunities to develop more robust information on bycatch risk to Atlantic salmon stocks and to direct appropriate mitigation measures.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用ICES数据调用中2000—2022年东北大西洋六种中上层经济鱼类（鲭、鲱、竹筴鱼、沙丁鱼、毛鳞鱼、日本鲭）的月度上岸量数据，结合重建的大西洋鲑（Salmo salar）洄游区域，识别其海洋迁移早期阶段与中上层渔业重叠的时空热点。结果显示，4—8月鲱和鲭渔业与鲑共享洄游走廊，兼捕暴露高于其他渔业，其中鲱渔业累积暴露最高；南部鲑种群4月还面临竹筴鱼和沙丁鱼渔业的兼捕风险。月度上岸量与鲑海洋回归率之间无一致关系，但鉴于鲑种群普遍衰退，亟需针对影响其海洋存活的因素采取保护措施。

papers.title: Genome‐wide analysis of the caspase gene family in common carp ( C yprinus carpio ) and their transcriptional responses to nitrate exposure
papers.authors: Karadaş, Naime Filiz; Yaprak, Esra; Arslan, Harun; İlhan, Emre
papers.abstract: Abstract Caspases are a family of cysteine proteases that play essential roles in apoptosis, inflammation and cellular homeostasis. Despite their biological importance, the genomic organization and stress‐related functions of the caspase gene family remain insufficiently characterized in many teleost fish species. In the present study, a comprehensive genome‐wide analysis of the caspase gene family was conducted in common carp ( Cyprinus carpio ), and the transcriptional responses of selected caspase genes to nitrate‐induced stress were investigated. A total of 37 caspase genes were identified and classified into initiator, executioner and inflammatory groups based on phylogenetic relationships, conserved domain architecture and motif composition. Comparative genomic analyses revealed extensive gene family expansion associated with the allotetraploid genome structure of common carp, while synteny and duplication analyses supported the evolutionary conservation of caspase genes among teleosts. Structural characterization demonstrated the preservation of the conserved caspase catalytic domain and typical caspase protein architecture. Functional enrichment analyses indicated that Cc_CASP proteins are predominantly involved in apoptosis, programmed cell death, immune regulation and stress‐response pathways. Gene expression analyses further revealed tissue‐specific transcriptional responses to nitrate exposure, with several caspase genes showing significant differential expression in liver and brain tissues. These findings provide new insights into the evolution, structural diversity and functional roles of the caspase gene family in common carp and suggest that selected caspase genes may serve as potential molecular biomarkers for assessing environmental stress in freshwater ecosystems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究对鲤鱼（Cyprinus carpio）caspase基因家族进行了全基因组鉴定与分析，共鉴定出37个caspase基因，依据系统发育关系、保守结构域及基序组成划分为起始型、执行型和炎症型三类。比较基因组分析揭示该基因家族扩张与鲤鱼异源四倍体基因组结构相关，功能富集表明其参与凋亡、程序性细胞死亡及免疫调控等通路。硝酸盐暴露下，多个caspase基因在肝脏和脑组织中呈现组织特异性差异表达，提示其可作为评估淡水生态系统环境胁迫的潜在分子生物标志物。

papers.title: Global origins of tuna and billfish fisheries reveal the transition from coastal access to oceanic exploitation
papers.authors: Rick, Torben C.; Andrews, Adam J.; Béarez, Philippe; Festa, Marcella; Fossile, Thiago; Hudson, Mark; Janßen-Kim, Melanie; Juan-Jordá, Maria José; Lambrides, Ariana B. J.; LeFebvre, Michelle J.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
papers.abstract: Ocean ecosystems have played a crucial role in people’s lives around the world for millennia. However, questions persist about when, why, and how people first began removing biomass from offshore habitats and established fisheries in distant, oceanic environments. We explore the antiquity and evolution of tuna (Thunnini) and billfish (Istiophoridae/Xiphiidae) fisheries, two groups of fishes that occur around the world, are economically significant, and are ecologically important open ocean apex predators. The earliest archaeological evidence of fishing for tuna occurs ~44,000 years ago and billfish at ~10,000 years ago, with early fisheries for some tuna species appearing around the world by 3,000 to 1,000 years ago. Most early fisheries are in areas where tunas and billfishes could be accessed relatively close to shore (e.g., submarine canyons) and/or where these fishes may come inshore seasonally or during warm ocean events. Early tuna and billfish fisheries were often linked to ceremony/ritual, alongside advances in maritime technologies. With few exceptions, sustained and intensive commercial exploitation of pelagic predators in offshore and oceanic habitats is a late development in the human past, occurring primarily during the last 200 y. Our findings document a long-term continuum of human interactions with global marine ecosystems spanning thousands of years, including significant differences between the timing and pathways by which people became dominant ecological drivers in nearshore compared to offshore/oceanic ecosystems.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究探讨金枪鱼（Thunnini）和旗鱼（Istiophoridae/Xiphiidae）渔业的起源与演化，综合考古证据重建人类从近岸获取到远洋开发这一顶级捕食者的历史轨迹。最早的金枪鱼捕捞证据约出现于44,000年前，旗鱼约10,000年前，部分金枪鱼渔业的早期形态在3,000至1,000年前已在全球多地出现，且多集中于近岸可达或鱼类季节性近岸的区域，常与仪式活动和航海技术进步相关联。除少数例外，对远洋栖息地中上层捕食者的持续集约化商业开发主要是近200年的事。研究揭示了人类与全球海洋生态系统数千年互动的连续性，以及近岸与远洋生态系统被人类主导的时间与路径存在显著差异。

papers.title: BD/ARAS-based financing risk management evaluation for fisheries enterprise: a framework for resilient risk management
papers.authors: Zhang, Shi-Tong
papers.summary_cn: 该研究针对渔业企业构建基于BD/ARAS方法的融资风险管理评价框架，旨在提升企业风险管理的韧性。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节与实证结果无法获知。

papers.title: Competitive exclusion, not predation, likely drove the decline in native fish diversity following carnivorous fish introductions to Lake Titicaca in the mid‐20th century
papers.authors: Villar, Daniel A.; Turpo Aroquipa, Renzo; Gamarra Peralta, Cesar; Moreno Terrazas, Edmundo
papers.abstract: Abstract Lake Titicaca is a continental centre for ichthyological biodiversity, with over 90% of native species being endemic. However, these species face significant threats from invasive species, particularly from invasive salmonids and invasive Argentine pejerrey. While ecologists have known that these invasive species have had deleterious effects on the ichthyofauna of Lake Titicaca for decades, whether this is a consequence of competitive exclusion or direct predation remains unknown. We tested this using morphological data, testing whether the closeness of native species to invasives in morphospace was predictive of their current conservation status, and whether smaller species were likelier to be at risk than larger species. We also tested whether fisheries pressure better explained extinction risk and found species that were at higher risk of extinction were fished less than those which were at a lower risk of extinction. We found that larger species, and those closer to the invasives in morphospace, are likelier to be endangered or to have gone extinct. This strongly suggests that competitive exclusion is the primary way that invasive species cause native fish declines in Lake Titicaca. Using morphospace to assess the mechanisms of invasive species' impacts on native fish species is an alternative to longer‐term monitoring which is often absent in poorly studied, though highly diverse, tropical waters. It could be used by conservationists in other regions to triage conservation efforts towards more vulnerable species and to predict which species are likelier to be harmed when a new invasive species is identified.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在探究invasive species导致Lake Titicaca本地鱼类多样性下降的机制——competitive exclusion还是direct predation。作者利用形态空间（morphospace）数据，检验本地物种与入侵物种在形态空间中的距离是否可预测其保护现状，并比较物种体型及渔业压力的影响。结果表明，体型较大且与入侵种形态空间距离较近的物种更易濒危或灭绝，而高灭绝风险物种反而捕捞压力较低，强烈提示competitive exclusion是入侵种导致本地鱼类衰退的主要机制。该方法可作为长期监测缺失条件下评估入侵种影响的替代手段。

papers.title: The chromosome-level genome assembly of the Neotropical yellow-tailed tetra fish Astyanax lacustris (Teleostei: Characiformes)
papers.authors: Utsunomia, Ricardo; dos Santos, Rodrigo Zeni; Sassi, Francisco de Menezes Cavalcante; Oliveira, Mariana Canóva; Poncet, Charles; Belmonte, Elodie; Gautier, Véronique; Parrinello, Hugues; Rastetter, Agnes; Porto-Foresti, Fábio
papers.abstract: Abstract Astyanax is one of the most diverse genera of characiform fishes and plays an important role in Neotropical freshwater ecosystems. However, high-quality genomic resources remain scarce for the group, with most available studies focused on the model species Astyanax mexicanus . Here, we present a high-quality chromosome-level genome assembly for the yellow-tailed tetra Astyanax lacustris , a widespread and ecologically important species from the upper Paraná River basin, Brazil. The final assembly spans 1.31 Gb, with a scaffold N50 of 49 Mb and 98.8% of the sequence anchored into 25 chromosome-scale scaffolds, corresponding to the expected haploid chromosome number. Assembly completeness was supported by 99.1% complete BUSCOs against the actinopterygii_odb12 dataset. This reference genome provides a valuable foundation for future comparative genomics, evolutionary studies, and conservation genetics of Neotropical fishes.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究报道了巴西上巴拉那河流域广泛分布且具生态重要性的黄尾脂鲤（Astyanax lacustris）高质量染色体水平基因组组装。组装大小为1.31 Gb，scaffold N50为49 Mb，98.8%序列锚定至25条染色体水平scaffold，BUSCO完整度为99.1%。该参考基因组为新热带鱼类的比较基因组学、进化研究及保护遗传学提供了重要基础。

papers.title: Modelling the impact of environmental pressure and fear effect on a plankton-fish ecosystem
papers.authors: Barman, Kangkana; Phukan, Animesh; Choudhary, Santosh Kumar; Dehingia, Kaushik; Barman, Kahuwa Kuwali; Sarmah, Hemanta Kumar
papers.abstract: Abstract This paper presents a mathematical prey-predator model to investigate the intricate, non-linear relationships between phytoplankton, zooplankton, and fish in a marine ecosystem. The model incorporates fundamental ecological processes, including logistic phytoplankton growth, zooplankton grazing on phytoplankton, and fish predation on zooplankton. Additionally, we consider the impact of extreme environmental pressures, including a fear effect, on the marine ecosystem. First, we examine the positivity and boundedness of the proposed model. Furthermore, all the equilibrium points are determined, and the local stability of the system is analyzed around each equilibrium point. The research also explores the impact of rising environmental pressure on population sizes among species. It concludes that greater environmental pressure could drive the system to extinction via a branch point bifurcation. Minimal environmental pressure will destabilize the system via a Hopf bifurcation. We also explore the impact of the fear cost on the zooplankton population and conclude that greater fear costs can cause system instability via another Hopf bifurcation. Theoretical calculations are confirmed by numerical simulations carried out using Mathematica and MATLAB software.
papers.summary_cn: 构建浮游植物-浮游动物-鱼类捕食者-猎物数学模型，纳入logistic生长、摄食及fear effect与环境压力，分析平衡点稳定性与分岔行为。结果表明，环境压力升高可经branch point bifurcation导致系统灭绝，微弱环境压力则经Hopf bifurcation使系统失稳；较高的fear cost亦经Hopf bifurcation引发不稳定。数值模拟验证了理论分析。

papers.title: Obtaining Hyaluronic Acid from Fish: An Evaluation of Extraction Methods
papers.authors: Barbosa, Élida Virna Rodrigues; Sá Matos Ribeiro, Maria Priscila; Mendonça Santos, Anamaria; Serafini, Mairim Russo; Costa Louzeiro, Hilton; Sousa De Sant’anna, Mikele Cândida; da Silva, Gabriel Francisco
papers.summary_cn: 该研究评估了从鱼类中提取透明质酸（hyaluronic acid）的不同方法，比较各提取工艺的效果，为鱼类副产物高值化利用提供依据。

papers.title: Temporal Shifts in Fish Landing Composition, Stock Status, and Diversity in Lake Volvi, Greece: A Six-Decade Analysis (1961–2024)
papers.authors: Kyritsi, Stavroula; Theocharis, Alexandros; Pafras, Dimitris; Conides, Alexios; Klaoudatos, Dimitris
papers.abstract: Long-term fishery records are essential for detecting ecological change in data-limited freshwater systems. We analyzed 64 years (1961–2024) of commercial landings for ten fish categories from Lake Volvi, Greece, combining temporal, multivariate, forecasting and catch-only approaches. Total landings fell 89.8%, from 620 t in 1962 to 63.3 t in 2024. Six categories declined significantly after autocorrelation correction, whereas Gibel carp increased; excluding a documented reporting discontinuity left the decline and all diversity trends unchanged. Changepoints in landings (~1971, ~1978, ~2002) did not coincide with a compositional boundary at 1990/1991, so production decline and reorganization were not synchronous. Composition differed strongly among three a priori periods (PERMANOVA R2 = 0.656, p = 0.001), reflecting a shift from native dominants to a low-production assemblage increasingly influenced by non-native Gibel carp; diversity increased while recorded richness showed no trend. Eight series yielded viable catch-only fits. Estimated terminal biomass lay below one-fifth of BMSY for six, irrespective of terminal year, whereas exploitation ratios were strongly terminal-year dependent: five of eight changed Kobe quadrant between 2022 and 2024, owing to carried-forward values in the final two years. Severe depletion of the native taxa is therefore the robust stock-status finding; single-year exploitation classifications remain conditional on terminal year.
papers.summary_cn: 分析了希腊Volvi湖1961–2024年商业渔获物组成与多样性变化，采用时间序列、多变量分析及仅基于渔获量的 stock assessment 方法。总渔获量下降89.8%（1962年620 t至2024年63.3 t），六个类别显著下降而Gibel carp增加，群落组成在三个时期差异显著（PERMANOVA R²=0.656），由本地种主导转向低产量、非本地种影响增强的群落。八个序列的 catch-only 拟合显示六个类别终端生物量低于BMSY的五分之一，本地种严重衰竭为稳健结论，但单一年份的 exploitation 分类依赖终端年选择。

papers.title: Toward Sustainable Aquaculture: Microalgae Fully Replace Fishmeal and Fish Oil in Rainbow Trout Diets While Maintaining Growth, Nutritional Quality, and Cost Viability
papers.authors: Sarker, Pallab; Labbe, Manuel; Schoffstall, Benjamin V.; Kapuscinski, Anne R.; McKuin, Brandi; Fitzgerald, Devin; Greenwood, Connor; O’Shelski, Kira; Pasion, Emily Noelle; Gwynne, Duncan
papers.abstract: As global demand for affordable, high-quality protein continues to rise, commercial aquaculture has emerged as a critical solution. The industry’s reliance on ocean-derived fishmeal (FM) and fish oil (FO) for aquafeed poses sustainability concerns. Marine microalgae offer a promising alternative due to their comparable nutrient profiles and potential for large-scale, sustainable production. We conducted a feeding trial with juvenile rainbow trout to evaluate fish-free, microalgae-based diets as alternatives to FM and FO. Diets were formulated using Nannochloropsis oculata (N. oculata) by-product as a protein source and Schizochytrium sp. (whole-cell or oil) as a source of DHA and key antioxidants. Diets included a reference formulation containing FMFO and three experimental diets: 75% replacement of FMFO using N. oculata and Schizochytrium whole-cell (NSW75), 100% replacement using both (NSW100), and 100% replacement using N. oculata and Schizochytrium oil (NSO100). The NSW100 diet supported growth and feed conversion comparable to the FMFO control; the NSO100 had lower growth than the FMFO control. Cost analysis revealed that fish-free diets had the numerically lowest, though not significantly different, values for formulated feed costs and economic conversion ratios, highlighting their commercial potential. These findings demonstrate that microalgae-based aquafeeds combining N. oculata and Schizochytrium sp. can viably replace FMFO.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以虹鳟幼鱼为对象开展摄食试验，评估以微藻（Nannochloropsis oculata 副产物提供蛋白、Schizochytrium sp. 全细胞或藻油提供DHA）完全替代鱼粉（FM）和鱼油（FO）的饲料效果。结果显示，采用 N. oculata 与 Schizochytrium 全细胞的100%替代组（NSW100）生长与饲料转化率与FMFO对照组相当，而藻油替代组（NSO100）生长较低。成本分析表明无鱼饲料的配方成本与经济转化率数值最低（差异不显著），显示其商业潜力。研究表明，结合两种微藻的配合饲料可可行地替代FMFO。

papers.title: Effects of Nepeta cataria and Lactuca sativa on Microbial Community Structure and Nitrogen–Phosphorus Biogeochemical Cycling in Aquaculture Water
papers.authors: Wu, Kunjie; Hou, Chengliang; Zhang, Chen; Ren, Tianyu; Meng, Qiang; Yuan, Gaoliang; Ju, Chenxi
papers.abstract: As the scale of aquaculture continues to expand, aquaculture waters are under increasing environmental pressure, particularly regarding total nitrogen (TN) and total phosphorus (TP). To address this challenge, this study evaluated the efficacy of Nepeta cataria and Lactuca sativa in removing nitrogen and phosphorus from aquaculture water and investigated the underlying microbial mechanisms. The experiment consisted of three groups: the Nepeta cataria group (NC) with Nepeta cataria planted, the Lactuca sativa group (HL) with Lactuca sativa planted, and the control group (CT) without any plants. The results indicated that, compared with the control group, both the Nepeta cataria group and the Lactuca sativa group significantly reduced the concentrations of TAN, nitrite, nitrate, TN, and TP in the aquaculture water (p < 0.01). Plant species exerted a significant regulatory effect on both planktonic and rhizosphere microorganisms. The phyla Proteobacteria, Actinobacteriota, and Bacteroidota were the core dominant phyla across all groups; hgcI_clade, Rhodoluna, and Sediminibacterium were the signature dominant genera in the plant groups’ planktonic water. The microbial community is highly coupled with nitrogen and phosphorus nutrients. Nepeta cataria and Lactuca sativa enhanced the nitrification–denitrification coupling process by enriching microbial communities with nitrogen and phosphorus transformation functions, thereby forming a synergistic purification model of “plant absorption–microbial transformation.” This study elucidated the regulatory mechanisms by which Nepeta cataria and Lactuca sativa influence microbial communities and nitrogen and phosphorus cycles in aquaculture water, providing a theoretical basis and technical reference for plant selection in aquaponics systems and the ecological purification of aquaculture water.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了猫薄荷（Nepeta cataria）和莴苣（Lactuca sativa）对养殖水体氮磷的去除效果及其微生物机制。试验设猫薄荷组、莴苣组和无植物对照组，结果表明两种植物均显著降低了水体中TAN、亚硝酸盐、硝酸盐、TN和TP浓度（p < 0.01），且植物种类对浮游和根际微生物群落具有显著调控作用。变形菌门、放线菌门和拟杆菌门为各组核心优势门，植物组浮游水体中hgcI_clade、Rhodoluna和Sediminibacterium为标志性优势属。两种植物通过富集具有氮磷转化功能的微生物群落增强硝化–反硝化耦合过程，形成“植物吸收–微生物转化”协同净化模式，为aquaponics系统植物选择和养殖水体生态净化提供了理论依据。

papers.title: The coral settlement-sphere: microenvironments that shape reef restoration in the Anthropocene
papers.authors: Romero, Sarah Ling; Harrison, Peter Lynton; Ordoñez Alvarez, Alexandra; Shlesinger, Tom; Khen, Adi; Loya, Yossi; Smith, Jennifer E.; Wangpraseurt, Daniel
papers.abstract: Accelerating losses of reef-building corals are driving steep declines in coral recruitment, imperiling the biodiversity and long-term resilience of reef ecosystems worldwide. Here, we review the mechanisms underlying coral recruitment success through a critical – yet largely overlooked – microenvironmental lens relevant to the scale of microscopic coral larvae. We introduce the concept of the “settlement-sphere”, which encompasses the physical, biochemical, and microbial microhabitat properties that govern successful coral larval recruitment. We then examine how anthropogenic stressors erode this settlement-sphere by diminishing essential chemical cues, reducing microhabitat complexity, and altering key physico-chemical conditions (e.g., hypoxia), ultimately leading to recruitment failure. Finally, we argue that advancing a collective understanding of the settlement-sphere is essential for developing actionable strategies to restore degraded coral reef systems. Such strategies include augmenting reef microhabitats with chemical cues and advanced materials that promote coral recruitment, thereby supporting genetic diversity, enhancing resilience, and enabling the restocking of coral populations.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述从微观环境视角探讨珊瑚幼体补充成功的机制，提出“settlement-sphere”概念，涵盖调控珊瑚幼虫成功附着与补充的物理、生化及微生物微生境特征。研究分析了人为胁迫如何通过削弱关键化学信号、降低微生境复杂性及改变溶解氧等理化条件侵蚀这一微环境，最终导致补充失败。作者主张深化对settlement-sphere的集体认知，以制定可操作的退化珊瑚礁修复策略，包括利用化学信号和先进材料增强微生境以促进珊瑚补充、维持遗传多样性并提升生态系统韧性。

papers.summary_cn: 该研究比较了珊瑚礁鱼类分类多样性与功能多样性对生境退化及保护措施的差异化响应，基于分类与功能两个维度评估群落变化。由于摘要缺失，具体方法未知，但研究提示仅依赖物种数可能低估生境退化对生态系统功能的影响，保护评估应同时纳入功能多样性指标。

papers.title: Environmental drivers of rotenone persistence in stream fish eradications
papers.authors: Bourret, Samuel L; Bell, Donovan A; Skaar, Donald R
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective Although rotenone has been used to remove nonnative fish populations in the United States since 1934, the factors influencing its persistence remain unclear, even though under- and overapplication have substantial social, financial, and ecological consequences. Here, we quantified the variation in rotenone persistence across streams and evaluated the environmental drivers associated with rotenone loss during treatments. Methods We measured physical and chemical stream characteristics that are hypothesized to impact rotenone persistence across 21 montane streams and collected rotenone mass flux measurements every hour for a 7-h treatment. We then fitted generalized linear models to quantify the influence of stream characteristics on rotenone persistence. Results Physical, chemical, and stream bed characteristics varied widely across the 21 sample reaches. Patterns in rotenone mass flux at our lowest measurement location showed high variability compared with upstream measurements. Vegetation, conductivity, and gradient were the strongest predictors in the generalized linear models and were all negatively associated with rotenone persistence. Conclusion The variability in rotenone persistence and the relatively strong influence of factors that influence rotenone persistence emphasize the need for practitioners to carefully consider rotenone treatments in streams. We suggest a framework and working model to help guide pretreatment surveys and bioassays that can greatly increase the potential for successful rotenone treatments.
papers.summary_cn: 研究旨在量化溪流中鱼藤酮持久性的变异并识别其环境驱动因子，以指导非本地鱼类清除中的剂量管理。方法上，在21条山地溪流中测定物理化学特征，并在7小时处理期间每小时采集鱼藤酮质量通量，采用广义线性模型分析各因子影响。结果显示鱼藤酮持久性在溪流间差异显著，植被、电导率和比降是最强预测因子且均与持久性负相关。作者据此提出预处理调查与生物测定的工作框架，以提高rotenone处理成功率。

papers.title: Sex‐Disaggregated Condition and Reproductive Investment in Sardina pilchardus Reveal a Decadal Reversal and Non‐Stationary Climate Responses in the Southern Alboran Sea
papers.authors: El Oumrassi, Hajar; El Arraf, Sana; de la Hoz, Camino Fernández; Hasni, Soufiane; Er‐Raioui, Hassan
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Small pelagic fish are highly sensitive to environmental variability, yet sex‐disaggregated assessments of condition and reproductive investment remain rare in Mediterranean fisheries science and absent for the Southern Alboran Sea (SAS). Here, we report a decadal reversal in sex‐specific somatic condition in Sardina pilchardus and show that this reversal is mechanistically explained by the asymmetric reproductive costs imposed by warming‐induced changes in spawning phenology. Using 20,383 individuals sampled across two contrasting periods (1999–2003 and 2012–2023) and 10 environmental predictors, we applied generalized additive models (GAMs) to quantify environmental drivers of relative condition factor (Kn) and gonadosomatic index (GSI) and to project future biological states under SSP245 and SSP585 for 2050 and 2100. Females exceeded males in Kn during 1999–2003 but fell consistently below them by 2012–2023 (sex × period interaction: p < 0.001, ΔAIC = 228). Concurrently, the explanatory power of environmental drivers over Kn eroded substantially between periods (seasonality: −40%; SST: −39%), and this erosion was larger in females than males, constituting a sex‐differentiated form of ecological non‐stationarity not previously quantified for this species or region. SST and seasonality dominated both indicators but with opposing effects: Kn increased monotonically with SST, whereas GSI declined sharply above 16°C–20°C, revealing a physiological trade‐off invisible to biomass‐based monitoring. NPP exhibited a negative threshold effect on GSI, consistent with a phenological mismatch between peak productivity and the thermal spawning window. Projections indicate Kn declining 18%–59% and male GSI falling up to 46% under SSP585 by 2100, whereas female GSI remains comparatively stable. These findings expose multi‐level hidden stress that standard stock assessments cannot detect and establish a formal case for sex‐disaggregated monitoring as a prerequisite for climate‐resilient management of small pelagic fisheries.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于南阿尔沃兰海（SAS）欧洲沙丁鱼（Sardina pilchardus）两个对比时期（1999–2003与2012–2023）共20,383尾样本，采用GAM量化环境因子对相对体况因子（Kn）和性腺指数（GSI）的驱动作用，并进行SSP245/SSP585情景下的未来预测。结果显示雌雄体况发生十年尺度逆转：雌鱼Kn由高于雄鱼转为持续低于雄鱼，且环境因子对Kn的解释力显著衰减（季节性−40%、SST−39%），雌鱼衰减幅度更大，构成性别差异化的生态非平稳性。SST与季节性对Kn和GSI效应相反，GSI在16–20°C以上急剧下降，揭示生物量监测无法察觉的生理权衡；SSP585下至2100年Kn预计下降18%–59%、雄鱼GSI最多下降46%，而雌鱼GSI相对稳定。研究主张将性别分解监测纳入小型中上层渔业的气候韧性管理。

papers.title: Impact of an Environmental Index of Recruitment on the Stock Assessment for Petrale Sole ( Eopsetta jordani Lockington, 1878) in the California Current Ecosystem
papers.authors: Tolimieri, Nick; Gertseva, Vladlena; Taylor, Ian G.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Stock assessments provide key scientific input for managing fisheries. Age‐structure information is important for these assessments because it provides the foundation for estimating recruitment, which impacts estimates of future spawning biomass and other assessment parameters that inform management. For some species, like petrale sole ( Eopsetta jordani Lockington, 1878) along the US West Coast, the younger cohorts are poorly sampled, which leads to uncertainty in estimates of recent recruitment. We used recruitment deviations from the most recent petrale sole stock assessment and oceanographic indicators derived from the GLORYS oceanographic model to develop an environmental index of recruitment. We then tested the impact of including the index in the assessment using Stock Synthesis. Quadratic relationships for degree days during the larval stage and alongshore transport during the pelagic juvenile stage explained 66% of the variation in recruitment deviations for 1993–2018 (the training period). We then included the index predicting the 2019–2022 (forecast period) recruitment deviations in the assessment model and compared the output to the 2023 base model without this index. Including the index provided information to capture recent recruitment variability and improved near‐term forecasting, leading to more accurate estimates of recruitment, spawning biomass, and projected catch—assessment estimated quantities that inform management decisions.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用GLORYS海洋模型衍生的海洋学指标，结合最新petrale sole（Eopsetta jordani）stock assessment中的recruitment偏差，构建了环境recruitment指数。幼体期积温与浮游幼鱼期沿岸输运的二次关系模型解释了1993–2018年recruitment偏差66%的变异。将该指数纳入Stock Synthesis评估模型后，相比2023年基准模型，能够更好地捕捉近期recruitment变异并改善短期预报，从而提高recruitment、spawning biomass及预估捕捞量的估计精度，为渔业管理决策提供更可靠的科学依据。

papers.title: Evolutionary remodeling of the ventral retina enables aerial vision in the four-eyed fish Anableps anableps
papers.authors: Perez, Louise; Shi, Lina; Daspit, Alyssa; Pruett, Keyla N.; Smith, Carsyn; Prideaux, Anna; Sousa, Josane F.; Schneider, Patricia N.
papers.abstract: Abstract The emergence of evolutionary novelties remains a central challenge in biology, particularly for complex organs such as the vertebrate eye. Here, we use the four-eyed fish Anableps anableps to investigate adaptation to simultaneous aerial and aquatic vision. Single-nucleus and spatial transcriptomics reveal that the ventral retina, which processes aerial light, is developmentally expanded and exhibits region-specific opsin expression. Ventral PR1 cones express opn1mw2 rather than the longer-wavelength-sensitive opn1lw paralogs expressed dorsally. Machine-learning predictions indicate that Opn1mw2 is red-shifted relative to Opn1mw1 but remains blue-shifted relative to dorsal Opn1lw pigments. Dorsal-ventral patterning markers further reveal an overrepresentation of ventral retinal identities. Comparative spatial profiling of developing and adult Anableps and killifish indicates dorsal displacement of the retinal boundary, producing a proportionally larger ventral domain. Thus, Anableps evolved aerial vision through developmental expansion of the ventral retina and regional reconfiguration of opsin expression within conserved cone subtypes.
papers.summary_cn: 以四眼鱼（Anableps anableps）为模型，结合单核与空间转录组学，探究脊椎动物眼适应水陆双重视觉的演化机制。研究发现腹侧视网膜（处理空中光）在发育中扩张，并呈现区域特异性 opsin 表达：腹侧 PR1 视锥表达 opn1mw2，而非背侧的 opn1lw 旁系同源基因。机器学习预测显示 Opn1mw2 较 Opn1mw1 红移，但仍较背侧 Opn1lw 蓝移；比较发育与成体 Anableps 及 killifish 的空间图谱表明，视网膜边界向背侧位移导致腹侧区域比例增大。四眼鱼通过腹侧视网膜的发育扩张及保守视锥亚型内 opsin 表达的区域重构，实现了空中视觉的演化。

papers.title: Sea Surface Temperature Influences Migratory Patterns of the Atlantic Bluefin Tuna ( Thunnus thynnus ) Between the Atlantic Ocean and the Mediterranean Sea
papers.authors: Sánchez‐Fabrés, Enrique; Tugores, Ma Pilar; Carrasco, Ismael Hernández; Ospina‐Alvarez, Andres; Abascal Crespo, Francisco J.; Sanchez‐Leal, Ricardo; Mourre, Baptiste; Alvarez‐Berastegui, Diego
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Oceanographic variability plays a critical role in shaping the migratory behavior of the Atlantic bluefin tuna ( Thunnus thynnus ). This study investigates the thermal preferences of individuals migrating through the Strait of Gibraltar and the Gulf of Cádiz during pre‐ and post‐spawning movements. Comparing data measured from electronic tags and satellite‐derived sea surface temperature (SST) fields, we identified distinct SST preferred ranges associated with each migratory phase: 17.4°C–19.3°C inbound to the Mediterranean and 18.4°C–22°C outbound to the Atlantic. Based on these preferences, we developed a SST adequacy index reflecting thermal suitability, which we applied to 13 years of high‐resolution SST satellite data (2010–2022). Spatial and temporal patterns of SST adequacy were then classified using Self‐Organizing Maps, revealing dynamic hotspots of thermal suitability along migratory corridors. Our findings highlight the nonrandom, environmentally modulated nature of ABFT migrations and offer a framework to advance towards climate informed fisheries assessment, a current request of the International Commission for the Conservation of Atlantic Tunas.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过电子标记与卫星海表温度（SST）数据，分析了大西洋蓝鳍金枪鱼（*Thunnus thynnus*）经直布罗陀海峡和加的斯湾进出地中海时的热偏好，发现入海与出海阶段的适宜SST范围分别为17.4–19.3°C和18.4–22°C。基于此构建SST适宜性指数，并结合2010–2022年高分辨率卫星数据与Self-Organizing Maps，识别出洄游通道上热适宜性的动态热点。结果表明ABFT洄游受环境调控且非随机，为气候信息化的stock assessment提供了框架。

papers.authors: Ikegami, Kana; Motegi, Shinnosuke; Kanda, Haruki; Mizusawa, Kanta

papers.title: Coconut Shell Liquid Smoke (CSLS) as a Sustainable, Natural Preservative in Fisheries: A Comprehensive Review on Thermochemical Processes, Efficacy, Safety and Future Prospects
papers.authors: Prasetiawan, Haniif; Fardhyanti, Dewi Selvia; Triwibowo, Bayu; Ardhiansyah, Hanif; Savanti, Fisa
papers.abstract: This review article synthesizes findings from the last two decades (2010–2026) on the preparation, chemical composition, preservation efficacy, and safety profile of coconut shell liquid smoke (CSLS) as a natural, sustainable fish preservative. Conventional slow pyrolysis (yielding optimal phenol levels at 450–550°C) and advanced Microwave-Assisted Pyrolysis (MAP, achieving yields up to 34.6% and operating at 255–280°C with 2–3 mm particle sizes) represent the primary thermochemical techniques. Purification via redistillation, filtration, and membrane separation (ultrafiltration/nanofiltration) successfully minimizes toxic polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs), producing food-grade liquid smoke (grades A and B) that complies with strict safety standards. CSLS contains key phenolic compounds, organic acids, and carbonyls that provide dual antimicrobial and antioxidant actions. Minimum Inhibitory Concentrations (MIC) of 0.22% to 0.40% are effective against major spoilage pathogens such as Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Staphylococcus aureus, and Escherichia coli. Applications of CSLS at concentrations of 2.5% to 7.0% significantly extend the shelf life of various fish products (fillets, balls, cakes). Advanced delivery formulations, including edible chitosan coatings and chitosan/maltodextrin nanocapsules, offer sustained release, maintaining fish freshness for up to 48 hours at room temperature. Furthermore, purified CSLS exhibits low cytotoxicity and offers therapeutic benefits such as anti-inflammatory and oral ulcer healing properties. Despite these benefits, scalability, life cycle assessments (LCA), ecotoxicity in aquatic environments, and comprehensive consumer sensory acceptance remain critical gaps. This review outlines pathways to transition CSLS from pilot-scale applications to industrial-scale sustainable fisheries preservation.
papers.summary_cn: 本文综述了2010—2026年间椰子壳液熏液（CSLS）作为天然可持续鱼类防腐剂的制备工艺、化学成分、保鲜效果及安全性。常规慢速热解（450–550°C）和微波辅助热解（MAP，255–280°C，产率可达34.6%）是主要热化学技术，经再蒸馏、过滤及膜分离纯化后可有效降低多环芳烃（PAHs）含量，获得符合安全标准的食品级液熏液。CSLS中的酚类、有机酸和羰基化合物具有抗菌与抗氧化双重作用，对铜绿假单胞菌、金黄色葡萄球菌和大肠杆菌的MIC为0.22%–0.40%，2.5%–7.0%浓度可显著延长鱼糜制品及鱼片货架期，壳聚糖涂膜与纳米胶囊缓释制剂可在室温下维持鲜度达48小时。纯化CSLS细胞毒性低并具抗炎等功效，但规模化生产、生命周期评价（LCA）、水生生态毒性及消费者感官接受度仍是关键研究缺口。

papers.title: Validation of an open-source hardware for cardio-physiological studies in fish: A statistical equivalence study with a widely used research-grade electrophysiological recording system.
papers.authors: Pettinau, Luca; Congia, Pierpaolo; Anttila, Katja
papers.abstract: Monitoring heart rate (fH) accurately is fundamental for fish eco-physiological studies. However, these measurements rely heavily on expensive experimental tools. Here, we aimed to validate BITalino, an inexpensive, open-hardware biosignal acquisition system for measuring fH that could help to democratize research in fish physiology. BITalino is a modular electrophysiological system with a dedicated electrocardiogram (ECG) module that records ECG signals through electrodes connected to the module via lead wires and attached directly to the subject. We compared BITalino with a widely used research-grade physiological recording system (BIOPAC) by measuring fH in fish using both devices simultaneously. Heart-rate measurements did not differ significantly between devices, and there was no significant Device×Time interaction, indicating that both systems tracked temporal variation similarly. The intra-class correlation coefficient (ICC) showed that 85.9% of the variance was due to biological differences between fish, with less than 5% from device-related variance. These results confirm that BITalino can be effectively used for fH monitoring in fish physiology studies. Beyond its low cost, its portability, modular design, open-hardware architecture and compatibility with third-party analysis software make it easily adaptable for different experimental applications, and may facilitate its use in resource-limited research settings.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在验证低成本开源硬件 BITalino 用于鱼类心率（fH）测量的可行性，通过与研究级 BIOPAC 系统同步记录 ECG 信号进行统计等效性比较。结果显示两种设备的心率测量值无显著差异，无显著 Device×Time 交互效应，ICC 分析表明 85.9% 的变异源于个体生物学差异，设备相关变异不足 5%。BITalino 可有效用于鱼类生理学研究中的心率监测，其低成本、便携性和开源架构适合资源有限的研究环境。

papers.title: Microencapsulation of sardine fish oil using different molecular weight chitosan and polymer blends: a comparative study on oxidative stability and encapsulation characteristics
papers.authors: Jeyakumari, Annamalai; Abhiroop, Vinod; Elavarasan, Krishnamoorthy
papers.abstract: Fish oil is a valuable source of long-chain omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids; however, it is more prone to oxidative degradation which limits its incorporation into food and nutraceutical products. Microencapsulation offers an effective strategy to protect these bioactive lipids by creating a physical barrier against environmental stressors. In the present study, low- and medium-molecular-weight chitosan, in combination with bovine gelatin and maltodextrin, were evaluated as wall materials for encapsulation of sardine fish oil by spray drying. The four different sardine fish oil emulsion formulations (SE1–SE4) were prepared and spray dried. The resulting microencapsulates were stored under both ambient and refrigerated conditions, and their oxidative stability was monitored for 21 days. The moisture content of the encapsulated powders ranged from 2.49 to 4.23%, while encapsulation efficiency varied between 53.26 and 82.06%. Powder flow characteristics differed significantly (p&lt;0.05) among the formulations, with SE3 exhibiting the most desirable flow properties, as indicated by the lowest Carr’s Index (26.93) and Hausner ratio (1.37). Storage studies further demonstrated that SE3 provided superior protection against lipid oxidation under both storage conditions, as evidenced by lower thiobarbituric acid reactive substances (TBARS) values throughout the storage period. The findings highlighted that among the formulations evaluated, medium-molecular-weight chitosan in combination with bovine gelatin, maltodextrin and fish oil (0.5%) produced microencapsulates showed enhanced encapsulation efficiency, improved powder characteristics, and greater resistance to oxidative deterioration. These results suggested that sardine fish oil encapsulates prepared in the study possess significant potential for the formulation of stable omega-3-enriched functional foods and nutraceutical products.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以低分子量和中分子量chitosan分别与牛明胶、maltodextrin复配作为壁材，采用喷雾干燥法微胶囊化沙丁鱼鱼油，比较四种配方（SE1–SE4）的包封特性与氧化稳定性。结果显示，包封效率为53.26%–82.06%，水分含量2.49%–4.23%，其中SE3（中分子量chitosan复配）流动性最佳（Carr's Index 26.93，Hausner ratio 1.37），且在常温和冷藏条件下21天贮藏期间TBARS值最低，氧化稳定性最优。研究表明中分子量chitosan复合壁材可有效提升沙丁鱼鱼油微胶囊的包封效率与抗氧化能力，适用于omega-3强化功能食品开发。
